chapters.title: Chapter 51: Is This Enough Money?
paragraphs: Tan Zekun held the rod and looked at the young man on the ground. The corners of his mouth curled into a cold smile.
He smashed down with the rod!
Thud!
“Ah!” A heart-wrenching voice sounded. The young man on the ground suddenly hugged his twisted arm. Clearly, the rod had broken his arm.

This time, it also stunned Wang Zhouning and the others, let alone the girls beside them. All of them widened their eyes. They were all like flowers who had grown up in a greenhouse. Thus, they had never seen such a scene.
“Hold him down!”

As soon as Tan Zekun said this, a few burly men immediately pressed down on the young man on the ground. Tan Zekun hit him with his rod a few times until the young man could only make whimpering sounds while blood splattered.
“Ah! How cruel!”
Ye Xinyu could no longer hold it in. She screamed and retched.

As soon as she said this, everyone present turned to look at Ye Xinyu. Even Tan Zekun, who was in the octagonal cage, was the same. He looked at the group of people outside and narrowed his eyes. Holding the iron rod, he walked out of the octagonal cage.
A few men in black followed beside him.
Tan Zekun looked at Ye Xinyu and wiped his sweat. He pointed his stick at her. “Were you the one who said that I was cruel?”
For a moment, everyone’s hearts skipped a beat. Wang Zhouning even glanced at his girlfriend. She really didn’t know when to speak. It was fine to pretend not to see such a thing.
The next moment, Tan Zekun laughed out loud. His already fat body trembled with laughter.
Then, he waved at a man beside him. “Go and teach her a lesson.”
“Yes, Young Master.”
Seeing the man in black walking towards her, Ye Xinyu could not help but take two steps back. Her face was extremely pale.

Wang Zhouning took a step forward and smiled apologetically at Tan Zekun. “Young Master Tan, we heard that you were in Hall One today and came because of your reputation. My girlfriend is insensible. Please don’t be calculative with a little girl.”
“My father is Wang An, the deputy general manager of New Deal Real Estate. Please show us some respect.”
Wang An?
Tan Zekun sneered. “Go and find your father. Come, call him over. Let’s see if he dares to ask me for some respect.”
He only spoke one sentence.
However, everyone’s expressions changed, and Wang Zhouning was very embarrassed.
The other party did not take his father seriously at all.
Tan Zekun looked at Wang Zhouning and the others. Then, his eyes lit up. He had to admit that Ye Xinyu, Wang Yuanyuan, and Shu Fan were quite beautiful.
They looked pure and innocent. They should still be virgins.
Tan Zekun walked forward until he was in front of Wang Zhouning.
Wang Zhouning looked at Tan Zekun. “Young Master Tan, we came here rashly and disturbed you. We apologize and ask you to be magnanimous.”
“Apologize? Of course.” Tan Zekun smiled faintly.
Wang Zhouning was overjoyed when he heard his words.
“I’ll give you two choices now. First, accompany me into the octagon cage to fight.”
As soon as he said this, Wang Zhouning’s legs instantly went weak. His entire body was cold, as if he had been splashed with a bucket of cold water.

Looking at the sparring partner in the octagonal cage, who was still dripping with blood like a dead dog, Wang Zhouning knew that if he chose this path, his outcome would not be much better than that of the sparring partner.
It was certain that his arms and legs would break.
“Of course, there’s also the second option. You, you, and you. The three of you, come and give me a massage.” Tan Zekun naturally pointed at Wang Yuanyuan, Ye Xinyu, and Shu Fan.
When the three of them heard this, their faces turned pale at the same time. Shu Fan subconsciously tugged at the corner of Chen Yun’s clothes and hid behind him. Ye Xinyu even sat on the ground.
Needless to say, everyone knew what this meant.

Xiu Zhifeng, who was standing beside Tan Zekun, looked at the three girls with envy. None of these three girls were inferior to the beauties from Jiang City University of the Arts that day. They were all top-notch.
This...
Wang Zhouning was also stunned and stood rooted to the ground.
There were only two paths in front of him. One was to have his arms and legs broken, and the other was to hand over the three girls for Young Master Tan to enjoy.
After some consideration, he opened his mouth and said, “Young Master Tan, my father and President Tan are also friends. Why don’t we do this?”
Pa!
With a crisp sound, Tan Zekun slapped Wang Zhouning’s face.
“Get lost!”
“If you don’t get lost, don’t even think about leaving!”
His slap and a few angry roars simply shocked all the young men and women present.
They were usually treated respectfully outside. They had never seen such an attitude.
There was even a girl standing at the back holding her male companion’s hand. “Let’s go quickly.”
She was already afraid that if she did not leave, she would end up like Shu Fan and the others.
For a moment, many people were shaken, including Wang Zhouning.

He had heard about how terrifying Zhiyuan Trade was. Although his father was a deputy general manager, he was still far inferior to them. If his father was here now, he might be able to deal with them. However, he was a nobody. Usually, he relied on his father’s reputation to do whatever he wanted. Now, nothing he said was useful.
He knew that if he did not relent now, his outcome would definitely not be good.
Women were like clothes. They should be thrown away.
He immediately bowed to Tan Zekun. “Young Master Tan, we’ll get lost. We’ll get lost now. Please be magnanimous...”
“Get lost!”
Just as Wang Zhouning was about to leave, Ye Xinyu pulled him back. “Zhouning, where are you going? Don’t leave me behind.”
Ye Xinyu burst into tears, no longer as imposing as before.

Wang Zhouning broke free from her hand. “You said something wrong. Bear the consequences yourself. Moreover, it’s just a massage for Young Master Tan. What’s wrong with that?! Will it hurt you much?!”
He roared and quickly cut ties with Ye Xinyu.

When Wang Yuanyuan and Shu Fan saw this situation, they knew that they could not escape today. After all, Tan Zekun was rich and powerful. Even Wang Zhouning did not dare to speak after being slapped, let alone them.
For a moment, the two girls’ eyes turned red as a sense of powerlessness swept through them.
Wang Zhouning strode over. The group of young men and women quickly retreated and distanced themselves from the three girls.
“At least you’re sensible.” Tan Zekun looked at everyone. Then, his eyes narrowed as he looked at Chen Yun, who was standing beside Shu Fan. “Kid, what do you mean?”
“Heh.”
Chen Yun chuckled and looked at Tan Zekun. “After talking for so long, is this all you have?”
“Why do you have to do this? Can’t you go to a high-end club and find a professional lady? I’ll accompany you and smile at you. If you don’t have money, I can give it to you.”
Chen Yun walked towards Tan Zekun and took out his wallet from his outer pocket. After opening it, he took out a stack of red notes. There were dozens of them.
“Is this enough money?”
After saying that, he threw the red notes in his hand at Tan Zekun and smashed them against his face!
The entire venue was silent. When everyone saw this scene, cold sweat broke out on their foreheads!

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Trash!
paragraphs: Swoosh...
One by one, red notes were slapped against Tan Zekun’s face. Then, they fell and scattered on the ground.
The atmosphere in Hall One was immediately extremely oppressive. They looked at Chen Yun and their eyes widened. They could not believe what they were seeing.
He actually used money!
He smashed the notes against Young Master Tan!
He used money and smashed it against the young master of Zhiyuan Trade!
This was crazy!
The entire world had gone crazy!
Shu Fan’s pretty face suddenly changed. “What are you doing, Chen Yun! Run!”
If Chen Yun did not run now, he would definitely be beaten to death by Tan Zekun today!
Wang Zhouning looked at Chen Yun, his eyes almost popping out. This kid’s brain was damaged!
Originally, the three girls would only have to pay a little blood to resolve this matter. Now that this kid had done this, they were in big trouble!
They had to see someone die!
The next moment, a violent laugh sounded.
Hahahaha!
Tan Zekun looked at the red notes on the ground and laughed out loud!
“Good! Good! Good!”
“In this life, no one has ever thrown money at me!”
“I guarantee that you’ll be the first and last one!”
“If you can leave this club while panting today,” said Tan Zekun as he tapped his chest and pointed at Chen Yun, “I, Tan Zekun, will follow your surname! F*ck you!”
He was done for!
He was completely done for!
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun. She knew that this matter had already gone out of control!

“What exactly is he doing? Does he know what kind of occasion this is? Does he not want to die quickly enough?!” Wang Yuanyuan could not help but stomp her feet. If something happened to Chen Yun, she would never be able to let go of it for the rest of her life. She was the one who wanted to come out and play, so she brought him here.
What should she do?!
“Fan Fan, what should we do?!” Wang Yuanyuan was also at a loss. She looked at Shu Fan, who was holding her phone. “Call the police.”
Just as she was about to make a call, Xiu Zhifeng stepped forward and snatched her phone.
“I advise you to stay here obediently!”
“Unless you want to be like him!”
These words made the young men and women tremble and not dare to move.
Tan Zekun looked at the burly men in black beside him. “What are you waiting for? Kill him!”
A few burly men in black suddenly stepped forward.
Each of these burly men was burly and more than 1.9 meters tall. They stood there like adult silverback gorillas. It was simply incomparably terrifying.
In particular, the bulging muscles on their bodies, their arms that were as thick as the thighs of others, and the fierce look on their faces were terrifying.
When these people rushed forward, Wang Zhouning and the others were so frightened that their faces turned extremely pale.
It was no wonder that they were so frightened that their faces turned pale.
These people had committed crimes before and were all good at fighting. They had crippled countless people. Tan Zekun gathered them together to resolve countless difficult problems for him.
A man clenched his fists and punched out angrily. The sound of the wind could be heard. If this punch landed on a person, it would be enough to break their bones.
“Be careful!”
Shu Fan shouted, only to see Chen Yun grab the man’s fist and pull him back. Then, Chen Yun pressed against the man’s other shoulder and hit him in the chest with his knee.
Crack!
The sound of bones shattering could be heard.
The man’s chest also caved in. He spat out a mouthful of blood that splattered on Chen Yun’s white suit.
It was like a plum blossom blooming on white snow.
However, no one appreciated it.

“How fierce!” Wang Zhouning’s pupils were constricted when he saw Chen Yun’s skills. What kind of strength was this? When the man was pulled by Chen Yun just now, he staggered and his sternum was broken by his knee!
Chen Yun was a good fighter!
The others also looked at Chen Yun strangely. Even Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes lit up. Shu Fan was even more delighted and cheered for Chen Yun in his heart.
“Heh, f*ck, so he’s a martial arts practitioner. No wonder he dared to jump like this. He directly attacked that man!”

With Tan Zekun’s order, the remaining burly men took out a short knife from their waists. The short knives were unsheathed, and for a moment, they shone with a cold light, scaring everyone into taking a few steps back.
Meanwhile, Wang Zhouning almost hid at the door. His body began to tremble violently. Young Master Tan was going to chop Chen Yun up!
He could fight one of them with his bare hands, but could he fight ten of them with his bare hands?!
He could fight one of them with his bare hands, but could he fight more than ten people with knives?!
Chen Yun looked at the burly men in front of him and narrowed his eyes. A cold light bloomed in his eyes.
“You’re asking for death!”
He did not retreat at all and rushed towards the burly man in front of him.
His physical fitness had now reached 80. It was not an exaggeration to say that he was a humanoid weapon. Moreover, Chen Yun had learned mixed martial arts for a few years.
He did not take these damned men seriously!
At that moment, he quickly rushed towards the crowd. His figure was so fast that he was like a phantom.
In the next moment, many blades slashed at Chen Yun without any hesitation!
It was obvious that this was not the first time they had done such a thing!
Chen Yun’s fists, shoulders, knees, and legs seemed to have instantly transformed into peerless weapons that attacked these burly men.
He attacked their chins, temples, and necks...
Chen Yun’s attacks were all aimed at their vital points. Coupled with his strength, a single strike could make a person faint, leaving them without any combat strength!
Bang, bang, bang...
Collisions sounded.
In less than a minute, more than ten burly men were all made to lie on the ground by Chen Yunfang and fainted!
No one even moaned!
In the entire venue!
There was silence!
There wasn’t even anyone panting!
Wang Zhouning looked at Chen Yun as if he was petrified!

He had never seen such a person who could fight. He did not expect the kid he looked down on to be an expert and a martial arts practitioner! He single-handedly defeated more than ten burly men with knives without suffering any injuries...
He had originally planned to humiliate Chen Yun again in the fitness fighting club and have a boxing match with him to embarrass him. Now, it seemed like it was simply a fantasy.
“He, he actually won?” Wang Yuanyuan’s small mouth opened slightly as if she had seen a ghost.
Ye Xinyu was also clutching her chest, trembling as she breathed.
Shu Fan’s face was filled with excitement and joy. Everyone present had different expressions.
At this moment, Chen Yun’s body was covered in blood. It was as if plum blossoms had bloomed on his white suit.
He looked at Tan Zekun, who was not far away, and walked towards him step by step.
Every step seemed to be stepping on everyone’s hearts, making them hold their breaths.
Walking up to Tan Zekun, Chen Yun looked at the still stunned Tan Zekun and slapped him.
Pa!
The force was so great that two of his molars were slapped out.
Pa!
Another slap made half of Tan Zekun’s face swell up, and he spat out blood.
Pa!
The third slap!
The force was getting stronger and stronger! With the last slap, Tan Zekun was sent flying backward, knocking down the trembling Xiu Zhifeng who fell heavily to the ground.
“It seems like you want to do this the hard way.”
Chen Yun glanced at Tan Zekun and pointed a short knife at him.
The next moment!
“Stop right there!”
An angry shout attracted everyone’s attention.
A black muzzle was pointed at Chen Yun!
It was a gun!
Tan Zekun actually had a gun!

Chen Yun glanced at Tan Zekun and pointed a short knife at him.
The next moment!
“Stop right there!”
An angry shout attracted everyone’s attention.
A black muzzle was pointed at Chen Yun!
It was a gun!
Tan Zekun actually had a gun!

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Cripple Him!
paragraphs: Tan Zekun, who had been slapped away by Chen Yun, grabbed the briefcase in Xiu Zhifeng’s hand and took out a pistol. Then, he raised it with both hands and pointed it at Chen Yun.
His eyes were bloodshot, and his hands began to tremble.
“Stand right there!”
A muffled voice sounded, shocking everyone.
They never expected Tan Zekun to have a gun in his hand. Even Chen Yun narrowed his eyes, as if flames were rising in them.
“Young Master Tan, you can’t shoot here.” Xiu Zhifeng quickly warned Tan Zekun when he saw his actions. After all, so many people had seen it.
“Tell them to get lost!”
With Tan Zekun’s order, many people hurried out.
Wang Zhouning felt as if he had been pardoned and quickly slipped away.
Otherwise, if the gun went off, it would not be a joke.
Wang Yuanyuan and Shu Fan did not want to leave. However, Ye Xinyu and Changsheng dragged them away.
After all, the two of them were girls. Now that they were scared out of their wits, it did not take much effort to pull them away.
Shu Fan finally looked at Chen Yun with tears in her eyes.
The manager went out. After evacuating the young men and women, he made a call. “Young Master Zheng, bad news. Something big happened in the shop.”

At this moment, in Hall One, Tan Zekun stood up shakily. His eyes were filled with madness as he looked at Chen Yun. “Kid, aren’t you very good at fighting?! Aren’t you able to fight more than ten people alone?!”
“Come, I want to see if you can withstand a bullet!”
“Come and try!”

The more he spoke, the more agitated Tan Zekun became. Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Tan Zekun and sneered. He played with the knife in his hand, as if he was about to throw it at Tan Zekun’s neck the next moment.
The two of them were in a deadlock. Xiu Zhifeng, who was beside them, was also sweating profusely. He had already recognized Chen Yun just now.
He was the rich man who had embarrassed him on the fifth floor of Jiang City’s Century City.
Chen Yun’s car was a McLaren 720S. Moreover, he had spent a few million yuan. He would not believe that he was not a young master of some family without any background.
Therefore, he could not let Tan Zekun be rash now. Otherwise, if anything really happened, he would not be able to be the manager of the Human Resources Department.
At that moment, he looked at Tan Zekun. “Young Master Tan! So many people saw you holding a gun just now. If you shoot him, it won’t be easy.”
“F*ck you! I’m going to kill him today!” Tan Zekun had lived for so long. Usually, everyone would lower their heads and bow when they saw him, respectfully calling him Young Master Tan.
However, Chen Yun simply slapped him three times in front of everyone!
How could he accept this?!
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at Tan Zekun and shook his head. “You don’t dare to shoot.”
“What did you say?! You’re asking for death!”
Tan Zekun’s eyes widened, and his hands holding the gun shook even more. Clearly, he was even more agitated.
“Trash.” Chen Yun chuckled. In the next moment, his eyes turned cold as he threw the short knife in his hand at Tan Zekun.
The knife cut through the air!
It rushed towards Tan Zekun’s neck.
This shocked Tan Zekun and he quickly dodged.
The next moment, he turned around and saw Chen Yun reach into his pocket and take out a silver-white gun. He aimed it at him and fired!
His movements were smooth like flowing water!
Bang!
The bullet pierced through Tan Zekun’s right shoulder, leaving him badly mangled!
Bang!
Another spear pierced through Tan Zekun’s left shoulder!
With two shots, Chen Yun made Tan Zekun completely lose his ability to fight.
Beside him, Xiu Zhifeng was stunned. Compared to the trembling Tan Zekun, Chen Yun’s actions were simply done in one go, as if he had trained countless times.
He was so determined and decisive. These were not qualities people his age had.
Outside, Zheng Jianghao, who had just arrived, had just entered the courtyard when he heard two gunshots. He immediately thought that something was wrong and ran towards Hall One with the manager.
When he entered Hall One, he was stunned by the scene in front of him.
More than ten burly men fell to the ground, their fate unknown!
There was blood all over the ground!
Meanwhile, Tan Zekun kept wailing like a pig being slaughtered!
Beside him, a young man in a white suit was holding a gun to Tan Zekun’s forehead.
He was like an executioner preparing to take Tan Zekun’s life in the next moment.
This figure.
It was so familiar!
Who was it?!
Zheng Jianghao’s eyes widened as he quickly filtered through the information in his mind.
This!
“Director Chen! Don’t!”
Zheng Jianghao spoke loudly, making Chen Yun turn his head. He quickly walked over and stood in front of Chen Yun. “Director Chen, why are you here?”

At this moment, Tan Zekun looked at Zheng Jianghao. Even though the corners of his mouth were twitching in pain, he used his last bit of strength to say, “Zheng Jianghao, help me call my father. I want to kill him!”
Thud!
With a muffled sound, Zheng Jianghao stepped on Tan Zekun’s stomach.
“Young Master Zheng, what are you doing?!” Xiu Zhifeng looked at Zheng Jianghao in confusion.
“You blind thing. Call your father? Let me tell you, Tan Zekun, even if your father comes today, he won’t be able to do anything.”
“Do you know who this person is?!”
Zheng Jianghao squatted down and patted Tan Zekun’s fat face. “Listen carefully. This is Director Chen of Sacred Heaven.”
“You should know what happened to Gai Lingjie. I don’t need to say anything else, right?”
Hearing Zheng Jianghao’s words, Tan Zekun’s body instinctively trembled.
What?
Was he Director Chen?
Was he the ruthless person who directly crippled Gai Lingjie?!
Even if Tan Zekun was beaten to death, he would never have thought that there would be such a dragon among a group of worms!
At that moment, he looked at the Desert Eagle in Chen Yun’s hand, his eyes filled with despair.
Then, he looked at Zheng Jianghao with pleading eyes.
“Do you now know fear?” Zheng Jianghao sneered and stood up. “Director Chen, I’m Zheng Jianghao. I’m from the same family as Jiang Shouheng. What do you think we should do with him?”
With a few words, he revealed his identity.

As he spoke, he was also in a difficult position. It would not be good if someone died in his territory. After all, so many people had seen it. If no one saw the conflict between the two of them today, Zheng Jianghao would definitely not mind helping Chen Yun deal with Tan Zekun.
“Cripple him.”
Chen Yun spoke slowly. Then, he took off his bloodstained white suit and abandoned it.
These two words had already shown Tan Zekun’s fate.

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Get Me a Knife!
paragraphs: Zheng Jianghao looked at the store manager beside him and spoke.
Then, the manager quickly picked up a short knife from the ground and handed it to Zheng Jianghao.
Tan Zekun lay on the ground and looked at the knife in Zheng Jianghao’s hand. “If you want to blame someone, blame yourself for not having eyes.”
The next moment, the sound of the wind breaking could be heard.
Screams filled the entire Hall One.
After a while, a police car sounded.
Zheng Jianghao looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, go out from the back door first. I’ll make the arrangements here.”
“Xiao He, help me send Director Chen off.”
“Yes.” Chen Yun glanced at him and walked towards the back with the manager.

After watching Chen Yun leave, Zheng Jianghao sat on the ground and looked at Tan Zekun, who was lying on the ground like a dead dog. He patted his face. “Why are you so blind? He snatched 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares from the Lu family. His background is so powerful that the entire upper echelons of Jiang City don’t dare to guess where he’s from. But you.”
“After you wake up in the hospital, think about how to speak and do things. If your words don’t satisfy Brother Jiang and me, we don’t mind making you shut up forever.”
“Of course. You know what kind of people keep their mouths shut forever.”
“Did you hear that?”
As soon as Zheng Jianghao said this, Tan Zekun panted heavily, as if he had agreed.
On the other hand, the manager drove Chen Yun back to school.
On the way, Chen Yun’s phone rang. Chen Yun looked at it and saw that it was an unfamiliar number.
“Hello?”
“Is this Chen Yun? The police were here just now. Why didn’t I see you? Are you alright?” The person who called was Wang Yuanyuan. She must have gotten his number from Auntie Song.
“I’m fine.”
Chen Yun replied. He also didn’t agree to Wang Yuanyuan and the other two girls’ request to treat him to a meal.
He did not have much interaction with Wang Yuanyuan to begin with. If she was not Auntie Song’s daughter, he would not have made a move.
As for the meal, there was no need for it.
With that, he hung up.
For a moment, Wang Yuanyuan looked at her phone and gritted her teeth in anger.
“How is it? How is it? Is he alright?” Shu Fan came over and looked at Wang Yuanyuan as she asked anxiously.

“He’s alright!” Wang Yuanyuan said angrily, “What’s there to be arrogant about?! He’s just good at fighting! The three of us wanted to treat you to a meal, yet you still put on airs. I even hurriedly asked you if you’re alright. What a waste of my effort!”
Although she said this, her eyes were still filled with yearning when she thought of how Chen Yun had stepped forward and fought more than ten people alone.
At the side, when Shu Fan heard Wang Yuanyuan’s words, she was relieved and heaved a sigh of relief.
She couldn’t help but cover her chest.
Meanwhile, ignoring Wang Yuanyuan, Chen Yun’s life returned to peace.

When he returned home, Chen Yun used his perfume to cover the smell of blood on his body. When he walked into the house, the two girls had long heard the sound of Chen Yun’s sports car and quickly went downstairs.
“Brother! You’re back.” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun and said angrily, “You went out early in the morning and only came back now. Where did you go?”
“I went to an event and then went to Auntie Song’s place.”
Hm?

“Wow! Why didn’t you tell me that you were going to Auntie Song’s place?” Chen Mengmeng pouted. It had been a long time since she had eaten Auntie Song’s cooking. To her, Auntie Song was simply her role model.
She was good at cooking and housework. Outside, she was a strong woman, but inside, she was a good wife and mother.
She was simply a model for women.

Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng’s admiring expression and smiled. “Why don’t I bring you along next time? However, let me tell you in advance, Auntie Song will definitely pull her daughter to accompany you. How about it? Will you still go?”

“I’m not going.” At the mention of Wang Yuanyuan, even Mengmeng quickly waved her hand. She could not afford to offend that young lady. She would hide. She did not want to see her for the rest of her life.
“Alright, I’ll take a shower and change my clothes.” Chen Yun walked in.
“Alright, Xiao Xue and I will cook. Hurry up and wash up. Don’t let the food get cold.”
Chen Yun made an OK gesture in the air.
When he returned to his room, he took off her clothes and simply threw them into the trash can.
If anyone saw this, they would definitely scold Chen Yun for being a prodigal!
A custom-made luxury suit worth 800,000 yuan was thrown just like that!
Most importantly, it even included a Gucci lizard-skin belt. Just that belt alone cost 300,000 yuan!
After taking a shower, Chen Yun went down and took a basin from the kitchen. After filling it with water, he placed the chlorella inside.
Gulp, gulp, gulp...
Strings of bubbles appeared. Not long after, the entire basin of water turned blue. The color was simply incomparably bewitching.
The next day.
Chen Yun got up and walked down with the basin. He placed it on the table and took a long straw. He drank from it while watching television.
After taking a sip, Chen Yun’s eyes widened. This was simply better than soda!
A cooling feeling instantly filled his entire body. It was really as the Sprite advertisement had said. It was so cool that it felt as if his heart was flying.
Moreover, all the cells in his body seemed to have been activated in an instant. It was simply incomparably strange.
On the second floor, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue slowly walked down in their pajamas.
Han Xue looked at Chen Yun and her eyes widened. “Brother Yun, you, you...”
“Brother!” Chen Mengmeng also ran over. “Brother, what are you doing? No matter how thirsty you are, you can’t drink the toilet cleaner!”
Chen Yun was speechless.
What toilet cleaner? As long as it was blue, did it mean that it was a toilet cleaner?
“No? Could it be detergent? Or is it screenwash?” Chen Mengmeng was still talking when Chen Yun pressed her onto the sofa and handed her a straw, forcing her to take a sip.
“Boohoo...”
Chen Mengmeng, who was still struggling, instantly quietened down. Her eyes were simply shining. The taste of this water was simply much better than cola!
Moreover, her entire body and mind seemed to be cleansed!
It was as if she had returned to the feeling from a few years ago.
Chen Yun also handed Han Xue a straw. The three of them drank it and fell in love with this feeling.
Just like that, the three of them finished half a basin. In the end, they stood up and felt that their bodies were swaying.
“Xiao Xue, look at your face.” Chen Mengmeng’s eyes widened as if she was looking at something unbelievable.
“What happened to my face?”
Han Xue took the mirror she carried with her and was shocked when she opened it.
She couldn’t believe it.
Was this her face? Although her facial features had not changed, her skin was much better.
Her skin was fair and smooth. It was also very delicate.
Oh God!

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Was He So Fierce?
paragraphs: Not only did this happen to Han Xue, but even Chen Mengmeng’s skin became delicate.
Moreover, the two of them clearly felt that their vitality had increased a lot. In comparison, Chen Yun, whose physique had previously been strengthened, felt that the effect was minimal.

“I didn’t expect this thing to have such an effect.” Chen Yun thought to himself. He recalled the introduction of the antioxidant chlorella back then. This thing could extend one’s lifespan if used continuously. It naturally had the effect of delaying aging.
Furthermore, there were no side effects.
Such a thing would definitely cause a commotion if it was revealed to the public. However, it could not be mass-produced yet.
These things could only be provided to a small number of people.
He turned on his phone. The Desert Island Survival show was still ongoing.
There were only 300 people left.
There were more and more comments. In the school, many people were discussing this variety show and the contestants who were participating in the show.

“What do you think of Zhou Jie? I think that he can get the 100 million yuan prize in the end. After all, he’s too strong and has such a physique. The key is that he’s handsome.” In Jiang City University of Technology, a few girls gathered together to discuss after class.
“It’s 100 million.”
“I want to participate too, but I didn’t pass the audition. How sad.”
When the boys beside them heard their words, they chuckled. “Zhou Jie is not bad, but I think Sun Xiao is more likely to win. She’s a girl with a super strong physique.”
“Come on, how is that possible?”
“Don’t you believe me? Go and take a look at the bets on foreign websites. Who has the higher odds now?”
For a moment, many people began to discuss. After all, the show had already reached the climax. It had just rained heavily on Clear Sky Island.

At the same time, as the Desert Island Survival program became popular in China, Sacred Heaven Entertainment also used the wide platform of the Desert Island Survival program to start their own promotion plan.

In a short period of time, Sacred Heaven had developed the label of their star-making factory to the extreme and nurtured a group of stylish male celebrities. This caused the market for young celebrities in China to instantly turn cold.
The box office of Sacred Heaven’s movies also rose steadily.
The entire Sacred Heaven was originally like a pile of dry firewood. It was not very imposing when piled there and was ordinary.
However, when a spark fell in, it burst out with powerful flames.
Furthermore, this spark was Chen Yun!

Sacred Heaven’s success also made many people sigh. Huaying Entertainment was one of them. Originally, their development had been rapid in recent years and they already had the momentum to catch up to Sacred Heaven. However, now, Sacred Heaven had widened the gap between them and there was no hope of catching up.
At this moment, Chen Yun was still studying how to mass-produce the chlorella. However, after trying for a day, he did not gain anything.
[Check-in Mission]
[Time: Tomorrow at 12 o’clock. Location: East Mountain Villa.]
Oh?
Did he have to check in at the East Mountain Villa tomorrow at 12?
Chen Yun had just finished reading the check-in mission when another screen popped up.
[Host, please check in.]
Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Check-in successful. Received 100,000,000 yuan.]
The next moment, the Random Double Skill was activated.
The reward of 100 million turned into 800 million!
It entered Chen Yun’s account again.
[Hidden Departure Check-in Mission: Spend all the rewards for this check-in within three days. You can obtain a skill the next time you check-in.]
Oh?
Chen Yun smiled. Could he obtain a skill?
This was amazing. One had to know that his current skills were especially heaven-defying. One of his skill was Full of Luck, while the other skill was the Random Double Skill.
Chen Yun was not in a hurry. After all, 800 million yuan was easy to spend. At most, he would buy another villa at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
After a meal.
Chen Yun’s phone rang. He picked it up and saw that it was Jiang Shouheng.
“What’s wrong?”
“Director Chen, there’s a collection exhibition at East Mountain Villa tomorrow. There will be an auction after that. It’s organized by our family. Do you have time?”
Oh?
He had received a check-in mission previously, which was at East Mountain Villa. He could go take a look.

Although he was not interested in the collection exhibition, after all, he had four porcelain vases of excellent quality. Any one of them could be sold for tens of millions or even hundreds of millions!
“That works too.”
“Then, Director Chen, I’ll go back from Clear Sky Island tonight. Shall I pick you up tomorrow?” Jiang Shouheng said respectfully.
“There’s no need. I’ll go over myself. Also, you don’t have to call me Director Chen in the future. It’s too distant.”
These words made Jiang Shouheng extremely excited. He immediately changed his words. “You’re a little older than me, so I’ll be arrogant and call you Brother Yun.”
“Sure.”
“Then we’ll be waiting for you tomorrow.”

The next day, Chen Yun woke up early. When it was almost noon, he walked to the underground garage and looked at the car in front of him. He got into the Ferrari and headed straight for the East Mountain Villa.

Meanwhile, there were already luxury cars gathered at the entrance of the East Mountain Villa. This time, in order to show off their wealth, the Jiang family spread invitations widely. As long as they were influential in Jiang City, they were invited. Everyone present was chatting and laughing, taking this opportunity to expand their social circle.
“Young Master Jiang.”
“Everyone, have fun today.”
Jiang Shouheng kept greeting everyone with a smile on his face.
“Brother Jiang!” In the next moment, a voice sounded. Jiang Shouheng looked at the young man on the other side. “Jiang Hao!”

“Brother Jiang, you guys are really ostentatious this time! You rented the entire East Mountain Villa to hold this exhibition. You’re really generous.” As Zheng Jianghao spoke, his eyes were filled with envy.

Now, everyone in Jiang City knew that Cauldron Dragon Security was close to Sacred Heaven. They even relied on Sacred Heaven’s Desert Island Survival variety show to become popular. As a result, there were endless orders. It was said that apart from security guards, the Cauldron Dragon Headquarters did not have any extra bodyguards.
This was a classic example of having a big power to rely on.

When Jiang Shouheng heard this, he was smug in his heart, but he waved his hand humbly. “What’s so great about it? I only have such an undeserved reputation now because of the empire my father built and Director Chen’s favor.”
“Otherwise, I don’t know how long it will take for us to rise.”
“By the way, I saw Director Chen yesterday.” As Zheng Jianghao spoke, he could not help but shiver. “I was almost scared to death yesterday.”
“What’s wrong? Did you provoke Director Chen?”

“No, this was what happened.” Zheng Jianghao briefly told Jiang Shouheng what his manager had told him yesterday. When Jiang Shouheng heard this, he was shocked and could not believe what he had heard!
He looked at Zheng Jianghao. “Do you think Director Chen defeated the ten or so ferocious people under Tan Zekun alone?”
“Moreover, he defeated more than ten people holding knives with his bare hands in less than a minute!”
This!
For a moment, cold sweat broke out on Jiang Shouheng’s forehead. He naturally knew that Tan Zekun’s subordinates were ruthless people who did not know how to hold back and were not afraid of death.
Furthermore, they were incomparably ferocious. If such people worked at Cauldron Dragon, they would definitely be worth a million yuan annually.
However, had such fierce people all been defeated by Director Chen in just a minute?
Moreover, Director Chen was unharmed!
Was this a fantasy?
Even the highest-level bodyguards of the Cauldron Dragon could not do it!

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Find Your Sister
paragraphs: Looking at Jiang Shouheng’s expression, Zheng Jianghao’s face darkened. “Later on, Tan Zekun took action.”
What?
These words made Jiang Shouheng’s eyes darken. “He dared to shoot Director Chen? He has a death wish!”
“Don’t be agitated, Brother Jiang. Don’t be agitated.” When Zheng Jianghao saw Jiang Shouheng’s expression, he quickly said, “Although Tan Zekun used a gun, Director Chen also had a gun.”

“I interrogated Tan Zekun’s manager back then. Director Chen quickly pulled out his gun when he was more than ten meters away. He fired two shots accurately at Tan Zekun’s shoulders. Brother Jiang, do you know what this means?” Zheng Jianghao’s face was solemn.
“Director Chen is an expert at guns!”

When Jiang Shouheng heard this, cold sweat broke out on his forehead. His family ran a security company, and all the high-level bodyguards in his hands had gun permits. Naturally, he had also touched guns. Moreover, his father had retired from the military, so he had received training since he was young.
However, even he did not dare to say that he could accurately hit the target from ten meters away when someone was pointing a gun at him.
How good was his mental fortitude and marksmanship?!
Moreover, Chen Yun had previously knocked down more than ten ferocious men with knives with his bare hands.
Regardless of Chen Yun’s identity, in terms of his strength, Jiang Shouheng would definitely dare to offer an annual salary of tens of millions in Cauldron Dragon Security!
This was a top-notch annual salary!

At that moment, Jiang Shouheng had a new opinion of Chen Yun. He originally thought that Chen Yun was the young master of a large family in Tianjing. He had a huge background and was rich. However, he did not expect Chen Yun to have such powerful combat strength.
Chen Yun’s impression of him instantly became stronger, even surpassing his iron-blooded father, Jiang Zhengyu!
He thought of his father and blinked. It seemed like he had brought someone with him when he came out to welcome the guests.
Pa!
Jiang Shouheng slapped his head and looked around him. Then, he squatted on the ground and scanned his surroundings.
If they didn’t know that Jiang Shouheng was the young master of the Jiang family, others would definitely say that he was being a hooligan.
“Is she gone? Where did she go? Eh?”
“Brother Jiang.” Zheng Jianghao, who was beside him, looked at Jiang Shouheng, who had an iron-blooded temperament, and was shocked. “What are you doing?”
“My sister, Lai Lai, is missing. Where did this little thing go?” Jiang Shouheng stood up and grabbed Zheng Jianghao. “Jianghao, when we met, did you see the little girl beside me?”
Zheng Jianghao was shocked by Jiang Shouheng’s appearance. He immediately shook his head crazily. “When we met, there wasn’t anyone beside you.”

“F*ck!” Jiang Shouheng couldn’t help but curse. “Jianghao, wait here to welcome Director Chen. I’m going to look for my sister. If anything happens to that little guy, my father will definitely kill me.”
Hey, hey!
Looking at Jiang Shouheng running away, Zheng Jianghao had a helpless expression. He could only stand there and help Jiang Shouheng welcome the guests.
What was going on?!
“Hello, please come in.”
“Haha, right, right. Young Master Jiang has something to do. I’m helping Young Master Jiang welcome the guests.”

Zheng Jianghao skillfully welcomed the guests, but he gradually became frustrated. At this banquet, the Jiang family distributed invitation cards, but the invitations were divided into several levels.
The invitation cards were divided into invitations for the external venue and invitations for the internal venue.

Among them, the invitations for the external venue allowed one to visit some of the exhibits. Meanwhile, the invitations for the internal venue were not easy to obtain. Only those with assets above 50 million and were willing to participate in the auction could enter.
Of course, there were also differences in the outer venue. Many people came in through their connections, so when they saw Zheng Jianghao here, they wanted to talk to him.
After all, he was also the young master of the Zheng family.
Just as Zheng Jianghao was feeling extremely frustrated, he looked at a few beautiful figures at the side and frowned. He seemed to have seen these people yesterday, but where were they from?
He was staring at Wang Yuanyuan and the others.

At this moment, Ye Xinyu still had a look of anger on her face. She was extremely dissatisfied with Wang Zhouning for abandoning her yesterday. If Wang Zhouning had not paid a huge price yesterday and bought her something worth hundreds of thousands of yuan, the two of them would have broken up.
At the side stood Wang Yuanyuan and Shu Fan. However, the two of them kept a respectful distance from Wang Zhouning. They were chatting enthusiastically with an older girl beside them.
They had also come with this girl.
“I didn’t expect the Jiang family to rise so quickly.” The girl sighed and shook her head. “Jiang City is really changing rapidly.”
At the side, Wang Yuanyuan looked at the girl with admiration. Then, she smiled bitterly. “Sister Bingyu, has Jiang City changed a lot? We don’t feel anything.”

Wang Bingyu looked at Wang Yuanyuan’s face and smiled. Wang Yuanyuan’s father was only a department cadre. Meanwhile, although her mother ran a company, it was very small. It was just a new middle-class company. How could she get news about the higher-ups?
Even with her identity, it was only just enough to have some contact with the upper echelons of Jiang City.
“Miss Wang, I didn’t expect us to meet again after meeting in Yanwei.” Beside them, a middle-aged man with a big belly walked over with a smile and looked at Wang Bingyu.
Wang Bingyu turned around and quickly put on a smile. “Mr. Li, why are you here?”
“I’m here on a business trip. I was invited here by a friend to take a look.”
Wang Bingyu suddenly understood. “Then, Boss Li, I have to do my best as a host today.”
“Alright, haha.” Li Xiao said a few words to Wang Bingyu before looking at his phone. “Miss Wang, my friend is urging me.”
“Boss Li, you must be very busy.”
After Li Xiao left, Wang Yuanyuan looked at Wang Bingyu. “Sister Bingyu, who is this?”

“Boss Li Xiao from Yanwei is considered a local tyrant. He’s rich,” said Wang Bingyu. She thought to herself that she had to rely on Boss Li today. This way, her cooperation with Yanwei and the other manufacturers would be smoother.
Just as Wang Bingyu was conversing with Wang Yuanyuan and Shu Fan, a few soft cries sounded from behind, making them turn around.

The crowd automatically retreated to the sides and made way for them. The people on both sides looked surprised and shocked. There were even people who smiled apologetically and greeted the people in the middle.

In the middle, there were a few people walking. The two people in the lead were wearing two suits, one black and one pink. The young man in the pink suit had slightly dark eyes and a thin body. He even made people feel that his footsteps were a little unsteady. There was a disdainful smile on his lips, as if he treated those who greeted him and wanted to talk to him as ants or even bedbugs.

Beside him was a man with a toothbrush mustache. He was short and held a short katana in his hand. He looked at the person beside them and chuckled at the young man beside him. He said in awkward Chinese, “Su Jun, it seems that you’re very popular in Jiang City.”
“Mr. Kawakaze, you flatter me. I just have some reputation in Jiang City. I’m not like you, the person-in-charge of the Three Spirits Financial Group in Jiangbei,” said the young man humbly.
As soon as he said this, even Kawakaze Kei chuckled.
In the distance, Wang Bingyu looked at the young man.
“What a big scene today. Even the young master of Huaying Entertainment, Su Yuncheng, is here. Tsk tsk.”
Su Yuncheng!
Wang Yuanyuan looked at the young master of Huaying Entertainment and couldn’t help but be fascinated.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: In All Honesty!
paragraphs: “Fan Fan, look. It’s the young master of Huaying.” Wang Yuanyuan looked at Su Yuncheng, her eyes seemingly blooming with light.

Huaying Entertainment was worth billions of yuan. The Su family controlled it, and Su Yuncheng had become the young master of Huaying at a young age. He had 10% of the shares in his hands. Although most of the shares were in the hands of the Su family’s old master, anyone with a discerning eye could tell that among the younger generation of the Su family, Su Yuncheng was the only promising one.
If the Su family wasn’t handed over to him in the future, who else would it be handed over to?
Whoever could get close to Su Yuncheng could become the wife of the entire Su family in the future.
That status was extremely glorious!

At this moment, the two of them walked forward. Zheng Jianghao looked at the two of them and sneered. “Please wait. Jiang Shouheng and Young Master Jiang have something to do, so I’ll welcome the guests here in his place.”
“You guys don’t look familiar. Can you show me your admission tickets?”

Zheng Jianghao deliberately said this for no other reason than to disgust these people. How could he not know Su Yuncheng? However, Huaying Entertainment and Sacred Heaven Entertainment were in opposition. Their family mainly worked with Sacred Heaven Entertainment, so they naturally felt proud. When they saw Su Yuncheng’s achievements, they wanted to provoke him.
“You don’t know me?” Su Yuncheng looked at Zheng Jianghao and asked.

Hehe, Zheng Jianghao raised his head. “Oh, what are you saying? My social circle is small, so how can I know everyone? Don’t you think so? Furthermore, this person doesn’t look like one of our compatriots. Aiya, the exhibition this time showcases the treasures of China. It’s a small matter if you can’t appreciate it. However, if anything is lost, Young Master Jiang and I won’t be able to bear the responsibility.”
“Thus, it’s better to be careful.”
“Don’t you think so?”
As he spoke, Zheng Jianghao squeezed out an innocent smile, looking harmless and serious.
It was not that Kawakaze Kei, who was beside him, didn’t understand chinese. At this moment, his eyes were filled with anger. How could he not understand what Zheng Jianghao meant?
Su Yuncheng looked at Zheng Jianghao. “Alright, you don’t know me, but I know you. You’re the son of President Zheng of the Zheng Corporation, right? Do you want to investigate? Here you go.”
The admission ticket was handed to Zheng Jianghao. Zheng Jianghao looked at it and said, “Aiya, so it’s Young Master Su from Huaying Entertainment. I’ve really neglected you.”
The people around them looked at the situation and smelled the smell of gunpowder in the air. They kept a respectful distance.
They could not afford to offend either side.
After watching the two of them enter, Zheng Jianghao sneered. He tore open Su Yuncheng’s invitation card and threw it into the trash can.
“Mr. Kawakaze, don’t mind him.” Su Yuncheng bowed slightly to the other man.
“Mr. Su, it’s fine. I’m here to retrieve what belongs to us. I hope you can help me,” said Kawakaze Kei.
“What is it?” Su Yuncheng was shocked. It was no wonder that Kawakaze Kei would come here.
Kawakaze Kei held the short knife in his hand, his fists turning white. “It’s a family heirloom that originally belonged to our Chuan Feng family.”

On the other side, Chen Yun drove the Ferrari over and looked at the grand scene in the parking lot of the East Mountain Villa. He could not help but be speechless. The cars parked here were all luxury cars worth more than 500,000 yuan. Moreover, 80% of the cars were worth more than a million yuan.
It could be seen how many high-ranking people the Jiang family had invited this time.
Chen Yun got out of the car, tidied his white suit, and locked the car.
“Don’t move!”
A childish voice sounded. “Lai Lai is going to cast magic. Lai Lai is going to turn you into the most handsome man in the world!”

Chen Yun chuckled and turned around. He saw a little girl standing behind him. She was fair and exquisite, like the girl that was often depicted with Guanyin. She was 70 to 80 centimeters tall and wore a white pleated dress. At this moment, her watery eyes were wide open and filled with surprise.
The little girl looked at Chen Yun’s face and then at her hands. “Wow! Does Lai Lai have magic?”
“Does Lai Lai really have magic?”
“Whose child is this?” Chen Yun squatted down and picked up the little girl. He touched her smooth face with his fingers. “Baby, why are you running around in the parking lot? It’s so dangerous.”

“Lai Lai didn’t run around. Lai Lai came with my brother. My brother is...” She turned her head and looked behind her. Then, she exclaimed. After looking around, her eyes immediately turned red and tears welled up in her eyes.
“Brother, Lai Lai’s brother is missing. Can you help me find my brother?” The little girl looked at Chen Yun and lay on his chest. Her tears wet Chen Yun’s suit.
Chen Yun patted the little girl’s head. “You were the one who got lost. Don’t cry. I’ll help you find your brother. What’s your name?”
“My name is Jiang Lai.”
“In the future1?” Chen Yunxin thought to himself that this girl’s family was quite good at naming. “What’s your brother’s name?”
“I don’t know.”
The little girl shook her head.
Alright, this sister didn’t even know her brother’s name.
Chen Yun saw that the little girl was dressed in branded clothes and should have run out of the East Mountain Villa. He immediately carried her towards the East Mountain Villa.
When he reached the entrance of the East Mountain Villa, Chen Yun saw how huge and luxurious the East Mountain Villa was.
It occupied tens of thousands of square meters.
There was a small bridge and flowing water, a Jiangnan-style waterside pavilion, a purple bamboo garden, and stone carvings.
If not for the fact that it did not occupy as much space as the Classical Gardens of Suzhou, it might have been able to compete for the first place among the Chinese Gardens.
The two huge stone lions at the door displayed their might. The little girl could not help but hide in Chen Yun’s arms.
“Lai Lai!”
“Lai Lai!”
In the distance, shouts sounded. When the little girl heard this, she quickly looked up. “It’s my brother!”
Chen Yun looked in the direction of the voice. The latter also looked over. The two of them were stunned.
Chen Yun was silent. It was Jiang Shouheng.
Jiang Shouheng was also silent. Was this Director Chen?
He quickly ran over. “Chen... Brother Yun, why didn’t you call me in advance?”
“Why are you so troublesome? Is this your family’s girl?”
“Yes, she’s my sister.”
“This little girl was running around the parking lot just now and I happened to bump into her, so I brought her here.” As Chen Yun spoke, he patted the little girl’s head dotingly.
You!
The parking lot!
When Jiang Shouheng heard this, his heart skipped a beat. What would happen if she was hit by a car?
That family’s sky would collapse!
“Lai Lai! How could you run away from me and go to the parking lot alone? Don’t you know how dangerous it is!” As he spoke, he raised his hand.
The little girl suddenly hugged the two buns on her head as if she was hugging her head with both hands. “Brother, I know I was wrong. Don’t hit me all the time.”
An aggrieved voice sounded.
However, it almost made Jiang Shouheng go crazy.
What the hell!
In all honesty!
He had been constantly pampering her, afraid that she would shatter and melt. When had he ever hit her?!
There’s no such thing as making up lies like this!

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Jade Seal!
paragraphs: “Alright, you’re not allowed to do this in the future.” Jiang Shouheng looked at Jiang Lai and sighed. “Come here. I’ll carry you. Don’t trouble Brother Yun.”
“No!” Jiang Lai hugged Chen Yun with her small hands. “I want this handsome brother to carry me.”
Jiang Shouheng was speechless. Could it be that he was an ugly brother?
“Alright, I’ll carry you.” Chen Yun tapped the little girl’s nose with the tip of his finger. Then, he laughed and walked in.
At this moment, there were already many people inside. It was like a garden party. Chen Yun and the others were mixed in and were really not very conspicuous.
After watching for a while, Chen Yun really could not appreciate it. Although these things were old, their quality was not good and they were severely damaged.
Compared to his porcelain vases at home, the difference was huge.
“Brother Yun, these are only for outsiders to see. There’s an auction here later. There are professional auctioneers sent by Sotheby’s Auction House. They also brought many precious auction items.”
“Oh? Then I’m going to take a good look.” Chen Yun smiled.
After strolling for a while, the auction began. Chen Yun and the others had their identities verified and walked in.
A total of 30 to 40 people entered the auction.
After Chen Yun sat down, Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao sat beside him.

Zheng Jianghao looked at the man standing at the side and took out a bag of tea leaves from his briefcase. “Bai Yu, get someone to soak these tea leaves for Director Chen to try. Let them use mountain spring water. There should be professional tea makers behind. Be careful not to ruin these tea leaves.”
“What tea is that?” Jiang Shouheng looked at Zheng Jianghao’s careful expression and could not help but smile.
“It’s a special-class Zhengshan xiaozhong tea.”
“Did you steal Uncle Zheng’s tea leaves?” Jiang Shouheng smiled. “My father drank it once too. After he came back, he even talked about it from time to time.”
“What do you mean by stealing? It’s done by my own son. How can it be considered stealing?”

After a while, Bai Yu walked over with a teapot and teacup. He poured the tea for Chen Yun first, then for Jiang Shouheng. After pouring for the three of them, the fragrance immediately filled the air.
For a moment, many people looked over.

“Why are their tea leaves so fragrant? This is differential treatment!” A foreign tycoon smelled the fragrance and spoke unhappily. His friend beside him quickly shushed him. “Those are tea leaves that they brought themselves.”
“Brother Lin, lower your voice. Don’t let them hear you. Otherwise, if you provoke them, it will be terrible.”
“What’s so amazing about them?” Brother Lin looked at the man beside him. “Aren’t they just three brats? Even if they’re the young masters of some family, they haven’t achieved much. It’s fine.”
Haha.

The man chuckled. “Brother Lin, I think you’re still underestimating Jiang City. Look, on the left-hand side of the main seat is Zheng Jianghao, also known as Young Master Zheng. He’s the son of the CEO of the Zheng Corporation. His family’s assets are worth one billion yuan.”
What?
These words made Brother Lin’s eyes widen. One billion!
This time, his arrogance was mostly suppressed.

The man continued, “The person on the right of the young man in the main seat is Jiang Shouheng, the son of Jiang Zhengyu from Cauldron Dragon Security. His family’s assets are worth close to two billion yuan!”
This!
Brother Lin’s arrogance was completely gone. Then, he looked at the young man in the white suit sitting at the head of the table. “What about the person in the middle? What’s his background?”
Since both of them were top young masters of Jiang City, the one in the middle couldn’t have a low status, right?
“The person in the middle is really powerful.”
“What’s his background?”
“Brother Lin, have you heard of Sacred Heaven Entertainment?”

“Of course. Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s market value is tens of billions. Moreover, recently, their show has become popular all over the country. How could I not know about them?” As Brother Lin spoke, his heart trembled. “Could this person be the son of one of Sacred Heaven’s upper echelons?”
The man shook his head gently. Brother Lin immediately heaved a sigh of relief.
However, in the next moment.
“This is Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. He holds 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares!”
Hiss!
A gasp sounded. Brother Lin could no longer remain calm. Even his hand holding the teacup gradually trembled!
Eighty percent of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares were worth tens of billions!
However, why was this person so young?!
He looked at Chen Yun with trembling eyes!
“So, Brother Lin, you still have to be careful with your words,” said the middle-aged man with a smile, making Brother Lin nod repeatedly.
Meanwhile, Su Yuncheng, who was wearing a pink suit, was naturally attracted by the fragrance and called the people beside him over.
“Young Master.”
“Is that Chen Yun from Sacred Heaven?”
“Yes, it is.”
Su Yuncheng stared at Chen Yun’s figure and nodded. His eyes gradually darkened.

It was him who brought Wang Menghan, whom he had not been able to pursue, out to sea to play. It was him who crippled his cousin. It was him who led Sacred Heaven to rise and completely suppress them.
What a character!
This was the person who had pushed the tip of the spear to the tip of his nose!
How could he not want to get rid of him?!
If Su Yuncheng had a gun now, he would definitely shoot Chen Yun. However, he did not have a gun now, so he could not do this. Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable.
However, it did not matter. There was still a long way to go!
Beside him, Kawakaze Kei looked at Su Yuncheng’s sinister eyes. “Young Master Su.”
“Mr. Kawakaze.” Su Yuncheng came back to his senses. “By the way, I heard that your family heirloom will appear in this auction. What’s going on?”

“That was decades ago,” said Kawakaze Kei while enunciating every word. The atmosphere was abnormal. “This treasure was among the war profits of our race when they invaded the Qing Dynasty decades ago. The treasures in the world belong to the virtuous. Since it belongs to my race, it naturally belongs to me too. This treasure was kept in my race for decades before it was stolen by a Chinese spy!”
“These Chinese people with dirty hands!” As Kawakaze Kei spoke, many people beside him looked over with anger in their eyes. However, Su Yuncheng glared at them, making them look away.
“Mr. Kawakaze, please continue.”
“When it appeared again, it was already in the Auction House and was brought here.”
Su Yuncheng nodded. “So that’s what happened. Mr. Kawakaze, don’t worry. My father has already instructed me. This time, I’ll definitely bring back what originally belonged to your family.”
“Mr. Su, thank you in advance.” Kawakaze Kei laughed out loud when he heard this.
Su Yuncheng waved his hand. “Mr. Kawakaze, your matter is the Su family’s matter. I will definitely spare no effort.”
“I just don’t know which item you’re talking about.”
As he spoke, Su Yuncheng opened the handbook for this auction.
“Mr. Su, there’s no need to flip through the pages. It’s on the last page.”
The last page?
That was the finale item!
Su Yuncheng flipped to the last page. When he saw what was on it, his eyes widened!
This was!
A jade seal!
A dragon and a tiger were carved on the front of the seal!
Meanwhile, there were engravings on the back!
It said, “Having received the Mandate from Heaven, may the Emperor lead a long and prosperous life.”

Su, thank you in advance.” Kawakaze Kei laughed out loud when he heard this.
Su Yuncheng waved his hand.
“Mr.
Kawakaze, your matter is the Su family’s matter.
I will definitely spare no effort.”
“I just don’t know which item you’re talking about.”
As he spoke, Su Yuncheng opened the handbook for this auction.
“Mr.
Su, there’s no need to flip through the pages.
It’s on the last page.”
The last page?
That was the finale item!
Su Yuncheng flipped to the last page.
When he saw what was on it, his eyes widened!
This was!
A jade seal!
A dragon and a tiger were carved on the front of the seal!
Meanwhile, there were engravings on the back!
It said, “Having received the Mandate from Heaven, may the Emperor lead a long and prosperous life.”

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Are You Comparing Wealth with Me?
paragraphs: A jade seal!
It was actually a jade seal!
“Mr. Su, if this matter succeeds, the Three Spirits Financial Group will remember the Su family’s kindness and definitely won’t forget it,” saud Kawakaze Kei slowly as he looked at Su Yuncheng.
“Of course. The old master at home has already instructed me to do my best.” Su Yuncheng closed the auction handbook.
On the other side, Chen Yun and the others drank tea and watched the auction begin.
“Lai Lai, do you like this jade pendant?”
“I like it.”
“Do you like this bottle?”
“I like it.”
“Do you like this golden cauldron?”
“I like it.”
Beside him, Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao listened to the conversation beside them. Their eyes widened. Jiang Shouheng’s hand that was holding the teacup began to tremble. “Brother Yun, you...”
Then, his face turned stiff. “Lai Lai, how can you take Brother Yun’s things? Don’t we have antiques at home too? Aren’t they enough for you to play with?”
“Sob... You’re being fierce to me again!”
Jiang Lai covered her small eyes with her two small hands. “Brother Yun only asked if Lai Lai liked it. Lai Lai doesn’t want Brother Yun’s things. Why are you so fierce to me?”
Chen Yun was speechless.
Jiang Shouheng was also speechless.
Only then did they remember that she was only a few years old. How would she know that if a man asked her whether she liked something and bought it, it would definitely be for her?
“Alright, alright, alright. I was wrong. I’ll make you delicious food tonight.” Jiang Shouheng rubbed Jiang Lai’s face.
“Brother, the potato slices you make are as hard as beef. Lai Lai won’t eat your cooking.” Jiang Lai turned around and threw herself into Chen Yun’s arms.
Zheng Jianghao, who was beside him, laughed out loud when he heard Jiang Lai’s words. “Brother Jiang, did you hand over your heaven-defying culinary skills to me when you came back?”
Jiang Shouheng glanced at him from the corner of his eye and did not say anything.
He was too ashamed to speak.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Jiang Lai in his arms. “Lai Lai, do you really not want it?”
“Dad said that we can’t take things from strangers.” Jiang Lai twiddled her fingers, looking pitiful.
“How about this? I’ll give you the jade pendant. The others are too heavy for you to carry, okay?” Chen Yun patted the little girl’s head.

Jiang Lai still shook his head. Jiang Shouheng, who was at the side, carried his little sister over. “Take this jade pendant, but be careful not to break it. Also, you have to repay Brother Yun in the future. Do you hear me?”
“But Lai Lai doesn’t have money ~” She looked at Chen Yun with her big eyes. “Brother Yun, why don’t Lai Lai give you a doll in exchange?”
This made the three of them laugh. Actually, it was quite good to tease the little girl.

Meanwhile, the auction was already coming to an end. At the beginning of the auction, as long as Chen Yun wanted it, almost no one dared to raise the price. Almost everyone present recognized Chen Yun.
What a joke! Who would dare to bid against Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment?!
Did they no longer want to stay in Jiang City?!
“Alright, everyone. Next is the last item of this auction.” The auctioneer on the stage reached for the red cloth beside him and gently pulled it down.
In the next moment, gasps of shock sounded.
This!
Looking at the pictures in the auction handbook and seeing the real thing were worlds apart!
At this moment, everyone looked at the white jade seal on the tray and their nerves tensed up.
Su Yuncheng narrowed his eyes. Kawakaze Kei was holding a short knife in his hand. His joints had turned white, showing how much strength he had used.
Meanwhile, Jiang Shouheng gasped, his eyes trembling.
Zheng Jianghao was the same. He put down the teacup in his hand, afraid that a tremble would make the tea drip and ruin his clothes.
As for Chen Yun, he straightened his body.
Everyone present was silent as they admired this royal treasure!
Many people knew that it was worth it to see such a priceless treasure in their lives!
“The bidding starts now. The starting price is 100 million.”
A hundred million!
The starting price alone was 100 million!
This made many people shrink back. After all, the threshold to come here was 50 million yuan.
However, how many people had hundreds of millions in assets?
For a moment, there was an awkward silence.
Then, Su Yuncheng gently raised the sign in his hand.
A hundred million!
His words shocked everyone present!
Everyone looked in Su Yuncheng’s direction, wanting to see who was so generous to actually dare to bid for this treasure.
When they saw that it was Su Yuncheng, everyone retracted their gazes. They naturally knew how rich Huaying Entertainment was.
Su Yuncheng was from the Su family, who stood behind Huaying Entertainment!
Originally, when Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao saw this item, they also wanted to fight for it. However, when they heard the starting price, the two of them gave up.
It was too expensive!
Just the starting price alone made them sigh.

Although their family’s assets were worth more than a billion yuan, most of their assets were properties. Moreover, they were only using the names of “rich second-generation heirs” and “young masters of Jiang City”.
The money in their hands could be counted on one hand. Their capital was in the hands of their parents and families.
They were not like Su Yuncheng, who had received the family’s instructions beforehand. Who dared to rashly attack now?
The entire venue fell silent again. After Su Yuncheng looked around, he had a teasing smile on his face.
In Jiang City, he still received some respect. Or rather, the Su family still received some respect.
Just based on the Su family’s reputation alone, this thing would belong to him!
Then, he looked at Kawakaze Kei. “Mr. Kawakaze, look. I’ve said it before. If our Su family makes a move, the item will be easy to obtain.”

Kawakaze Kei, who was at the side, also smiled brightly and nodded repeatedly. “Mr. Su, you and the Su family are both good friends of ours. You helped us take back our family heirloom. Our family will remember this affection.”
Meanwhile, the auctioneer saw that no one raised the price.
“A hundred million, going once.”
“A hundred million, going twice.”
“A hundred million...”
“Two hundred million.” This voice was not loud, but it set off a storm!
Two hundred million!
The price was simply doubled!
Everyone looked at Chen Yun, their eyes filled with shock. They could not believe what Chen Yun had said!
Meanwhile, Su Yuncheng suddenly slammed the table and looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with maliciousness!

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Lighting the Lamp!
paragraphs: It was not just Su Yuncheng!
Beside him, Kawakaze Kei, who was originally beaming with joy, instantly turned cold.
In the auction venue.
After a short silence, an intense discussion broke out.
“How generous. He simply increased the price by 100 million!”
“This is good. Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment versus Young Master Su Yuncheng of Huaying Entertainment.”
“I wonder if Young Master Su will raise the price again.” A child-like excitement appeared on a middle-aged man’s face. “Perhaps this jade seal can be sold for an astronomical price today.”

Sacred Heaven Entertainment and Huaying Entertainment were competitors to begin with. Coupled with Chen Yun’s previous actions, Su Yuncheng treated him as a thorn in his side. Needless to say, everyone understood these things.
“Brother Yun...” Jiang Shouheng looked at Chen Yun from the side, shocked speechless.
He simply increased the price by 100 million!
Just thinking about it made his heart ache!
What kind of foundation did he have to raise the price like this?!
At this moment, Chen Yun leaned back in his chair and picked up his teacup. He brushed away the mist and took a sip. Then, he turned to look at Su Yuncheng and the others not far away and sneered.
“I want this thing today.”
“Outsiders can’t take things that belong to China.”
These two sentences were spoken indifferently, indicating Chen Yun’s determination.

“Mr. Su, no matter what, you have to get this today. I’ll personally invest in it. With it, my status in the family can rise to another level. I can provide greater help to you and the Su family for you to obtain more wealth.”
“Alright!” Without any hesitation, Su Yuncheng immediately nodded and raised his hand. “I’d like to raise the price to 250 million.”
He increased the price again!
“Five hundred million.” Chen Yun put down the teacup in his hand and said 500 million as if he was throwing out 50 cents to buy a lollipop.
Five hundred million!
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire venue erupted again.
Everyone felt a chill in their hearts. They simply could not believe what they had heard!
Many of them did not even have 500 million yuan in assets!
As for Chen Yun, he spent 500 million yuan with a wave of his hand!
“You!”
Su Yuncheng was furious. He looked at Chen Yun and clenched his fists.
Beside Chen Yun, Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao were also extremely shocked. Five hundred million!
It was equivalent to one-third of the assets of their family!

Apart from being shocked, they immediately smiled. The young master of Huaying Entertainment, Su Yuncheng, could be said to be the number one young master in Jiang City. He was also an enemy force, so he had suppressed them a lot. Now that Chen Yun had suppressed Su Yuncheng, how could they not be happy?
Just as Su Yuncheng was about to speak, Chen Yun knocked on the table.
Then, he pointed at the item beside the waiter not far away.
The waiter looked at the thing beside him and his body suddenly trembled.
Chen Yun’s actions were also seen by everyone present. They looked at the waiter and saw a golden lamp beside him.
It was exquisitely carved and incomparably dazzling.
However, the local tycoons in Jiang City knew what this lamp meant!
He wanted to light the lamp!
When these words appeared in everyone’s hearts, everyone’s bodies trembled!
The meaning of these words was very simple!
He was saying that he definitely had to get this item!
They could raise the price of this auction as much as they wanted! He would pay for everything!
A tycoon from the outer city looked at the person beside him. “Brother, what does this mean?”
“It’s very simple. We can raise the price of this jade seal for this round. No matter how much we increase the price, Director Chen will buy it at an additional price!”
“This is called lighting the lamp!”
“How ruthless!” The rich man from the outer city rubbed his hands. “Why don’t I try raising the price too?”
Hahahaha!
The man beside him laughed and stood up. “Brother Zhang, I advise you not to.”

“The action of lighting the lamp was a rule in Jiang City during the dynasty. At that time, if you couldn’t afford to pay for the auction item, one of your hands or legs would be cut off. But now, hmph.”
“First, see who dares to compete with Director Chen.”
“Second, the current price has reached 500 million. You can increase the price, but if Director Chen extinguishes the lamp, you’ll have to fork out 500 million.”
“In the past, during the dynasty, auction houses had the right to break people’s limbs. But now, hehe, go and ask Sotheby’s Auction House if they dare to touch a billionaire!”

“Also, try and see if you can walk out of Jiang City if you dare to cheat Director Chen.” As the man spoke, he turned around and left. “Brother Zhang, let’s end our cooperation here. You’re on your own.”
As soon as the man said this, Brother Zhang was stunned on the spot. Many people beside him looked at him and sneered.
Not far away, Jiang Shouheng nodded at him and waved to the side. A few burly men in black immediately walked over.
This action frightened Brother Zhang so much that his face turned pale.
He did not dare to say another word!
He was like a frightened quail. If there was a crack in the ground here, he would definitely hide inside.
No one present dared to say anything else.
They could tell that this was a battle between Su Yuncheng and Chen Yun. It was a battle between Huaying and Sacred Heaven!
If they interfered, they would be standing opposite the Su family and Sacred Heaven at the same time!
That would be asking for death!

Meanwhile, the waiter brought the golden lamp over. Chen Yun waved his hand at Jiang Shouheng, who tacitly understood Chen Yun. Then, Jiang Shouheng took out his Zippo lighter that cost more than ten thousand yuan.
Chen Yun lit up a small fire.
The small fire burned the air, but in everyone’s eyes, it was burning money!
Even Su Yuncheng looked at the golden lamp and the corners of his mouth twitched.
Good, Director Chen!
How bold!
He actually dared to light the lamp!
He lit the lamp with a starting price of 500 million!
This was unprecedented!
At this moment, everyone was looking at Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei.
“Mr. Su.” Kawakaze Kei looked at Su Yuncheng. “Mr. Su, help me get this thing. When I return to the Three Spirits Headquarters, it will be a great merit. The Su family will definitely benefit!”
“Mr. Su, why are you still hesitating?!”
At this moment, Su Yuncheng was being watched by dozens of people. He looked at the lamp and narrowed his eyes.
He clenched his fists.
Kawakaze Kei did not know the rules of Jiang City, but he knew that Chen Yun was determined to get this thing today!
Moreover, he had already lit up the lamp. The starting price was 500 million yuan!
He did not dare to accept it!
He could not accept it either!
He couldn’t afford it!
The Su family behind him could not afford it either!
“Mr. Su!”
Kawakaze Kei interrogated him again, but Su Yuncheng lowered his head and picked up the lid of the teacup.
He gently closed it.
Everyone knew that this battle had come to an end!

chapters.title: Chapter 61: How Dare Such a Small Place Bear the Mandate from Heaven!
paragraphs: “Five hundred million, going once!”
“Five hundred million, going twice!”
“Five hundred million, going thrice!”
“Sold!”
With the auctioneer’s last sentence, this peerless treasure landed in Chen Yun’s hands.
The waiter came to Chen Yun from behind. “Hello, Sir. You bought a total of 11 auction items. The total value is 850 million.”
“Yes, here’s my card.”

“Alright, we’ll settle it for you immediately.” Just as the waiter turned around, Chen Yun stopped her and said, “Give me the jade seal and jade pendant. I’ll give you an address for the other things. Just send them to me directly.”
“Yes, sir.”
A moment later, a wooden box made of Hainan rosewood was brought over and placed on Chen Yun’s table. For a moment, Jiang Shouheng and Tan Zekun leaned over.
Jiang Lai also stuck his head out with a serious and curious expression.

After opening it, the jade seal was safely placed inside. Chen Yun looked at the jade seal and reached out to touch it. It was as if he was touching the wheel of history and feeling the rise and fall of life and death. A different emotion appeared in his heart.
Jiang Lai also wanted to touch it, but she was grabbed by Jiang Shouheng.
That was something worth 500 million!
It could be said to be one of the most precious treasures in China!
If it was damaged, it would be terrible!
Jiang Lai pouted when he saw his brother holding his hand.

Pa!

“How dare such a small place bear the Mandate from Heaven? You’re asking for death!”
You!

Everyone was shocked!
