paragraphs: The situation instantly became tense!
Everyone’s breathing tightened as they looked at the scene in front of them. They did not expect Chen Yun to fly into a rage and attack directly!
It was really satisfying!

Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao protected Chen Yun. The two of them strangled the two men’s necks. The burly men beside Jiang Shouheng also followed closely and surrounded Su Yuncheng and the others.

At this moment, Kawakaze Kei covered his face and felt the burning pain. Then, when he heard Chen Yun’s words, his eyes suddenly darkened. He looked at Chen Yun and reached for the short knife beside him!
Whoosh!
A cold light flickered on everyone’s faces, causing their hearts to turn cold.
Kawakaze Kei was actually going to use his blade!
“How dare you!” Jiang Shouheng looked at Kawakaze Kei. His eyes widened as he shouted angrily.
However, Kawakaze Kei did not listen to him. He looked at Chen Yun in front of him and slashed out with the short knife in his hand.
“Brother Yun!”
Zheng Jianghao also shouted. He wanted to go over and help Chen Yun, but it was too late.
Everyone’s hearts tightened. Kawakaze Kei’s blade was aimed at Chen Yun’s neck. If it landed, blood would definitely splatter!
“Ah!”
Many ladies exclaimed and closed their eyes.
Some men also instantly frowned, unable to bear to watch the next scene.
However, the blade drew an arc in the air before stopping abruptly.
This!
What was going on?!
They looked over!
They were all shocked!
Chen Yun was holding a pistol and pointing it at Kawakaze Kei’s glabella!
It was a gun!
Seeing the thing in Chen Yun’s hand, everyone’s hearts trembled!
If Chen Yun had not pointed his gun at Kawakaze Kei, they would probably have fled in all directions!
After all, the richer one was, the more they cherished their lives.
“Chen Yun has taken out a gun!”
“It’s a real gun, right?”
“Of course. Look, it’s even shining with a metallic luster under the sunlight!”
Everyone discussed and looked at Chen Yun.
At this moment, Kawakaze Kei looked at the black muzzle of the gun and was shocked. His body began to tremble.
He felt as if a basin of ice water had been poured over his head, and his entire body trembled.
Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao were also shocked when they saw this scene. The bodyguards behind quickly went forward and carried Jiang Lai away.
At this moment, Chen Yun was holding the jade seal in one hand.
With his other hand, he held a gun diagonally and pressed it against Kawakaze Kei’s head.
“You can understand Chinese, right?” The corners of Chen Yun’s mouth curled into a cold smile. “I’ll give you a chance now. Tell me, who does this thing belong to?”
“I’ll give you three seconds. Listen carefully. Just three seconds.”
“One!” Chen Yun suddenly shouted loudly and dragged out his voice, as if he wanted to make everyone’s hearts jump.
“Two!” The second sound was crisp and urgent, as if the executioner had already raised the knife in his hand.
Kawakaze Kei looked at Chen Yun in front of him. His face was pale, and his eyes were filled with fear.
He had never thought that there would be a day when someone would point a pistol at him.
Chen Yun was about to say “three” when Kawakaze Kei took a deep breath. “It belongs to China!”
“It belongs to China!”
“It’s from China!”
Her trembling voice was already filled with tears.
Bang! Bang!
Two gunshots suddenly sounded. Everyone subconsciously squatted down and held their heads. Even Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao’s eyelids twitched in panic.
When they came back to their senses, they saw Kawakaze Kei’s legs being pierced by bullets. Blood splattered on the ground!
The next moment, Kawakaze Kei collapsed to the ground and wailed in pain!
“Let me make this clear to you today. From now on, if you dare to insult China and take our country’s treasure, I’ll cripple you every time I see you!”
“I’m a person who makes it clear to prevent fights in the future. Remember this!”
With that, Chen Yun fired again and the bullet pierced through his right shoulder. Then, he kicked Kawakaze Kei away from the road in front of him.
“Let’s go.” Chen Yun looked at the two people beside him. “Don’t let him ruin the taste of our meal.”
As soon as she said this, everyone present was shocked. He said, “Don’t let him ruin the taste of our meal.”
What kind of person could say such a thing?!
He had just fired three shots, and now he was going to eat as if nothing had happened?
Moreover, he fired decisively and fiercely. He was definitely an experienced shooter!
“Director Chen!”
Chen Yun took three steps forward. After brushing past Su Yuncheng, a voice sounded from behind him.
Chen Yun turned around and looked at Su Yuncheng.
At this moment, Su Yuncheng’s face was extremely gloomy. His eyes were even a little bloodshot. At this moment, he looked at Chen Yun and smiled sinisterly.

“Director Chen, what an imposing manner! How dare you hit someone in the East Mountain Villa! How dare you fire a gun in the East Mountain Villa! Do you still want to leave now? Do you think that the East Mountain Villa is a place where you can come and go as you please?!”
These words made many people frown.
“Young Master Su is right. It’s not appropriate for Director Chen to take out his gun here. Although the higher-ups are tight-lipped and won’t spread the news, but...”
“But what?” Someone beside him looked at him and quickly asked.
“Don’t forget where we are. This is Fourth Master Feng’s East Mountain Villa, Fourth Master Feng’s territory. No one dares to touch this place, let alone use a gun.”
Fourth Master Feng!

The owner of the East Mountain Villa was an iron-blooded person. He was nearly 60 years old, but his personality was still like a raging fire. One of the few people in Jiang City who could not be provoked was Fourth Master Feng!

Not only was he rich in assets, but he also occupied the East Mountain Villa and had a wide network. He had many powerful subordinates. He had made a name for himself in Jiang City from the beginning!
When some people who did not understand heard these words, their mouths widened. They still did not know that the owner of the East Mountain Villa was a ruthless person who was elusive.

They finally understood what Su Yuncheng meant. Chen Yun had attacked here and crippled Kawakaze Kei. However, this was the territory of another person. How could Chen Yun cause trouble in the territory of such a big shot?!

“Looks like this is Director Chen’s first time at the East Mountain Villa. You don’t know the rules.” The corners of Su Yuncheng’s mouth curled up, and his eyes were sinister. “Last time, CEO Qian of Jiang City, a person with billions of assets, caused trouble at the East Mountain Villa. One of his legs was broken and he was thrown out.”
“I wonder whether they want Director Chen’s arm or leg today!”

He said, “Don’t let him ruin the taste of our meal.”
What kind of person could say such a thing?!
He had just fired three shots, and now he was going to eat as if nothing had happened?
Moreover, he fired decisively and fiercely.
He was definitely an experienced shooter!
“Director Chen!”
Chen Yun took three steps forward.
After brushing past Su Yuncheng, a voice sounded from behind him.
Chen Yun turned around and looked at Su Yuncheng.
At this moment, Su Yuncheng’s face was extremely gloomy.
His eyes were even a little bloodshot.
At this moment, he looked at Chen Yun and smiled sinisterly.
“Director Chen, what an imposing manner!
How dare you hit someone in the East Mountain Villa!
How dare you fire a gun in the East Mountain Villa!
Do you still want to leave now?
Do you think that the East Mountain Villa is a place where you can come and go as you please?!”
These words made many people frown.
“Young Master Su is right.
It’s not appropriate for Director Chen to take out his gun here.
Although the higher-ups are tight-lipped and won’t spread the news, but...”
“But what?” Someone beside him looked at him and quickly asked.
“Don’t forget where we are.
This is Fourth Master Feng’s East Mountain Villa, Fourth Master Feng’s territory.
No one dares to touch this place, let alone use a gun.”
Fourth Master Feng!
The owner of the East Mountain Villa was an iron-blooded person.
He was nearly 60 years old, but his personality was still like a raging fire.
One of the few people in Jiang City who could not be provoked was Fourth Master Feng!
Not only was he rich in assets, but he also occupied the East Mountain Villa and had a wide network.
He had many powerful subordinates.
He had made a name for himself in Jiang City from the beginning!
When some people who did not understand heard these words, their mouths widened.
They still did not know that the owner of the East Mountain Villa was a ruthless person who was elusive.
They finally understood what Su Yuncheng meant.
Chen Yun had attacked here and crippled Kawakaze Kei.
However, this was the territory of another person.
How could Chen Yun cause trouble in the territory of such a big shot?!
“Looks like this is Director Chen’s first time at the East Mountain Villa.
You don’t know the rules.” The corners of Su Yuncheng’s mouth curled up, and his eyes were sinister.
“Last time, CEO Qian of Jiang City, a person with billions of assets, caused trouble at the East Mountain Villa.
One of his legs was broken and he was thrown out.”
“I wonder whether they want Director Chen’s arm or leg today!”

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Hello, Director Chen!
paragraphs: Did they want his arms or feet?!

As soon as Su Yuncheng said this, everyone looked at Chen Yun. After hearing Su Yuncheng’s words and listening to Fourth Master Feng’s deeds, they naturally knew that if Fourth Master Feng found out about today’s matter, it would definitely not end well.
Rules were rules!
The people of Jiang City were especially law-abiding!
Su Yuncheng looked at Chen Yun. “Moreover! Director Chen! Do you know who you shot just now?!”

“I’m not afraid to tell you the truth! That’s the person-in-charge of the Three Spirits Financial Group in Jiangbei! If you touch him, you’ll be slapping the face of the Three Spirits Financial Group. In addition, you took the jade seal. Let’s see how you explain it to Three Spirits Financial Group!”
“Even if you’re the Chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, you’re not qualified enough!”
With these few words, everyone broke out in cold sweat.
It was the Three Spirits Financial Group!
That was a colossus!
When Chen Yun heard Su Yuncheng’s words, the corners of his mouth curled into a cold smile. “Explain? How dare they ask for an explanation from me!”
“I’ll wait here. If they dare to come, I’ll be waiting.”
He was not afraid at all!
In the next moment, many people retreated and looked over. A bald man quickly walked over with a group of men in black.
“Who is this?!”
“Why are they charging straight at us?! What are they doing?!”
“It’s obvious that he’s not from the upper echelons of Jiang City. He’s filled with hostility.”
Many people looked at the bald man with disdain.
Wang Bingyu also snorted softly. “Why would such a vulgar person come to the East Mountain Villa?”
However, beside her, her father quickly covered her mouth.
“Dad, what are you doing?! You’re ruining my makeup!”
Wang Bingyu stomped her feet in anger, only to see her father’s serious expression and pale face.
“You can’t spout nonsense! Do you know who this is?!”
“Who is this?” Wang Bingyu curled her lips and asked disdainfully.
After all, her dressing and actions had nothing to do with elegance. Those who didn’t know better would think that she was a hooligan on the streets.

“This is Sun Wenkai, Master Kai! He’s the person who is taking care of the East Mountain Villa for Fourth Master Feng. CEO Qian, whom Su Yuncheng mentioned previously, had his limbs broken by him! Tell me, were you spouting nonsense?!”
These words made Wang Bingyu’s heart tremble. She simply couldn’t believe what she had heard. Was this person’s background actually so great?
She had almost provoked a big shot.
The other party was someone who even dared to break the legs of a billionaire. She was just a little girl. If she provoked the other party, she did not know what the other party would do.
Many people were also informed of the bald man’s identity by the people beside them. They immediately avoided him. Of course, they also knew why he was here.
At this moment, Sun Wenkai looked at everyone. “Who was causing trouble just now?!”
“Who used a gun?!”
These two sentences immediately made the scene unparalleled. After all, Sun Wenkai’s aura was too terrifying.

Now, Sun Wenkai was also incomparably angry. The owner of the East Mountain Villa had changed today. He originally wanted to perform in front of his new owner and serve him well, but he did not expect such a mess to happen.
If the new owner happened to see this, he would think that he was not managing the East Mountain Villa well!
At that time, even he would have to scram!
At this moment, he saw Kawakaze Kei lying in a pool of blood and quickly walked up. When he saw the short knife in his hand, his eyes suddenly darkened.
He walked up and grabbed Kawakaze Kei’s collar, pulling him up. “How dare you use a knife in the East Mountain Villa!”
These words made Kawakaze Kei, who was already in pain, tremble even more. “It’s... it’s him. He shot me! Look!”
Sun Wenkai looked at Kawakaze Kei, then at the injuries on his face and body. He simply threw him onto the ground and looked in the direction he was pointing.
The crowd dispersed, revealing a few young men.
Su Yuncheng dodged back and pointed at Chen Yun. “Master Kai, it’s him. He’s the one who shot him!”
Sun Wenkai looked at Chen Yun and recalled the information he had seen previously. His heart trembled as he led his men forward.
“It’s over! Today’s matter can’t be settled peacefully.”
“Master Kai is inexplicably angry today. Director Chen has bumped into a gun.”
“You really know no fear when you cause trouble in someone else’s territory.”

Many people talked spiritedly. Although Chen Yun was the Chairman of Sacred Heaven, he was currently in the East Mountain Villa. If he caused trouble in the East Mountain Villa, he would definitely not have a good ending!
Sighs sounded repeatedly. It seemed that Chen Yun would not be able to escape today.
At this moment, the corners of Su Yuncheng’s mouth curled up into a gloating smile. He watched from the sidelines.

When Jiang Shouheng saw Sun Wenkai coming over, he quickly ran forward and smiled apologetically. “Master Kai, do you still remember me? I’m Jiang Shouheng, and my father is Jiang Zhengyu. Look at what happened today...”
“Move aside!”
Sun Wenkai simply pushed Jiang Shouheng away and walked forward.
When the others saw this scene, the corners of their mouths twitched. Even Jiang Shouheng was not useful.
It seemed like Director Chen was in trouble today.
At the side, Su Yuncheng had a sinister smile on his face.
He was prepared to watch the development of the matter.
Sun Wenkai walked up to Chen Yun and looked at him. Just as everyone thought that Sun Wenkai was going to get someone to capture Chen Yun!
Instead, his body bent down and he bowed 90 degrees!
“Hello, Director Chen!”
Behind him, the group of burly men in black also bowed!
“Hello, Director Chen!”
Their voices shook the heavens!
Everyone was shocked!
This!
What did this mean?!
This was the manager of East Mountain Villa, Master Sun Wenkai!
Why was he bowing 90 degrees to Chen Yun?!
It was simply shocking!

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Throw Them Out!
paragraphs: This!
Everyone present was stunned by the scene in front of them.
They had thought of ten thousand outcomes, but they did not expect such an outcome!
Who was Sun Wenkai?!
He was Fourth Master Feng’s favorite!
He was the manager of the East Mountain Villa!
At the same time, he was also a ruthless person!
However, such a ruthless person bowed to Chen Yun in front of everyone!
He looked like a servant!
“What’s going on?”
“This is Master Sun Wenkai, right? Why is he bowing to Chen Yun?”
“Just now, he was still angry and looked like he would kill anyone in his way. Why is he suddenly afraid now?”
“Could it be that Director Chen is related to Fourth Master Feng?”
Everyone spoke one after another. In the end, they confirmed that Chen Yun should be Fourth Master Feng’s guest. Otherwise, the current situation could definitely not be explained.
Beside Chen Yun, Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao also looked at Sun Wenkai and were at a loss. Even Su Yuncheng, who was opposite them, was also furious. He could not believe what he was seeing.
“Master Kai, what are you doing? He’s the one who caused trouble here. Not only did he hit someone, but he even used a gun here.” Su Yuncheng complained to Sun Wenkai.
However, Sun Wenkai sneered and did not say anything.
Chen Yun looked at Su Yuncheng and shook his head. A teasing smile appeared on his lips. “Throw him and the knife-wielding person over there out.”
Throw them out!
Instantly, everyone looked at Chen Yun.
Chen Yun’s actions were a ruthless slap to the Su family’s face!
He simply asked someone to throw the young master of the Su family out!

If the Su family knew about this, they would probably not let the matter rest. If he publicly threw Su Yuncheng out like this, the blow to Su Yuncheng and the entire Su family would be even more violent than breaking Su Yuncheng’s legs in private!
This move was too ruthless!
“How dare you!” Su Yuncheng’s eyes widened. “Mr. Chen! This is the East Mountain Villa, Fourth Master Feng’s territory. Who do you think you are?! How dare you shout here and order that!”
“Master Kai, he’s looking down on Fourth Master Feng! Aren’t you going to attack?!”
Haha.
At the side, Sun Wenkai looked at Su Yuncheng and sneered. “The East Mountain Villa has changed owners today!”
“Director Chen, from today onwards, you will be the new owner of the East Mountain Villa!”
“Tell me, who is he?!”
The East Mountain Villa had changed owners today!
This!
When everyone heard Sun Wenkai’s words, their eyes widened and they gasped in shock. They could not believe what they had heard. This was too terrifying!
Chen Yun had actually bought the East Mountain Villa from Fourth Master Feng!
What kind of wealth was this?!
What kind of background was this?!
Coupled with the fact that Chen Yun had bought 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares from the Lu family previously, everyone looked at Chen Yun again. Which big family in China was Chen Yun from?

They did not doubt Chen Yun’s identity as the young master of a top family in China at all. It was also because of his background that he could take down Sacred Heaven Entertainment and the East Mountain Villa at the age of 20!
Jiang City was about to change!
Everyone’s hearts trembled as they looked at Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao enviously.
It was said that a good bird chose a tree to nest in. Without a doubt, these two people were on the right side!
“What are you waiting for?! Didn’t you hear Director Chen?!” Sun Wenkai shouted. The burly men behind him immediately stood up and walked towards Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei.
No matter how the two of them struggled, their arms could not win against the thighs of the burly men. In the end, they were carried out of the inner courtyard.
“Ah! Let go of me!”
“I’m the young master of the Su family! The young master of Huaying Entertainment! Do you want to die?!”
“You guys are a bunch of animals!”
Su Yuncheng shouted, attracting too many gazes.
“Oh my god, who is that?” Wang Yuanyuan looked at Su Yuncheng and widened her eyes. “Is that Young Master Su Yuncheng? Why is he being carried out?”
At this moment, Su Yuncheng’s clothes were in a mess. He was far from the high-spirited and insufferably arrogant person he was when he first entered!
“What exactly happened inside? Why is Young Master Su being carried out?”
“I don’t know. We have to ask the people from the inner courtyard about what happened later.”
Many people discussed this matter, making Su Yuncheng’s heart completely die.
He know that he would become the laughing stock of the upper echelons of Jiang City after today!
The Su family would also become the laughing stock of the entire upper echelons of Jiang City!
Meanwhile, Kawakaze Kei was not much better than Su Yuncheng!
He was not only embarrassed now!
If he arrived at the hospital any later, he might lose his life!
Plop.
Plop.

Two dull sounds were heard as the two of them were thrown out of the East Mountain Villa. Everyone looked at them. Although they only took a glance before turning their heads, many people had ridicule in their eyes.
The faces of the two people were ashen. They were completely embarrassed!
At this moment, in the inner courtyard of the East Mountain Villa, Sun Wenkai looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, I was late. Please punish me.”

“You’re not late. It’s fine. I’ll still leave the entire East Mountain Villa to you, but you don’t have to rent it out anymore.” Chen Yun waved his hand and said, making Sun Wenkai’s heart skip a beat. He quickly nodded. “Thank you for your trust, Director Chen. I’ll definitely...”
Sun Wenkai patted his chest and promised. Chen Yun did not listen much. Things had to be done, not just put in words.
“Brother, why did you take me away just now?”
Jiang Lai ran over and hugged Jiang Shouheng’s leg.
“Brother, did you fight again? I’m going to tell Dad.”
“Don’t!” When Jiang Shouheng heard this, his scalp went numb. “My little ancestor, as long as you don’t tell Dad, I’ll buy your dessert for a month. I’ll buy you whatever you want to eat.”
“Okay~ Thank you, Brother.”
Jiang Shouheng was speechless. Extortion! This was blatant extortion!
“Let’s go eat.” Chen Yun’s mood was not ruined as he walked out.
The next moment, he stopped in his tracks.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
This!
This check-in was different from usual! This was because after completing the previous additional mission, he would obtain a skill!
Chen Yun carefully pressed the check-in button!
[Check-in successful!]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the skill: Eye of Truth!]
[The Eye of Truth skill consumes spending points. One hundred million spending points can be exchanged for two minutes of the Eye of Truth skill.]
[After activating the skill, you can possess complete x-ray vision, perform decomposition, numerical analysis, prediction...]
Looking at the screen, Chen Yun smiled.
It just so happened that he had a lot of spending points now.
He used his skill!
Two minutes!
In an instant, Chen Yun felt his eyes light up.
“Hm? This beauty is amazing. She went from B to 36D!”
“This is also amazing. Based on the composition analysis, it’s actually silicone. Oh my god, how much did she inject? She injected two buckets of silicone. She’s really ruthless to herself.”
At the same time, Chen Yun looked at everyone’s actions. He decomposed their strength and speed, predicting their next actions.
The Eye of Truth skill was extremely terrifying!
The next moment, he looked at the jade seal and his eyes widened!
This!
Inside the jade seal!
There was actually a pearl that emitted a faint green light!

At the same time, Chen Yun looked at everyone’s actions.
He decomposed their strength and speed, predicting their next actions.
The Eye of Truth skill was extremely terrifying!
The next moment, he looked at the jade seal and his eyes widened!
This!
Inside the jade seal!
There was actually a pearl that emitted a faint green light!

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Are You Treating This As a Big Deal
paragraphs: This pearl!
Chen Yun looked at the bead and his eyes widened.
How did this pearl enter the jade seal?
This jade seal should be carved from an entire piece of jade.
For a moment, Chen Yun began to admire his ancestor’s skill.
At the same time, he was very curious about the origin of this pearl.
A thought suddenly flashed through Chen Yun’s mind.
When the warlords blew up the imperial mausoleum, the Empress Dowager must have had a pearl like this in her mouth.
Legend had it that the pearl emitted a dark green cold light. If it was placed in one’s mouth, it could ensure that the corpse would not rot.
It was also because of this that when the warlords opened the imperial mausoleum, they saw that the Empress Dowager was still very lifelike. She was simply like a living person, scaring them.
After taking out the night-luminescent pearl, the corpse began to rot.
If that was the case, the value of this treasure was another matter.
Two truly priceless treasures! It was enough to cause a storm of blood!
Chen Yun put away the jade seal in his hand and brought it with him. He hugged Jiang Lai with his other hand. “Let’s go eat.”
The few of them went out together, leaving Sun Wenkai and the shocked upper echelons of Jiang City behind.

They looked at Sun Wenkai’s respectful expression and then at the figures of Chen Yun and the others. They immediately knew that what happened today might spread, but they could not let it spread from their mouths.
Otherwise, with Director Chen’s sharp personality, he would definitely not let go of the person who caused trouble for him.
Meanwhile, the people from the outer courtyard gradually dispersed. Chen Yun and the others did not have a large number of people following them, so they did not attract much attention.
However, a few pairs of eyes were fixed on them.
“Yuanyuan, look, Chen Yun is over there.” Shu Fan tugged at Wang Yuanyuan’s clothes beside him and looked to the other side.
Beside him, Wang Zhouning and Ye Xinyu came over. Ye Xinyu also looked over. “It’s really Chen Yun. How did he enter the East Mountain Villa?”
“A friend must have brought him in.”
“How else could he have come in?”
The young men and women beside her chimed in. Ye Xinyu shrugged. “What powerful friends can he have? What are you guys thinking?”

Ye Xinyu looked at Chen Yun and snorted coldly. She had originally planned to treat Chen Yun to a meal with Wang Yuanyuan and the others the day before yesterday as a form of repayment. However, it seemed like he wanted to do it the hard way. In her heart, Chen Yun was the one who did not come. It was not that she did not want to treat him. Therefore, even if the two sides were even, she naturally did not have a good impression of Chen Yun now. Moreover, she also felt a sense of disgust that he would refute their dignity.
However, the moment she said this, Wang Zhouning’s eyes trembled. “You can eat whatever you want, but you can’t spout nonsense!”
His voice was so loud that the young men and women beside him were shocked.
Even Ye Xinyu looked at Wang Zhouning. “How dare you shout at me!”
“Do you know who that is?!” Wang Zhouning raised his chin. “Did you see the person in the navy suit beside Chen Yun?!”
“That’s Zheng Jianghao, the eldest son of the CEO of the Zheng Corporation. His family is worth more than a billion yuan!”

“Yesterday, I asked you to wait outside. I went in to take a look myself and happened to see him drag Tan Zekun out! Even a young master like Tan Zekun was beaten up like this when he caused trouble in his own territory. Who do you think you are? How dare you speak?”

This sentence made everyone shut up. They stayed at the door yesterday and did not leave, so they naturally saw what happened after that. Tan Zekun was sent to the hospital like a dead dog. It was unknown if he was dead or alive.
In their opinion, only someone like Zheng Jianghao could restrain such a profligate young master.
Ye Xinyu immediately shut her mouth, her eyes trembling. If Young Master Zheng Jianghao heard her words, she would probably not have a good ending.
Beside him, Shu Fan and Wang Yuanyuan were also shocked.
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun, who was standing side by side with Zheng Jianghao while chatting and laughing. She was shocked and immediately understood.

It was no wonder that Chen Yun was able to retreat unscathed the day before yesterday after angering Tan Zekun. It turned out that he had relations with Zheng Jianghao. Moreover, from the looks of it, their relationship was not shallow!
“Is this why you had the confidence to resist Tan Zekun?” Wang Yuanyuan thought to herself, but she shook her head. “However, how can the other party really treat you as his peer?”
“You relied on your skills to curry favor with these people. In the end, you are just a pawn and will become the pawn of these people’s horses.”
Thinking of this, Wang Yuanyuan could not help but shake her head.
Beside her, Wang Zhouning looked at the young man on the other side of Chen Yun and frowned. “Who’s this person beside this kid? I think I’ve seen him somewhere, but I can’t remember.”
“We don’t know him either.”
Ye Xinyu looked at Jiang Shouheng’s respectful expression and sneered, “I’m afraid he’s the same character as Chen Yun. Forget it, let’s go back.”
At noon, the few of them gathered in East Sea City and had a big meal there. When they saw the final bill, even Jiang Shouheng and Zheng Jianghao were stunned.
The few of them had spent more than a million yuan on this meal!
The average person spent more than 300,000 yuan!
If this cost per person was shown on Dianping or Meituan1, no one would be interested in East Sea City.
After eating and drinking their fill, Jiang Shouheng arranged for two people to send Chen Yun back and drive Chen Yun’s Ferrari back.
At night, after Chen Yun slept, he woke up and realized that the antiques had been shipped over.

At this moment, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, the two little girls, were sitting on the ground and looking at the nine antiques in front of them. Their eyes were shining and their faces were red, especially Chen Mengmeng. At this moment, she touched the golden cauldron, but she retracted it as if it was hot.
If it was damaged, she would not be able to take the blame.
“The things are here.” Chen Yun walked down from the second floor and looked at the things placed in the boxes in front of him. He grabbed a Ming Dynasty porcelain plate and rubbed it in his hand.
“Brother! How could you! Oh my god!”
This shocked Chen Yun. “What are you doing!”
Chen Mengmeng leaned in front of Chen Yun and took the porcelain plate from him with both hands. Then, she carefully carried it back to the box as if she was taking care of a baby.
“These are all antiques, right? Aren’t you afraid of breaking them?”
“This didn’t cost much.” Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng and couldn’t help but laugh.
“How much did it cost?” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun and blinked. Then, she looked at the porcelain plate. Could it be that these were not antiques? Had they been bought from a street stall?
Even Han Xue relaxed.
“Let me think. This porcelain plate doesn’t cost much. It only cost 40 million yuan.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Han Xue was also speechless.
It only cost 40 million yuan?
This was good!
This was the essence of showing off subconsciously!
Looking at the two of them’s disdainful gazes, Chen Yun frowned. “Why are you looking at me like that?”
“Are you treating something worth 40 million as a big deal?” Chen Yun sneered and pinched Chen Mengmeng’s face.
“Then a few days ago, why did you two little girls pour water and arrange flowers in my four blue-and-white porcelain vases worth 100 million yuan each?”
The expressions on Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s faces gradually froze.
What?
Those four porcelain vases!
Were they blue-and-white porcelain vases?
Why did he just leave them there?!

The two of them immediately felt dizzy and could not take it anymore. They turned around and looked at the things in the room. They even began to wonder if the bowls they usually used to eat from were also antiques.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: The Transformed Xiao Xin
paragraphs: Chen Yun looked at the two little girls’ gazes and could not help but smile. “Come, help me tidy up these antiques and see where they should be placed.”
“Let’s place this golden cauldron on the counter opposite the door.” Chen Yun picked up the golden cauldron.
Oh, it was really not light, but it was no wonder.
Although this golden cauldron was not big, gold was very dense.
A porcelain plate, a jade artifact...
Chen Yun also found them a home.
In the end, Chen Yun took out a wooden box.
Oh?

Chen Mengmeng looked at the exquisite wooden box. In comparison, when the other antiques were shipped over, although the packages were also exquisite, the wooden materials used were far inferior to this.
“What’s in this?” The two little girls finished their work and came over.
Chen Yun gently opened the box, revealing the jade seal inside.
In an instant, the two little girls could not help but gasp. Their eyes widened. “A jade, jade, jade... jade seal!”
“Brother, where did you get this thing?!”
“Don’t be nervous. I got it from the auction.” Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng’s head. “Tell me, where should I put this thing?”
“Put it in your study.”
Chen Mengmeng reached out and touched the jade seal. Han Xue also could not help but reach out and touch it with a satisfied expression, as if her entire life had meaning.
Chen Yun followed their suggestion. He held the jade seal with both hands and placed it on the desk. However, he did not open it and still placed it in the box.
He turned around and looked at the yearning gazes of the two of them. He chuckled softly. They had only seen this jade seal, but they did not know that there was another treasure in this jade seal!
If the identity of the pearl was really as Chen Yun had thought.
The value of these two treasures could not be measured!
One of the treasures was proof of the Son of Heaven. It was a national treasure!
The other was a rare treasure in the world which ensured that one did not rot after death!
After placing the treasures, the entire villa’s style changed again.
What a joke!
Who had ever seen a pure golden cauldron placed at the entrance the moment they entered a house?!

After cleaning up, the three of them rested for a while. During this period, Chen Mengmeng used her phone to project a live-stream on the television that occupied a wall. Then, she watched the live-stream with interest.

Xiao Xin was in the live-stream. With her witty commentary and the Full of Luck skill she had rubbed off from Chen Yun, it was as if she had an omniscient view. It was like she had obtained the script in advance.
“Brother, look quickly. This young lady is very powerful!”
“She already has tens of millions of fans online!”
“It would be great if I had her abilities some day.” Chen Mengmeng thought. Chen Yun smiled and didn’t say anything.
After a while, his phone rang. It was from Xiao Xin.
Although she was a commentator on Clear Sky Island now, she only worked four days a week. A few commentators took turns to ensure the quality of the commentary.
After work, she could take the helicopter back. It was very fast.

Seeing that the two little girls were admiring Xiao Xin, Chen Yun replied with a message. After telling Xiao Xin, Xiao Xin naturally agreed. After all, Chen Yun was her benefactor. It was all thanks to Chen Yun that she could be where she was today.
After agreeing, Chen Yun looked at the two little girls lying on the sofa. “Hurry up and pack up. I’ll bring you to see Xiao Xin later. Don’t you want to see her?”
“Xiao Xin? Which Xiao Xin?” Chen Mengmeng was stunned.
“The one on television just now.”
“Really?” Chen Mengmeng’s face immediately turned red. This was too good!
She was the God of Luck!
Who wouldn’t want to meet her? She might even get lucky!
If Chen Yun knew what his sister was thinking now, he would definitely roll his eyes. That person was also riding on his Full of Luck skill!

After dressing up, Chen Yun looked at the two little girls. The two of them were getting better at putting on makeup. After putting on makeup, they were a pair of urban beauties, a pair of beautiful sisters. Their looks were above 90 points.
“Let’s go.”
Then, Chen Yun drove the Maserati Quattroporte to East Sea City.
At this moment, Wang Dalong and the general manager of East Sea City were already waiting. When they saw Chen Yun get out of the car, the two of them were stunned.
F*ck!
This was another luxury car worth more than three million yuan!
This was the third car they saw from Chen Yun!
He had a McLaren 720S, a Ferrari Rafa, and a Maserati Quattroporte!
He had too many cars!
They were beginning to wonder if Chen Yun chose his car every day based on his mood.
Indeed, those who were rich were wilful.
The two of them came over. “Director Chen, you’re here. We have already prepared the Riverview Hall for you. Please go over.”
“Alright.” Chen Yun handed the car keys to the waiter beside him. The latter naturally understood what he meant and helped Chen Yun park the car.
The Riverview Hall was the most luxurious private room on the top floor of East Sea City.
This private room was nearly 50 square meters large. It was made of glass walls and had a rotating design.

From here, one could enjoy the bustling scenery of Jiang City at night. Moreover, the private room would rotate for about an hour and a half. The speed was slow, and no one would feel it. At the same time, one could admire the scenery around Jiang City.
Chen Yun had just entered the private room when the door was knocked.
“Director Chen, I’m Chen Guangming from Hongyuan Trade. I just saw that you are here too, so I took the liberty to toast you.”
“Director Chen, I’m...”
Not long after, four or five people came up to toast. Chen Yun used tea as wine, while the other party drank until their cups were dry. The two little girls were stunned.
In the end, when Wang Dalong saw that the dishes on Chen Yun’s table were already prepared, he guarded the door and rejected all the toasts.
“Brother, they’re all big shots, right? Why are they all here to toast you? What are you...” Before Chen Mengmeng could finish asking, the private room opened again and a beautiful figure walked in.

Xiao Xin had exquisite makeup on and was covered in a fragrant perfume. Her white tube top chiffon dress outlined her beautiful and enchanting curves, revealing her collarbones. Her fair neck was complemented with a jade pendant. She was holding the limited edition Louis Vuitton bag that Chen Yun had given her. Compared to the strong student aura from before, Xiao Xin had changed a lot. She really had the demeanor of a celebrity.
“Brother Yun, I’m sorry, I’m sorry. I’m late.” Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun and apologized.
“It’s fine, it’s fine. You just came back, right?” Chen Yun gestured. The waiter beside him quickly pulled out a chair and let Xiao Xin sit down.
“Yes, I took a helicopter back. I took a shower and put on makeup. I could have made it in time, but there was a traffic jam on the way.” Xiao Xin patted her head and smiled bitterly.
Opposite them, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Xiao Xin. Their eyes widened. They had finally seen her in person!
The person in front of them could definitely be considered one of the most popular internet celebrities on the Internet!
She had ten million fans on the Internet!
She had nearly three million fans on the Flying Fish live-streaming platform!
She was definitely a big streamer! An internet celebrity!
Moreover, with her special ability, he even obtained the title of the God of Luck on the Internet!
Chen Yun looked at the two of them with stars in their eyes. “Why aren’t you calling her Sister Xiao Xin?”
“Hello, Sister Xiao Xin.”
“Sister Xiao Xin~”

Chen Yun used tea as wine, while the other party drank until their cups were dry.
The two little girls were stunned.
In the end, when Wang Dalong saw that the dishes on Chen Yun’s table were already prepared, he guarded the door and rejected all the toasts.
“Brother, they’re all big shots, right?
Why are they all here to toast you?
What are you...” Before Chen Mengmeng could finish asking, the private room opened again and a beautiful figure walked in.
Xiao Xin had exquisite makeup on and was covered in a fragrant perfume.
Her white tube top chiffon dress outlined her beautiful and enchanting curves, revealing her collarbones.
Her fair neck was complemented with a jade pendant.
She was holding the limited edition Louis Vuitton bag that Chen Yun had given her.
Compared to the strong student aura from before, Xiao Xin had changed a lot.
She really had the demeanor of a celebrity.
“Brother Yun, I’m sorry, I’m sorry.
I’m late.” Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun and apologized.
“It’s fine, it’s fine.
You just came back, right?” Chen Yun gestured.
The waiter beside him quickly pulled out a chair and let Xiao Xin sit down.
“Yes, I took a helicopter back.
I took a shower and put on makeup.
I could have made it in time, but there was a traffic jam on the way.” Xiao Xin patted her head and smiled bitterly.
Opposite them, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Xiao Xin.
Their eyes widened.
They had finally seen her in person!
The person in front of them could definitely be considered one of the most popular internet celebrities on the Internet!
She had ten million fans on the Internet!
She had nearly three million fans on the Flying Fish live-streaming platform!
She was definitely a big streamer!
An internet celebrity!
Moreover, with her special ability, he even obtained the title of the God of Luck on the Internet!
Chen Yun looked at the two of them with stars in their eyes.
“Why aren’t you calling her Sister Xiao Xin?”
“Hello, Sister Xiao Xin.”
“Sister Xiao Xin~”

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Did You Change Cars Again?
paragraphs: “Come, let’s eat.” Chen Yun looked at them and gestured for Wang Dalong to serve the dishes.
After a while, a few delicacies were served.
However, Chen Mengmeng had no intention of eating. Instead, she looked at Xiao Xin with interest. “Sister Xiao Xin, the Internet says that you’re a God of Luck. Do you really have special abilities?”
“I don’t know either.” Xiao Xin smiled bitterly. “However, my luck has been pretty good recently, especially in the lottery.”
Chen Mengmeng looked at the waiter beside her. “Excuse me, do you have any poker cards here?”
Hm?
The waiter was stunned for a moment before nodding. “Please wait a moment. I’ll get it now.”
After a while, the waiter brought the poker cards over.
After Chen Mengmeng shuffled the cards, she spread them out on the table. “Sister Xiao Xin, draw one.”
Xiao Xin reached out and opened a card.
It was the red Joker!
“Oh my god, really?” Chen Mengmeng was still puzzled previously. Then, she shuffled the cards and handed them to Xiao Xin. Xiao Xin took one out. It was the red Joker again!
Chen Mengmeng was playful. “We’ll all draw a card. Brother, come too.”
Chen Yun was forced to draw a card.
They flashed their poker cards.
Chen Mengmeng had an A and Han Xue had a 7.
Xiao Xin chuckled and flipped the card in her hand. Then, her eyes widened.
Hm?
It was the black Joker.
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were also stunned. Why was it the black Joker? Shouldn’t it be the red Joker?
“It’s here.”
A voice sounded and attracted the attention of the three girls. At this moment, Chen Yun had a poker card in his hand. Without even looking, he opened his hand and showed it to everyone.
It was the red Joker!
This!
“Brother, how can you cheat? When did you take the red Joker away? Did you recognize that card after Sister Xiao Xin drew it a few times?” Chen Mengmeng looked like she was looking at a child.
It was as if she was scolding Chen Yun for playing such a trick at his age.
Chen Yun was speechless.
He was confused.
He thought, “Your brother is the real God of Luck!”
“Be careful or I’ll draw a circle and curse you!”
“I’m not playing anymore. You won’t believe me even if I play.” Chen Yun threw the king in his hand back into a pile of poker cards.

Among the three of them, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue had looks of disbelief on their faces. Only Xiao Xin was puzzled. She looked at Chen Yun. She remembered that her luck had only improved after returning from the sea with Chen Yun. Now, such an outcome had happened.
If she still didn’t suspect anything, she would really be stupid.
However, from the looks of it, Chen Yun did not want to reveal his ability.
During the meal, Xiao Xin’s phone kept ringing, forcing her to turn it on silent mode with a helpless expression.
“What’s wrong? Is someone harassing you?” Chen Yun asked.
Xiao Xin nodded. “Someone is harassing me.”
“CEO Qu from Jiang City wants me to test his luck and help him check the Feng Shui of his new home.”
“Meanwhile, Mr. Liu spent a lot of money to let me bless his bracelet.”

“Umm, the abbot of Cold Mountain Temple asked me to go over this morning. He said that he wanted me to stand there for a day and increase the offering money for their temple.” Xiao Xin pursed her lips. “He didn’t say anything about payment. He just said that he wanted Buddha to protect my entire family.”
She was asked to read fortunes, bless items, and go to the monastery to stand guard.
This was simply too much!
“Sister Xiao Xin, aren’t you going to those who invited you to bless them?” Chen Mengmeng smiled. “They paid a lot of money.”

“I’m not a master. What’s there to bless?” Xiao Xin smiled. Then, when she heard that the two of them were going to Jiang City University of the Arts, her eyes widened. “In that case, do you want to join the Modeling Department? I know the Dean and can let you in directly. How about that? Think about it.”
Xiao Xin looked at their figures. The ratio was simply perfect. If they entered the Modeling Department, they would definitely be good seedlings.
“We’re going to the Acting Department. I’m sorry, Sister Xiao Xin.”

“The Acting Department?” Xiao Xin pouted. “Actually, the Modeling Department is quite good. It’s fine if you’re unwilling, but the Acting Department is quite difficult. Moreover, I heard that there are many dark things over there. You have to think about it.”
After saying that, she felt that she was worrying for nothing. Chen Yun was behind them. With his background, who could touch them?
That night, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue simply got along well with Xiao Xin.
The three of them used cosmetics as a breakthrough point and communicated crazily.
Chen Yun was at the side and could not say a word.
He could only look at them quietly.
Ha, women.
Their interests were always so poor.
Chen Yun looked at them and then at himself. He suddenly felt that his life was so poor.
After all, the lives of rich people were simple and boring.
Their meal cost 100,000 yuan.
This was because they didn’t drink.
However, even this price made 99% of the people in Jiang City shrink back.
When they left at night, Chen Yun looked at Xiao Xin. “Xiao Xin, let’s go. I’ll send you back.”
“Brother, you’re not sending Sister Xiao Xin back. You’re sending us back.” Chen Mengmeng pulled Chen Yun. “We agreed to sleep at Sister Xiao Xin’s place tonight.”
“Do you want to come along?” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun. “I heard that Sister Xiao Xin and her two roommates are there too.”
“Moreover, before I came, Mom also said that you’re not young anymore. You should...”
“Go, go, go.” Chen Yun covered his sister’s mouth. “You can’t do anything else, but you’re the best at nagging.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Was she that bad?
“Xiao Xin, I’ll have to trouble you to take care of these two little girls tonight.” Chen Yun sent them to Xiao Xin’s rented house, got out of the car, and said a few words.
“Brother Yun, don’t worry. Drive slowly.”

At this moment, on the window of the second floor, Lin Yu and Zhang Jing heard the sound of the engine below and came over to take a look. They were looking at the Maserati Quattroporte from above. Coupled with the darkness of the night, they could not see the car logo clearly.
However, the car was six meters long!
It had a handsome appearance!
With just one look, one could tell that this was a luxury car!
It was definitely a luxury car!
“Oh my god, this car costs at least a million yuan.”
“It’s definitely worth more than that!” Zhang Jing looked at the person beside the car and her eyes widened. “Look, it’s Brother Yun!”
What?
Lin Yu also pouted. Did Brother Yun change cars?
Wasn’t his previous McLaren sports car still brand new?!
When Xiao Xin came up with the two girls, Zhang Jing and the others opened the door early.
“Xiao Xin.” Zhang Jing walked up and pinched her little face. “I remember when you left, you said that you went to bless a CEO’s bracelet. Could that CEO be Brother Yun?”
Xiao Xin was shocked.
Ahem!
Had she said this?!
Had anyone ever said such a thing?!
“Did I say that? Jingjing, think about it carefully.” Xiao Xin blinked, and Zhang Jing snorted. “Do you still want to be cute?”
Just as the two of them were about to cause trouble, Lin Yu looked at the two girls behind them.
“Who are these two?”
“These are Brother Yun’s two sisters, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. Mengmeng, Xiao Xue, these are my two roommates, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu.” Xiao Xin stood in the middle and introduced them.
“Hello, sisters.”
Chen Mengmeng greeted them. The two of them looked at Chen Mengmeng. This girl was really similar to Brother Yun in some aspects. In particular, her eyes seemed to be able to speak!
They could steal one’s soul!

chapters.title: Chapter 68: We Want the First Place!
paragraphs: “Come, come in quickly. I’ll wash fruits for you.” Zhang Jing and the others welcomed the two of them in. Xiao Xin looked at the time. It was almost time for the live-stream.
“Sister Xiao Xin, are you going to do a live-stream?”
“Yes, do you want to come?”
“Okay!” Chen Mengmeng had been waiting for this sentence for a long time.
Han Xue, who was beside her, also felt that she had been plotting for a long time and glanced at her.
Chen Mengmeng scratched head and pretended to be obedient. “Sister Xiao Xin, is it okay for us to take advantage of your popularity like this?”

“What do you mean by taking advantage? We’re all family. If not for Brother Yun, I would still be a small streamer who can’t buy half a melon a day.” Xiao Xin looked at the two of them. “How about this? I can’t let you live-stream with me for nothing. I’ll give you all the gifts tonight. How about that?”
“Don’t decline. Otherwise, I won’t bring you guys along anymore.” Xiao Xin looked at the two of them and said, “Alright, I’ll go prepare. You guys should prepare too.”
At nine o’clock in the evening, the live-stream started on time.
This appearance instantly caused the entire live-stream to explode!
“The God of Luck! I haven’t seen you in a long time!”
“The stream opened with a lightning strike. With three beautiful ladies, I’m three times happier!”
“God of Luck, aren’t you going to commentate on survival on the deserted island?”
Many comments floated past the screen, including many gifts and tips.
“Eh? What’s this? Why is there another event?” Xiao Xin looked at the activity sign in the upper left corner. When she clicked on it, she was stunned. This!
It was the Flying Fish Two Kings Event!
To put it simply, it was an event to choose the most popular male and female streamers this year.
The popularity rankings were evaluated by the “fish scales”.
The fish scales were temporary items. They would only be obtained by tipping the streamer during the period of the event. Those who tipped one yuan would obtain one fish scale.

In fact, there was such an event every year. Xiao Xin had watched it for a few years and understood that such an event was the money-gathering event of the Flying Fish platform. This time, Flying Fish could simply earn a lot of money.
It was the same for those big streamers.
The worst were the low-level streamers. They were stepped on by those big streamers and could only be their stepping stones.
In the past few years of the Two King event, she could only watch those popular streamers fight. She did not expect that she would have the ability to compete this year.
However, when she looked at the deadline and the current rankings, her heart instantly turned cold.
There were only three hours left!
The number one female streamer, Mei Qing, had already reached ten million fish scales!
The popular female streamers behind her on the rankings also had more than five million fish scales! It was simply too terrifying!
As for her, she had only earned 10,000 fish scales with the previous wave of tips.
She was on the brink of tears.
She had been busy commentating for the past few days and had taken three days off. She did not have time to pay attention to this side at all and happened to miss the event.
It seemed that she had no fate with the Two Kings event this year.
After adjusting her mood, she brought Chen Mengmeng and the others to sing in front of the screen.
Then, the interesting lucky draw segment began.
Once it was time for the lucky draw, the entire live-stream was filled with popularity. Gifts flew everywhere. However, the pits dug in the past three days could not be filled in such a short time.
“Hehe, what God of Luck? Look at how few fish scales she has now. She still wants to compete with our streamer. Tsk tsk.”
“It’s even said that she’s a popular streamer on Flying Fish with tens of millions of fans on the Internet. Is this what she looks like?”
“She must have been beaten back to her original state.”
These comments were immediately posted on the public chat. It was as if a thousand waves had been stirred up for a moment. However, the God of Luck Family Army suddenly counterattacked.
Gifts flew in the live-stream.
“Have you been released to bite people again?”
“Open your eyes wide and watch carefully. Our almighty God of Luck has been on leave for the past few days. She just went on air today.”
“If she streamed for the past few days, I wonder how much she will surpass the streamer in first place by.”

“Alright, alright.” Xiao Xin looked at the words on the screen and was caught between laughter and tears. She was more and more aware that she had become a Buddhist-type deity. She didn’t ask for much about these things.
Since there was no hope of getting first place, she would take good care of Mengmeng and Zhang Jing.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun returned home, turned on his computer, and looked at the live-stream.
As expected, the three of them were really streaming.
He knew her sister’s personality very well.
“User [Cloud Death] has entered the live-stream.”
A line of words immediately appeared on the public screen, shocking everyone. The haters also quietened down.
Chen Yun was like a blazing sun!
It made everyone lose their light.
After all!
He had tipped 11 million yuan in a short period of time last time!
He directly broke the record on the Flying Fish platform!
“The big shot is here! Hurry up and worship the big shot!”
“Brother Tycoon, you’re finally here. We’re so far behind now. We’re relying on you to turn the tide!”
The comments immediately appeared on the public chat. Xiao Xin looked at Chen Mengmeng beside her. “Mengmeng, Brother Yun is here.”
“Is this my brother?”
The next moment, a super rocket rose into the air in the live-stream!
“F*ck! How impressive!”
“He didn’t say anything and just tipped a super rocket!”
“How many super rockets has he sent? It’s a 500-hit combo! They’re worth a million yuan!”
Then, the combo continued!
There were 1,000 super rockets!
There were 2,000 super rockets!
There were 3,000 super rockets!
There were 4000 super rockets!
There were 5,000 super rockets!
He sent 5,000 super rockets! They were worth a total of 10 million yuan!
This scene was simply shocking!
Such a crazy reward directly made Xiao Xin rush from the top 100 to first place!
Chen Yun turned the tide alone!
Moreover, the combo continued!
The entire Flying Fish Platform was shocked. They looked at Chen Yun’s crazy tips and could not help but open their mouths wide, unable to believe what they were seeing.
What was a tycoon?
This was what a tycoon was like!
He had tipped 10 million last time!
This time, he tipped more than ten million yuan!
Some people even wanted to ask Chen Yun if his tips were periodic!
Apart from tipping, Chen Yun broadcasted a sentence through the loudspeaker on the entire platform.
“Don’t waste your energy. It’s useless. We want the first place.”
This sentence was extremely arrogant!
For a moment, many big streamers gritted their teeth and were furious.
However, they couldn’t do anything!
This person had thrown out more than ten million yuan in a short period of time!
They had been tipping for the past few days and had made great losses. How could they have the money to continue tipping now?!
When the various streamers saw Chen Yun’s words, their hearts turned cold. Even a big sponsor like him had spoken. What was there to fight for?
Meanwhile, the male streamers heaved a sigh of relief.
This was too terrifying!
Fortunately, such a thing happened at the female streamers’ side.
While the Two Kings Event was in full swing, a few people were drinking in the mountain viewing hall on the top floor of East Sea City. There was a computer in front of the leader.
“Young Master Su, I’m sorry. I didn’t book the Riverview Hall. Please forgive me.”
“Look, this is the power of the Flying Fish live-stream platform. It won’t be wrong for Huaying to cooperate with us.”
Sitting in the main seat was Su Yuncheng. Beside him was a greasy-haired young man.
This person’s name was Yu Chengzhi. He was the eldest son of the current general manager of the Flying Fish platform.

Even with his status, he looked at Su Yuncheng with respect in his eyes. Although the Flying Fish platform had been doing well in recent years and was successfully listed on the market, it was not even qualified to be on par with an entertainment company like Huaying.
Furthermore, his father only had 30% of the shares in the Flying Fish platform and was the elected chairman.
Therefore, he came from Linjiang City to Jiang City to seek cooperation with Su Yuncheng.
“The first-place streamer on the rankings is quite interesting.” Su Yuncheng opened Xiao Xin’s live-stream and looked at her. He sneered.
Wasn’t she one of the commentators for the Desert Island Survival show, an entertainment project that Sacred Heaven had worked hard to create?
Thinking of Sacred Heaven, Chen Yun, and the East Mountain Villa, Su Yuncheng’s eyes suddenly darkened.
He clenched his fists so tightly that cracking sounds could be heard!

It was simply too terrifying!
As for her, she had only earned 10,000 fish scales with the previous wave of tips.
She was on the brink of tears.
She had been busy commentating for the past few days and had taken three days off.
She did not have time to pay attention to this side at all and happened to miss the event.
It seemed that she had no fate with the Two Kings event this year.
After adjusting her mood, she brought Chen Mengmeng and the others to sing in front of the screen.
Then, the interesting lucky draw segment began.
Once it was time for the lucky draw, the entire live-stream was filled with popularity.
Gifts flew everywhere.
However, the pits dug in the past three days could not be filled in such a short time.
“Hehe, what God of Luck?
Look at how few fish scales she has now.
She still wants to compete with our streamer.
Tsk tsk.”
“It’s even said that she’s a popular streamer on Flying Fish with tens of millions of fans on the Internet.
Is this what she looks like?”
“She must have been beaten back to her original state.”
These comments were immediately posted on the public chat.
It was as if a thousand waves had been stirred up for a moment.
However, the God of Luck Family Army suddenly counterattacked.
Gifts flew in the live-stream.
“Have you been released to bite people again?”
“Open your eyes wide and watch carefully.
Our almighty God of Luck has been on leave for the past few days.
She just went on air today.”
“If she streamed for the past few days, I wonder how much she will surpass the streamer in first place by.”
“Alright, alright.” Xiao Xin looked at the words on the screen and was caught between laughter and tears.
She was more and more aware that she had become a Buddhist-type deity.
She didn’t ask for much about these things.
Since there was no hope of getting first place, she would take good care of Mengmeng and Zhang Jing.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun returned home, turned on his computer, and looked at the live-stream.
As expected, the three of them were really streaming.
He knew her sister’s personality very well.
“User [Cloud Death] has entered the live-stream.”
A line of words immediately appeared on the public screen, shocking everyone.
The haters also quietened down.
Chen Yun was like a blazing sun!
It made everyone lose their light.
After all!
He had tipped 11 million yuan in a short period of time last time!
He directly broke the record on the Flying Fish platform!
“The big shot is here!
Hurry up and worship the big shot!”
“Brother Tycoon, you’re finally here.
We’re so far behind now.
We’re relying on you to turn the tide!”
The comments immediately appeared on the public chat.
Xiao Xin looked at Chen Mengmeng beside her.
“Mengmeng, Brother Yun is here.”
“Is this my brother?”
The next moment, a super rocket rose into the air in the live-stream!
“F*ck!
How impressive!”
“He didn’t say anything and just tipped a super rocket!”
“How many super rockets has he sent?
It’s a 500-hit combo!
They’re worth a million yuan!”
Then, the combo continued!
There were 1,000 super rockets!
There were 2,000 super rockets!
There were 3,000 super rockets!
There were 4000 super rockets!
There were 5,000 super rockets!
He sent 5,000 super rockets!
They were worth a total of 10 million yuan!
This scene was simply shocking!
Such a crazy reward directly made Xiao Xin rush from the top 100 to first place!
Chen Yun turned the tide alone!
Moreover, the combo continued!
The entire Flying Fish Platform was shocked.
They looked at Chen Yun’s crazy tips and could not help but open their mouths wide, unable to believe what they were seeing.
What was a tycoon?
This was what a tycoon was like!
He had tipped 10 million last time!
This time, he tipped more than ten million yuan!
Some people even wanted to ask Chen Yun if his tips were periodic!
Apart from tipping, Chen Yun broadcasted a sentence through the loudspeaker on the entire platform.
“Don’t waste your energy.
It’s useless.
We want the first place.”
This sentence was extremely arrogant!
For a moment, many big streamers gritted their teeth and were furious.
However, they couldn’t do anything!
This person had thrown out more than ten million yuan in a short period of time!
They had been tipping for the past few days and had made great losses.
How could they have the money to continue tipping now?!
When the various streamers saw Chen Yun’s words, their hearts turned cold.
Even a big sponsor like him had spoken.
What was there to fight for?
Meanwhile, the male streamers heaved a sigh of relief.
This was too terrifying!
Fortunately, such a thing happened at the female streamers’ side.
While the Two Kings Event was in full swing, a few people were drinking in the mountain viewing hall on the top floor of East Sea City.
There was a computer in front of the leader.
“Young Master Su, I’m sorry.
I didn’t book the Riverview Hall.
Please forgive me.”
“Look, this is the power of the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
It won’t be wrong for Huaying to cooperate with us.”
Sitting in the main seat was Su Yuncheng.
Beside him was a greasy-haired young man.
This person’s name was Yu Chengzhi.
He was the eldest son of the current general manager of the Flying Fish platform.
Even with his status, he looked at Su Yuncheng with respect in his eyes.
Although the Flying Fish platform had been doing well in recent years and was successfully listed on the market, it was not even qualified to be on par with an entertainment company like Huaying.
Furthermore, his father only had 30% of the shares in the Flying Fish platform and was the elected chairman.
Therefore, he came from Linjiang City to Jiang City to seek cooperation with Su Yuncheng.
“The first-place streamer on the rankings is quite interesting.” Su Yuncheng opened Xiao Xin’s live-stream and looked at her.
He sneered.
Wasn’t she one of the commentators for the Desert Island Survival show, an entertainment project that Sacred Heaven had worked hard to create?
Thinking of Sacred Heaven, Chen Yun, and the East Mountain Villa, Su Yuncheng’s eyes suddenly darkened.
He clenched his fists so tightly that cracking sounds could be heard!

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Violation?
paragraphs: When Yu Chengzhi heard Su Yuncheng’s words, he looked at Xiao Xin, who was live-streaming.

“This person’s name is Liu Xin. She now has ten million fans on the Internet and has a financial backer to farm the first place in the rankings for her.” As Yu Chengzhi spoke, he was also stunned. “Eh? I remember that she didn’t participate in this event. How did she reach first place?”
What had happened?!
The next moment, he saw an unbelievable scene!
He saw a combo of 6,000 super rockets!
In a short period of time, 12 million yuan was farmed!
It simply made Xiao Xin jump from the bottom of the ocean to the top of the rankings!
This!
Needless to say, Yu Chengzhi could imagine that the financial backer behind Xiao Xin was working hard!
At a glance, it was indeed so!
The user’s name was Cloud Death!

“Young Master Su, the first place on the rankings in the live-stream is Xiao Xin’s financial backer. Last time, he farmed 11 million yuan in a short period of time, setting a record for our platform. This time, he even farmed 12 million yuan in one go, breaking his original record.”
“Heh.”
Upon hearing Yu Chengzhi’s arrogant words, Su Yuncheng could not help but sneer.
It was only 20 million yuan. Was there a need to make such a fuss?
“I think she’s quite interesting.” Su Yuncheng looked at Yu Chengzhi and sneered. “Do you understand what I mean?”
If Yu Chengzhi still didn’t understand, he would be a fool.
He immediately looked at Su Yuncheng. “Young Master Su, this streamer is now popular on the Internet. She might be a little difficult to deal with.”

“A popular streamer? Huaying Entertainment has created more stars than the streamers on your platform in a year. Are you telling me that it’s difficult?” Su Yuncheng’s eyes turned cold. “A streamer who has become popular will inevitably be a little arrogant. A newbie like her will know how precious an opportunity is after being suppressed a few times. Then, when an opportunity is placed in front of them, they will grab it at all costs.”

“Moreover, I remember that this female streamer seems to have been a commentator on Sacred Heaven’s Desert Island Survival show recently. It’s very interesting. You discussed a collaboration with me, but the female streamer under you went to Sacred Heaven to be a commentator!”
Su Yuncheng slammed the table. “Are you here to play with me?!”
For a moment, the entire room fell silent. Everyone looked at the angry Su Yuncheng and their hearts trembled.
For a moment, they were like frightened quails, not daring to provoke Young Master Su.
Yu Chengzhi was also shocked. His originally rosy face turned pale.
He looked at Su Yuncheng with a fawning expression.

“Young Master Su, you’re right. Such a streamer should be suppressed. Otherwise, how would they know how precious opportunities are?” Yu Chengzhi originally did not want to touch Xiao Xin because of her identity on the Internet.
But now.
Heh heh.
If he could get close to Young Master Su and Huaying, the market value of the Flying Fish platform would increase by countless times.
Moreover, Liu Xin had recently made him very unhappy. He had heard that the Xiao Ya live-streaming platform had offered her a contract fee worth hundreds of millions, but she did not reject them.
She even took three consecutive days off to be a commentator for Sacred Heaven’s variety show.
It was probably impossible not to suppress her properly.
“Manager Liu, what are you waiting for? Didn’t you hear Young Master Su’s words? Mobilize the people under you.” Liu Xin looked at Liu Bo, who was Liu Xin’s previous manager.
It was precisely because of Xiao Xin’s rise that Liu Bo was promoted to a manager in the company.
It went without saying how important Xiao Xin was to him. Now, Yu Chengzhi actually asked him to do it himself.
This!
“General Manager, if we offend the financial backer behind Xiao Xin...”
Hahahaha...

Upon hearing his words, Su Yuncheng couldn’t help but sneer and laugh loudly. “Can someone become a sugar daddy just by tipping a mere 20 million yuan? Does it mean that you can’t touch them anymore? The Flying Fish live-streaming platform is really small!”
“I really wonder if there’s a need for me to work with you.”
These words instantly shocked Yu Chengzhi. It was as if a bucket of cold water had been poured on his head.
He looked at Liu Bo and pursed his lips. “Trash, Little Zhang, you can do it.”
When Zhang Xing heard Yu Chengzhi’s words, his eyes suddenly lit up. “Alright, General Manager. I’ll do it immediately. Do we follow the previous method?”
“Yes.”

As soon as he said this, Zhang Xing glanced at the ashen-faced Liu Bo and immediately chuckled. He had not liked Liu Bo for a long time. Previously, the position of manager was originally his, but now, Liu Bo had successfully been promoted with the help of a female streamer. Meanwhile, he was walking around in circles. How could he not be jealous!
How could he not be resentful!
Now, there was an opportunity. There was finally an opportunity!
“Hehe, General Manager Yu, I’ll definitely do it beautifully for you.” Then, he looked at Liu Bo opposite him and left with a sneer.
Meanwhile.
Xiao Xin’s live-stream was still immersed in revelry.
At this moment, it was as the public chat was filled with snowflakes once again!
“How impressive!”
“He’s indeed a godly tycoon. How impressive!”
“I’ve opened my eyes. He sent 6,000 super rockets! They’re worth a total of 12 million!”
Even the three people streaming in front of the screen were extremely excited. Chen Mengmeng held Xiao Xin’s hand. “Sister Xiao Xin, we’re already first!”
Although her heart ached for Chen Yun’s tips, she had been stimulated so many times that she was already numb.
After all, he had a plate worth 40 million yuan, blue-and-white porcelain vases worth 100 million each, and a top-notch house worth hundreds of millions!
She no longer knew how much money her brother had.
This tip of ten million yuan might not even be enough to buy a corner of the plate she had picked up in the afternoon.
Meanwhile, Xiao Xin did not expect such a situation. If she was the most popular female streamer in the Two Kings Event, she could become popular on the Internet again.
At this moment, Chen Yun, who was in front of the screen, looked at the screen and picked up his teacup to take a sip.
With a relaxed expression, he tipped 10 million yuan as easily as an ordinary person throwing out two yuan.
He hid his achievements and reputation.

Under Chen Yun’s lead, the popularity of the entire live-stream skyrocketed. All kinds of tips kept coming in. Furthermore, with the effect of the live-stream conducted by Xiao Xin and the others, there was no need for Chen Yun’s tips later on. The gap between her and the second-place streamer was also increasing.
For a full three hours.
Xiao Xin’s live-stream became a sea of happy tips.
“It’s going to be midnight in a few minutes.”
“That’s right. We’ve shaken off the streamer in second place by a few million fish scales. We’re going to win!”
“Congratulations to Xiao Xin for becoming the most popular female streamer!”
“Congratulations to the streamer for reaching the top of the Two Kings Event!”
For a moment, congratulatory comments flooded the screen. Everyone was waiting for midnight.
However, at midnight, when everyone was preparing to celebrate...
The entire live-stream went dark!
[I’m sorry, the live-stream you’re watching is suspected of violating the rules. It has been banned.]
A sentence appeared on the screen.
It was as if a slap had landed on everyone’s faces!
