chapters.title: Chapter 70: Something Big Happened!
paragraphs: This!
Everyone was stunned. Their eyes widened, unable to believe what they were seeing!
Was it because Xiao Xin was suspected of violating the rules?!
F*ck!
How was it against the rules?!
Nothing had happened before this. Why did they have to ban the live-stream when the Two Kings Event ended?!
For a moment, Xiao Xin’s fans simply exploded.
“What’s going on?! Why was the live-stream banned?”
“Suspected of violating the rules? How is she suspected of violating the rules?! Streamer, streamer, do you know why?”
Xiao Xin’s phone immediately rang. At this moment, Xiao Xin, Chen Mengmeng, and Han Xue were sitting in front of the screen. Their eyes blinked, and they were all stunned!
“Sister Xiao Xin, what’s wrong?” Chen Mengmeng’s voice was trembling, not knowing what to do.

“This is the first time I’ve encountered such a situation. What happened?” Xiao Xin looked confused. Why was the live-stream inexplicably banned? She looked at herself and the two girls beside her. They were both dressed very modestly. Moreover, she was not a streamer who relied on acting coquettishly to gain fans.
At this moment, in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, Chen Yun’s eyes suddenly darkened.

Looking at the platform, the God of Luck Family Army, who were originally in Xiao Xin’s live-stream, were all farming comments under the live-streams of other streamers. The entire Flying Fish fell into chaos.
An hour later, an announcement popped up on the Flying Fish platform.
[The Two Kings of the Two Kings Event have been born!]
[Most Popular Male Streamer: Little Horse on the Shore.]
[Most Popular Female Streamer: Mei Qing.]
“What the hell! Why is Mei Qing the most popular female streamer!”
“Isn’t she second? Our Xiao Xin surpassed her by several million fish scales. Why is it her?!”
“What’s the Flying Fish live-stream platform trying to do?! Do you want to earn money?!”
Then, another announcement popped up.

[The live-stream hosted by “Jiang City’s Xiao Xin” is suspected of violating the rules. It has been banned. It is unknown when the ban will be lifted. The results of the Two Kings Event will be automatically voided.]
As soon as this result was announced, the God of Luck Family Army was collectively unconvinced.
Even a fool could tell what had happened!
There was obviously an inside story!
Xiao Xin had definitely been messed with!
The damned Flying Fish live-stream platform didn’t ban the stream earlier on. They only banned the stream at midnight when everyone farmed all the gifts in their hands!
It was obvious that they wanted to mess with the users and use Xiao Xin to earn another sum of money!
What a good plan!
How capable!
“Impressive! It’s banned just like that! F*ck the Flying Fish live-stream platform!”
“Hehe, was she suspected of violating the rules? Tell me what she’s suspected of violating. There are a bunch of people acting coquettishly in the other live-streams. Now, you’re capable!”
“Besides, if you want to void the results, you can return all our gifts!”
At this moment, the complaint channel of the Flying Fish live-stream platform almost exploded!
Everyone was cursing.
At this moment, backstage, Yu Chengzhi had already returned to his room. The next moment, a girl knocked on the door and entered. “General Manager Yu, bad news!”
“Look, too many users have started to complain to us, asking us to return their tips. Moreover, it shows that our app’s ratings have plummeted in the various app malls. What should we do?”
Haha.
Yu Chengzhi looked at the girl in front of him and smiled. “Ask them to complain. They have the ability to farm. They donated the money voluntarily. Why should we return it to them?”
The Two Kings Event was the first large-scale event he had organized. He could use this opportunity to get close to Young Master Su and Huaying Entertainment.

She was just a streamer. If they suppressed her, so be it. If they didn’t suppress her, how would she know how precious the opportunity was? How would she obediently climb into Young Master Su’s bed? How could he have the chance to continue working with Huaying and climb up?

He looked at the girl in front of him. “There are some things that I don’t need to teach you, right? If you can’t solve the problem of the complaints, solve the problem of the people who complained. Do you understand?”
If they couldn’t solve the problem, they would deal with the people who complained!
In one night, countless accounts were about to be banned.
“Understood, General Manager Yu.”

At this moment, in the hotel, Liu Bo looked at the scene on the platform and his heart was about to break. It was true that he had relied on Xiao Xin to successfully be promoted. Of course, he had also given Xiao Xin a lot of resources.
Now that Xiao Xin had been banned and suppressed, his efforts had been wasted.
He looked at the situation on the platform. Although these fans were clamoring happily, they were all scattered soldiers. They could not cause much damage to a platform like Flying Fish.
It was just like the last time when Flying Fish forced a streamer away. The fans also made a fuss, but in the end, they ended up with nothing.
“F*ck!” As Liu Bo thought about this, he could not help but slap the table so hard that his hands went numb!
Now that Xiao Xin had lost her power, he would not have an easy time on the Flying Fish platform.
No! He could not sit back and wait for death!
At that moment, he called Xiao Xin and created a group chat, asking her to pull Chen Yun in.
A video call was started.
A total of three windows appeared on the screen.
The anxious Liu Bo appeared in one of the windows.
Xiao Xin, whose face was still covered in tears, appeared in another window.
The last window contained Chen Yun, who was leaning against a chair and sipping tea.

“You must be Mr. Cloud Death. Hello, I’m Xiao Xin’s manager, Liu Bo...” Liu Bo introduced himself first. “Today’s result is all our General Manager’s idea. He wants to suppress Xiao Xin because of the Xiao Ya live-streaming platform and Sacred Heaven...”
“I mentioned you to him, but he didn’t take you seriously at all. He even said that it’s a mere 20 million yuan...”
In just a few sentences, he explained the ins and outs of the matter. As Chen Yun drank his tea and listened to Liu Bo’s report, the coldness in his eyes intensified.
Damn!
Very good!
What a good plan!
Chen Yun had spent money on the Flying Fish live-stream platform to show them some respect. However, their current actions were equivalent to slapping Chen Yun in his face.
They even dared to cheat him of his money and slap his face!
How could he not be angry!

“A mere General Manager of Flying Fish dares to commit such a huge crime. It seems that this is all Flying Fish can do.” Chen Yun sneered and looked at the screen. “Mengmeng, comfort Sister Xiao Xin. Sleep well tonight. I’ll give you a satisfactory result in a day or two.”
Then, Chen Yun looked at Liu Bo. “You did well. When I obtain the Flying Fish live-stream platform, you’ll be in charge.”
These words made Liu Bo’s eyes widen. He could not believe what he had heard. Chen Yun said that when he obtained the Flying Fish live-stream platform, he would be in charge.
When he obtained the Flying Fish live-stream platform?
Oh my god!
This...
“Alright, Mr. Chen. I’ll definitely do my best and not let you down!” Liu Bo stood up from his chair and bowed 90 degrees to the screen.
For some reason, he had an inexplicable trust in Chen Yun’s words!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun made a call to Ma Ke and briefly explained the matter. In any case, he would use the lowest price to get the Flying Fish live-stream platform in the shortest time possible!
He would destroy them!
He would crush them!
When Ma Ke heard this, his heart tightened. He did not expect Flying Fish to be so blind as to provoke Director Chen.
He immediately went to the study and began to contact his subordinates, preparing to attack Flying Fish.
In ten minutes, the entire Public Relations Department was in place!
They held a video conference to discuss countermeasures!
It would be implemented in half an hour!
This set of work was smooth like flowing water!
Meanwhile, everyone else fell asleep.
The next day, before dawn, all the higher-ups received an emergency call. They woke up from their sleep and looked at the documents sent. Everyone’s eyes widened.
Oh no!
Something big had happened!

What happened?” Xiao Xin looked confused.
Why was the live-stream inexplicably banned?
She looked at herself and the two girls beside her.
They were both dressed very modestly.
Moreover, she was not a streamer who relied on acting coquettishly to gain fans.
At this moment, in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, Chen Yun’s eyes suddenly darkened.
Looking at the platform, the God of Luck Family Army, who were originally in Xiao Xin’s live-stream, were all farming comments under the live-streams of other streamers.
The entire Flying Fish fell into chaos.
An hour later, an announcement popped up on the Flying Fish platform.
[The Two Kings of the Two Kings Event have been born!]
[Most Popular Male Streamer: Little Horse on the Shore.]
[Most Popular Female Streamer: Mei Qing.]
“What the hell!
Why is Mei Qing the most popular female streamer!”
“Isn’t she second?
Our Xiao Xin surpassed her by several million fish scales.
Why is it her?!”
“What’s the Flying Fish live-stream platform trying to do?!
Do you want to earn money?!”
Then, another announcement popped up.
[The live-stream hosted by “Jiang City’s Xiao Xin” is suspected of violating the rules.
It has been banned.
It is unknown when the ban will be lifted.
The results of the Two Kings Event will be automatically voided.]
As soon as this result was announced, the God of Luck Family Army was collectively unconvinced.
Even a fool could tell what had happened!
There was obviously an inside story!
Xiao Xin had definitely been messed with!
The damned Flying Fish live-stream platform didn’t ban the stream earlier on.
They only banned the stream at midnight when everyone farmed all the gifts in their hands!
It was obvious that they wanted to mess with the users and use Xiao Xin to earn another sum of money!
What a good plan!
How capable!
“Impressive!
It’s banned just like that!
F*ck the Flying Fish live-stream platform!”
“Hehe, was she suspected of violating the rules?
Tell me what she’s suspected of violating.
There are a bunch of people acting coquettishly in the other live-streams.
Now, you’re capable!”
“Besides, if you want to void the results, you can return all our gifts!”
At this moment, the complaint channel of the Flying Fish live-stream platform almost exploded!
Everyone was cursing.
At this moment, backstage, Yu Chengzhi had already returned to his room.
The next moment, a girl knocked on the door and entered.
“General Manager Yu, bad news!”
“Look, too many users have started to complain to us, asking us to return their tips.
Moreover, it shows that our app’s ratings have plummeted in the various app malls.
What should we do?”
Haha.
Yu Chengzhi looked at the girl in front of him and smiled.
“Ask them to complain.
They have the ability to farm.
They donated the money voluntarily.
Why should we return it to them?”
The Two Kings Event was the first large-scale event he had organized.
He could use this opportunity to get close to Young Master Su and Huaying Entertainment.
She was just a streamer.
If they suppressed her, so be it.
If they didn’t suppress her, how would she know how precious the opportunity was?
How would she obediently climb into Young Master Su’s bed?
How could he have the chance to continue working with Huaying and climb up?
He looked at the girl in front of him.
“There are some things that I don’t need to teach you, right?
If you can’t solve the problem of the complaints, solve the problem of the people who complained.
Do you understand?”
If they couldn’t solve the problem, they would deal with the people who complained!
In one night, countless accounts were about to be banned.
“Understood, General Manager Yu.”
At this moment, in the hotel, Liu Bo looked at the scene on the platform and his heart was about to break.
It was true that he had relied on Xiao Xin to successfully be promoted.
Of course, he had also given Xiao Xin a lot of resources.
Now that Xiao Xin had been banned and suppressed, his efforts had been wasted.
He looked at the situation on the platform.
Although these fans were clamoring happily, they were all scattered soldiers.
They could not cause much damage to a platform like Flying Fish.
It was just like the last time when Flying Fish forced a streamer away.
The fans also made a fuss, but in the end, they ended up with nothing.
“F*ck!” As Liu Bo thought about this, he could not help but slap the table so hard that his hands went numb!
Now that Xiao Xin had lost her power, he would not have an easy time on the Flying Fish platform.
No!
He could not sit back and wait for death!
At that moment, he called Xiao Xin and created a group chat, asking her to pull Chen Yun in.
A video call was started.
A total of three windows appeared on the screen.
The anxious Liu Bo appeared in one of the windows.
Xiao Xin, whose face was still covered in tears, appeared in another window.
The last window contained Chen Yun, who was leaning against a chair and sipping tea.
“You must be Mr.
Cloud Death.
Hello, I’m Xiao Xin’s manager, Liu Bo...” Liu Bo introduced himself first.
“Today’s result is all our General Manager’s idea.
He wants to suppress Xiao Xin because of the Xiao Ya live-streaming platform and Sacred Heaven...”
“I mentioned you to him, but he didn’t take you seriously at all.
He even said that it’s a mere 20 million yuan...”
In just a few sentences, he explained the ins and outs of the matter.
As Chen Yun drank his tea and listened to Liu Bo’s report, the coldness in his eyes intensified.
Damn!
Very good!
What a good plan!
Chen Yun had spent money on the Flying Fish live-stream platform to show them some respect.
However, their current actions were equivalent to slapping Chen Yun in his face.
They even dared to cheat him of his money and slap his face!
How could he not be angry!
“A mere General Manager of Flying Fish dares to commit such a huge crime.
It seems that this is all Flying Fish can do.” Chen Yun sneered and looked at the screen.
“Mengmeng, comfort Sister Xiao Xin.
Sleep well tonight.
I’ll give you a satisfactory result in a day or two.”
Then, Chen Yun looked at Liu Bo.
“You did well.
When I obtain the Flying Fish live-stream platform, you’ll be in charge.”
These words made Liu Bo’s eyes widen.
He could not believe what he had heard.
Chen Yun said that when he obtained the Flying Fish live-stream platform, he would be in charge.
When he obtained the Flying Fish live-stream platform?
Oh my god!
This...
“Alright, Mr.
Chen.
I’ll definitely do my best and not let you down!” Liu Bo stood up from his chair and bowed 90 degrees to the screen.
For some reason, he had an inexplicable trust in Chen Yun’s words!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun made a call to Ma Ke and briefly explained the matter.
In any case, he would use the lowest price to get the Flying Fish live-stream platform in the shortest time possible!
He would destroy them!
He would crush them!
When Ma Ke heard this, his heart tightened.
He did not expect Flying Fish to be so blind as to provoke Director Chen.
He immediately went to the study and began to contact his subordinates, preparing to attack Flying Fish.
In ten minutes, the entire Public Relations Department was in place!
They held a video conference to discuss countermeasures!
It would be implemented in half an hour!
This set of work was smooth like flowing water!
Meanwhile, everyone else fell asleep.
The next day, before dawn, all the higher-ups received an emergency call.
They woke up from their sleep and looked at the documents sent.
Everyone’s eyes widened.
Oh no!
Something big had happened!

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Kill One to Warn a Hundred!
paragraphs: The executives of Flying Fish live-stream platform looked at the documents in front of them and widened their eyes. They simply could not believe what had happened!
In just one night, more than a hundred live-streams on the entire Flying Fish had been banned!
Furthermore, they were not banned by Flying Fish itself!
It was the cyber police!
In one night, a group of streamers were reported!
All the female streamers who showed off their bodies were reported as vulgar and indecent.
Meanwhile, many male streamers had been banned with conclusive evidence!

Of course, there was no smoke without fire. These people had conclusive evidence. What was worse was that not only were the live-streams banned, but the news of the entire Flying Fish live-stream platform had also spread on many platforms.
There was news that they had forced popular streamers away, used unfair contracts to squeeze the profits of the streamers, exploited the low-leveled streamers, and cleared their name...
One by one, they were like sharp knives stabbing into the heart of the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
Flying Fish had no room to refute. These were all things that they had really done.

Many netizens were now agitated. Under every news article, they scolded the Flying Fish live-stream platform. Coupled with the fact that the streamers who had caused a commotion previously were forced to leave, the ratings of the Flying Fish live-stream app were directly attacked. In all the app markets, the ratings of the Flying Fish live-stream app were lower than 50%.
In some app stores, the Flying Fish live-stream app had already reached a miserable state!

Such news was everywhere. Coupled with the fact that hundreds of live-stream rooms were banned, it had the effect of punishing a few as an example to others. Many streamers hurriedly went offline, causing only a few streamers to live-stream on Flying Fish, which should have had hundreds of streamers in the morning.
Those popular streamers even gave up. They did not stream. The Flying Fish platform appeared bleak.
What a joke!

Those big streamers were all smart. At this moment, they naturally knew that someone was messing with the Flying Fish live-stream platform. Who would dare to go on the live-stream? Moreover, their foundation was not clean. They had relied on whitewashing to obtain their current status.
If they were also banned or their dirty secrets were exposed, they would not be able to survive in this industry.
All they could do now was wait and see the reaction of Flying Fish. They would wait and see how the situation developed!
“Oh my god, why isn’t there anyone streaming anymore?”
“Where are they? Where did those streamers go?”
“That’s it? Is this the number one live-stream platform? Let’s go...”

When the users who were preparing to watch the live-stream came in early in the morning, they were all stunned when they saw this scene. Then, they looked at the few small streamers who were still live-streaming. They were completely bored.
As a result, a large number of users directly uninstalled the app and were forced to leave.

The upper echelons of the Flying Fish live-stream platform clearly did not expect such a thing to happen. The day before, they were still happily making a lot of money from the Two Kings Event. They could not even close their mouths.
And now, in just one night, more than 90% of their streamers did not dare to live-stream.
There were even a large number of streamers whose live-streams were banned!
It would be normal if such a situation happened to one or two streamers. However, now, so many situations had happened at once. This was a little abnormal!
When such a thing happened, the Flying Fish live-stream platform would definitely ask the remaining big streamers.
However, the answers they received were almost the same.
“I can’t live-stream right now.”
“I don’t dare to live-stream now.”
“It’s awkward for me to disclose the details.”
“Sorry, I’m taking a few days off.”
The upper echelons of the Flying Fish live-stream platform were at a loss. What was going on?!
Why did those streamers who didn’t act coquettishly or had their live-streams banned not dare to live-stream for a moment?!
They should be fine!
However, what all the higher-ups did not know was that just this morning, the pillars of the Flying Fish live-stream platform had all received an email with an attachment.
One of the attachments was a compressed package. In the compressed package, there were scandals about these streamers.
There were big and small scandals.

If the small scandals were exposed, it would be enough to make the fans go crazy. However, if others found out about the major scandals, not only would they not be able to survive on the Internet, but they would also be too ashamed to face others.
They would lose everything.
This was the power of Sacred Heaven’s Public Relations Department!
Moreover, these streamers were all smart people. From the short few hours last night, it was obvious that the other party was not here for them, but for the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
As long as they gave up, they would be safe.
Thus, before receiving the email asking them to live-stream, they did not dare to live-stream even if they risked breaching the contract.
Otherwise, what awaited them was a dead end!
After the stock market opened, the Flying Fish live-stream platform’s shares plunged to the limit!
It was like riding a roller coaster!
They had set a record!
Seeing this situation, the upper echelons of the Flying Fish live-stream platform panicked!
“Why doesn’t anyone know what happened?!” At this moment, in the chairman’s office of the Flying Fish Headquarters, the middle-aged man in the lead widened his eyes in anger!
In front of him were the directors and the management of the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
At this moment, they looked at Yu Jinghao in front of them like frightened quails. They did not dare to say a word or even breathe heavily.

It was no wonder that Yu Jinghao was anxious now. The pillars of the platform had all requested leave. After all, the contract stated that there were a few days of leave every month, so the other party could not be considered to have breached the contract.
However, when they signed the contract, no one expected all the streamers to take leave and stop live-streaming at the same time!

Today, the Flying Fish live-stream platform’s stock price had fallen to the limit as soon as the market opened. At this rate, the Flying Fish live-stream platform would close down in less than three days!
Moreover, the cyber police had already begun to investigate the reports related to the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
They could not hold on any longer!

It could be said that even after this storm, the Flying Fish live-stream platform had suffered a huge blow. Could they still be the number one live-stream platform in China? It was already a blessing if they could be ranked among the top three— no, the top five live-stream platforms!
“Speak! Does anyone know what’s going on?!”
“Who knows what’s going on?!”
Only Yu Jinghao’s roar was left in the entire conference room.
The next moment, a higher-up stood up. “Chairman, according to my observation, someone is messing with us this time.”
“I don’t need you to tell me!”
“I had a private chat with a streamer. The other party gave me a definite answer. This time, it was Sacred Heaven who did it.”
What?
Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Although they were in Linjiang City, they were not far from Jiang City. Naturally, they knew about Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Sacred Heaven was a behemoth to begin with. Now, they had become popular again with the Desert Island Survival show!
It could be said that among the Chinese entertainment companies, Sacred Heaven already had the potential to compare to those veteran entertainment companies that had been established for decades.
This sentence made all the directors and higher-ups turn pale.
When they heard that Sacred Heaven Entertainment was messing with them, they were simply helpless.
They didn’t have a powerful Public Relations Department like them, nor were they as rich!
How were they going to turn the tables?
They could just wait for death!
Even Yu Jinghao’s body froze. When Yu Chengzhi heard the words ‘Sacred Heaven’, his body trembled. He seemed to have thought of something and lowered his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 72: If I Don’t Give You Face, You’re Nothing!
paragraphs: “Why?” Yu Jinghao’s face was ashen. He looked in front of him in confusion. “Why? Why would Sacred Heaven Entertainment suddenly attack us? Are they going to do live-streams too?”
“I don’t think so. Sacred Heaven is such a big industry. How can they be interested in the live-stream market where most of the meat has been distributed?”
Yu Jinghao muttered, expressing the thoughts of all the directors and executives.
These directors and executives did not know why such a situation happened.

The higher-up who had spoken just now paused and whispered, “I have a few friends in Sacred Heaven. They heard that this order seemed to have been issued directly by Director Chen, who had just taken office at Sacred Heaven Entertainment.”
What?
Had it been issued directly by the highest level?!
This was the highest level of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Yu Jinghao simply couldn’t figure out why!
Why would such a big shot suddenly attack them?!
The next moment, a man opposite him stood up and looked at Yu Jinghao. “Chairman, actually, I think it’s better to ask our General Manager about this. I think he’ll give us an explanation.”
“He should give us an explanation too.”
The person who spoke was none other than Manager Liu Bo. As soon as he said this, everyone looked at Yu Chengzhi, who had his head lowered and a pale face.

Liu Bo could now tell that the entire Flying Fish live-stream platform was in danger. Sacred Heaven’s attack was a huge blow to the Flying Fish live-stream platform. Or rather, it directly made the Flying Fish live-stream platform unable to stand up.

He did not expect Chen Yun’s words to be so effective. In just a day, Flying Fish live-stream platform had fallen to this extent. At that moment, he believed Chen Yun’s words yesterday. In addition, he really could not stand Yu Chengzhi’s actions of banning Xiao Xin and stepping on streamers to earn money, so he shouted angrily.
In his opinion, Yu Chengzhi was trash!
He was a tycoon who didn’t know how to operate a business!
How dare he shout at professionals like them here!
It caused the entire Flying Fish to be in a foul mood!
It was because of his father!
Meanwhile, when Yu Chengzhi heard Liu Bo’s words, he suddenly raised his face and looked at everyone in front of him. The anger in his heart suddenly spewed out.
Bang!
He slammed the table and stood up, pointing at Liu Bo. “F*ck you! What did you say?!”
“What’s wrong with me?! What right do you have to say that this incident was because of me?!”
“If you don’t produce evidence today, get lost!”
These words simply roared out, causing everyone present to frown.

Liu Bo looked at Yu Chengzhi in front of him and sneered. Then, he looked at the people in front of him. “Chairman, directors, and higher-ups, as far as I know, the top financial backer of our streamer, Xiao Xin, is a higher-up of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.”
“He spent a lot of money and made Xiao Xin famous. He even asked her to join the Sacred Heaven variety show, Desert Island survival, as a commentator.”
“However, last night, because General Manager Yu wanted to curry favor with Huaying Entertainment, he directly banned Xiao Xin’s live-stream that didn’t violate the rules!”
“That’s why I offended him!”
“That’s why everything is like this!”
This!
When everyone heard Liu Bo’s words, they suddenly looked at Yu Chengzhi. They knew what was going on!
Why would the most popular female streamer be replaced? Why were there so many complaints last night? Why...
At that moment, everyone’s eyes were filled with anger.
Even Yu Jinghao’s eyes were dull.
Liu Bo briefly described the matter. Yu Jinghao would really be stupid if he didn’t know where the problem was.
It was obvious that since such a powerful entertainment company like Sacred Heaven invited Xiao Xin as a commentator, Xiao Xin naturally had relations with the higher-ups of Sacred Heaven.
Many directors and higher-ups present sneered as they looked at the father and son.
Yu Jinghao looked at Yu Chengzhi beside him. “Is what he said true?!”
“Dad, I didn’t expect a streamer to be so powerful.” Yu Chengzhi’s body began to tremble.
“Bastard!”
Pa!
With a crisp sound, Yu Jinghao slapped Yu Chengzhi’s face.
Although the Flying Fish live-stream platform was doing well, it was not monopolized by one family. Instead, it was surrounded on all sides. It had to develop steadily.
However, at this moment, such a thing happened. How could the Flying Fish live-stream platform endure it!
Now, all the pillars of the Flying Fish live-stream platform had taken leave to stop broadcasting. When the stock market opened, their shares plunged to the limit.
This was an omen of the Flying Fish live-stream platform’s collapse!
What should they do?

Even though Yu Jinghao had slapped Yu Chengzhi, the directors and executives present did not buy it. They also had many shares in the Flying Fish live-stream platform. Now that the situation had turned out like this, their money had become useless paper.
Severing someone’s path to wealth was like killing their parents!
Now, many people were staring at Yu Jinghao and Yu Chengzhi!
There had to be an explanation!
At the same time, a voice sounded from outside.
“Who are you? You can’t enter. There’s a board meeting here. Who are you...”
The secretary’s anxious voice attracted the attention of the directors and higher-ups. Everyone looked out and saw six or seven men and women in work clothes and briefcases walk in.

After entering the meeting room, everyone looked at the six or seven people in front of them. All of them were in suits and leather shoes, especially the girl in the lead. Her face was cold, like a frost beauty or an arrogant female CEO. Just her looks and aura were terrifying enough!
This person was none other than Zhou Jingyi, who was now the operations manager of Sacred Heaven!

“Chairman Liu, right? Hello, we’re from Sacred Heaven’s Operations Department. I’m the manager of Sacred Heaven’s Operations Department, Zhou Jingyi...” Zhou Jingyi introduced briefly. Then, she walked to the main seat and sat down!
For a moment, everyone looked at Zhou Jingyi and was shocked.
“This is a meeting among the higher-ups of Flying Fish!”
“What are you doing here?! Get out!” Yu Jinghao looked at them and shouted angrily.

After all, he was the chairman of the Flying Fish live-stream platform. This was a board meeting of the directors and higher-ups of Flying Fish. Now that a group of strangers had barged in, it was simply a slap to his face.
However, as soon as he said this, Zhou Jingyi sneered, as if she took Yu Jinghao’s words as a joke.
“Chairman Yu, I think you still don’t understand the situation.”
“If I’m giving you face, I’d call you Chairman!”
“However, if I don’t give you face, you’re nothing! You’re not even qualified to carry our shoes!”
Hiss!
As soon as these words were spoken, all the directors and executives present gasped. They looked at Zhou Jingyi and their eyes could not help but widen.
They had never seen anyone dare to say such things to Yu Jinghao!
The entire place was silent!
The oppressive aura kept expanding!

Yu Jinghao muttered, expressing the thoughts of all the directors and executives.
These directors and executives did not know why such a situation happened.
The higher-up who had spoken just now paused and whispered, “I have a few friends in Sacred Heaven.
They heard that this order seemed to have been issued directly by Director Chen, who had just taken office at Sacred Heaven Entertainment.”
What?
Had it been issued directly by the highest level?!
This was the highest level of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
Yu Jinghao simply couldn’t figure out why!
Why would such a big shot suddenly attack them?!
The next moment, a man opposite him stood up and looked at Yu Jinghao.
“Chairman, actually, I think it’s better to ask our General Manager about this.
I think he’ll give us an explanation.”
“He should give us an explanation too.”
The person who spoke was none other than Manager Liu Bo.
As soon as he said this, everyone looked at Yu Chengzhi, who had his head lowered and a pale face.
Liu Bo could now tell that the entire Flying Fish live-stream platform was in danger.
Sacred Heaven’s attack was a huge blow to the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
Or rather, it directly made the Flying Fish live-stream platform unable to stand up.
He did not expect Chen Yun’s words to be so effective.
In just a day, Flying Fish live-stream platform had fallen to this extent.
At that moment, he believed Chen Yun’s words yesterday.
In addition, he really could not stand Yu Chengzhi’s actions of banning Xiao Xin and stepping on streamers to earn money, so he shouted angrily.
In his opinion, Yu Chengzhi was trash!
He was a tycoon who didn’t know how to operate a business!
How dare he shout at professionals like them here!
It caused the entire Flying Fish to be in a foul mood!
It was because of his father!
Meanwhile, when Yu Chengzhi heard Liu Bo’s words, he suddenly raised his face and looked at everyone in front of him.
The anger in his heart suddenly spewed out.
Bang!
He slammed the table and stood up, pointing at Liu Bo.
“F*ck you!
What did you say?!”
“What’s wrong with me?!
What right do you have to say that this incident was because of me?!”
“If you don’t produce evidence today, get lost!”
These words simply roared out, causing everyone present to frown.
Liu Bo looked at Yu Chengzhi in front of him and sneered.
Then, he looked at the people in front of him.
“Chairman, directors, and higher-ups, as far as I know, the top financial backer of our streamer, Xiao Xin, is a higher-up of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.”
“He spent a lot of money and made Xiao Xin famous.
He even asked her to join the Sacred Heaven variety show, Desert Island survival, as a commentator.”
“However, last night, because General Manager Yu wanted to curry favor with Huaying Entertainment, he directly banned Xiao Xin’s live-stream that didn’t violate the rules!”
“That’s why I offended him!”
“That’s why everything is like this!”
This!
When everyone heard Liu Bo’s words, they suddenly looked at Yu Chengzhi.
They knew what was going on!
Why would the most popular female streamer be replaced?
Why were there so many complaints last night?
Why...
At that moment, everyone’s eyes were filled with anger.
Even Yu Jinghao’s eyes were dull.
Liu Bo briefly described the matter.
Yu Jinghao would really be stupid if he didn’t know where the problem was.
It was obvious that since such a powerful entertainment company like Sacred Heaven invited Xiao Xin as a commentator, Xiao Xin naturally had relations with the higher-ups of Sacred Heaven.
Many directors and higher-ups present sneered as they looked at the father and son.
Yu Jinghao looked at Yu Chengzhi beside him.
“Is what he said true?!”
“Dad, I didn’t expect a streamer to be so powerful.” Yu Chengzhi’s body began to tremble.
“Bastard!”
Pa!
With a crisp sound, Yu Jinghao slapped Yu Chengzhi’s face.
Although the Flying Fish live-stream platform was doing well, it was not monopolized by one family.
Instead, it was surrounded on all sides.
It had to develop steadily.
However, at this moment, such a thing happened.
How could the Flying Fish live-stream platform endure it!
Now, all the pillars of the Flying Fish live-stream platform had taken leave to stop broadcasting.
When the stock market opened, their shares plunged to the limit.
This was an omen of the Flying Fish live-stream platform’s collapse!
What should they do?
Even though Yu Jinghao had slapped Yu Chengzhi, the directors and executives present did not buy it.
They also had many shares in the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
Now that the situation had turned out like this, their money had become useless paper.
Severing someone’s path to wealth was like killing their parents!
Now, many people were staring at Yu Jinghao and Yu Chengzhi!
There had to be an explanation!
At the same time, a voice sounded from outside.
“Who are you?
You can’t enter.
There’s a board meeting here.
Who are you...”
The secretary’s anxious voice attracted the attention of the directors and higher-ups.
Everyone looked out and saw six or seven men and women in work clothes and briefcases walk in.
After entering the meeting room, everyone looked at the six or seven people in front of them.
All of them were in suits and leather shoes, especially the girl in the lead.
Her face was cold, like a frost beauty or an arrogant female CEO.
Just her looks and aura were terrifying enough!
This person was none other than Zhou Jingyi, who was now the operations manager of Sacred Heaven!
“Chairman Liu, right?
Hello, we’re from Sacred Heaven’s Operations Department.
I’m the manager of Sacred Heaven’s Operations Department, Zhou Jingyi...” Zhou Jingyi introduced briefly.
Then, she walked to the main seat and sat down!
For a moment, everyone looked at Zhou Jingyi and was shocked.
“This is a meeting among the higher-ups of Flying Fish!”
“What are you doing here?!
Get out!” Yu Jinghao looked at them and shouted angrily.
After all, he was the chairman of the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
This was a board meeting of the directors and higher-ups of Flying Fish.
Now that a group of strangers had barged in, it was simply a slap to his face.
However, as soon as he said this, Zhou Jingyi sneered, as if she took Yu Jinghao’s words as a joke.
“Chairman Yu, I think you still don’t understand the situation.”
“If I’m giving you face, I’d call you Chairman!”
“However, if I don’t give you face, you’re nothing!
You’re not even qualified to carry our shoes!”
Hiss!
As soon as these words were spoken, all the directors and executives present gasped.
They looked at Zhou Jingyi and their eyes could not help but widen.
They had never seen anyone dare to say such things to Yu Jinghao!
The entire place was silent!
The oppressive aura kept expanding!

chapters.title: Chapter 73: You’re Really Too Amazing!
paragraphs: Zhou Jingyi’s words simply shocked everyone.

They looked at Zhou Jingyi and their eyes widened. They thought, “Even if you’re from Sacred Heaven, you have to understand the situation clearly. This is an internal meeting of the Flying Fish live-stream platform. This is our home ground!”
However, Zhou Jingyi ignored their thoughts and took out a document from her briefcase. “Director Chen asked me to come this time.”
Director Chen?
The two of them made people feel immense pressure.

Among them, there was no lack of well-informed people. They had long heard that Director Chen of Sacred Heaven was doing well in the entire Jiang City. He had even obtained 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares and became the absolute controller of the entire Sacred Heaven!
Moreover, Director Chen was the big financial backer behind Xiao Xin!
These people who knew the news had cold sweat on their foreheads. They knew that Sacred Heaven would come sooner or later, but they didn’t expect it to come so quickly.
Zhou Jingyi naturally knew the whole story when she came this time. She also knew Xiao Xin, but this was not enough for her to have such an attitude towards the higher-ups of Flying Fish.
Another reason was that they had slapped Chen Yun’s face and became his enemies. The enemies of the entire Sacred Heaven naturally became her enemies!

In the past, she might have held back against her enemies. However, after training in Sacred Heaven for such a long time, she had already become swift and decisive. As long as she attacked, she would definitely destroy them!

“Everyone, there’s no need to explain my motive for coming this time, right?” Zhou Jingyi looked around, then her gaze swept to Yu Chengzhi, who was standing. “You must be General Manager Yu. Director Chen asked me to help him pass a message to you. You made him very unhappy.”
At this moment, Zhou Jingyi looked like a queen. This made Yu Jinghao, who had been scolding them and telling them to scram, feel a little afraid.
Yu Jinghao’s face was now extremely gloomy.

He had been drifting along in Shanghai for so many years, but at this moment, he could not show any aura. This was because they were now controlled by Sacred Heaven Entertainment. They were like small fish in Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s hands.

When Yu Jinghao thought of this, the corners of his mouth twitched in anger. He clenched his fists tightly. After a long time, he said coldly, “Does the Sacred Heaven really want to fight us to the death?!”
Hahahaha...

These words made Zhou Jingyi involuntarily cover her mouth and laugh. “Chairman Yu, I really didn’t expect you to still be able to say the words ‘fight to the death’ at this point. I find it ridiculous.”
“Do you still have the chips to fight us to the death now?!”
These words instantly choked the directors and higher-ups present.
That was right!
In the past, there might have been hope. They still had chips in their hands. After all, they were also a listed company.

However, now, all the streamers on the entire platform were in Sacred Heaven’s hands. Now, there were only a few small streamers streaming on Flying Fish. To put it bluntly, such a configuration was not even comparable to those late-night live-stream platforms online.
As long as the other party wanted to, they would die without a burial place!
They had no strength to resist at all!
The law of the jungle was the law of nature, which was naturally the law of the business world!
No one spoke, including Yu Jinghao, because they knew that what Zhou Jingyi said was true.
Beside him, Yu Chengzhi’s eyes widened when he heard Zhou Jingyi’s words. He said angrily, “Don’t go too far.”
He looked at Yu Jinghao. “Dad! I’ll call the young master of Huaying Entertainment now. Together with Huaying, we’re enough to fight them!”
As he spoke, he made a call to Su Yuncheng.
However, after a few rings, the other party hung up.
He did not pick it up at all.
For a moment, Yu Chengzhi’s strength seemed to have been drawn away. His eyes were filled with confusion. “How, how is this possible...”
At this moment, the directors and higher-ups, who had thought that there would be some hope, turned ashen.
Even Yu Jinghao was the same. He smiled bitterly. They had already become rats on the streets. How could Huaying help them?
Now, Sacred Heaven was definitely going to take them down.
For a moment, Yu Jinghao seemed to have aged ten years. He stood there and said, “If we lose, what conditions can you give us?”
“Very well.”

Zhou Jingyi’s lips curled into a smile. Then, she looked at the young man beside her. A young man walked up and looked at Yu Jinghao and the directors in front of him. “We’ll buy your shares for two yuan per share.”
The young man’s words were unquestionable and powerful.

He was Sacred Heaven’s professional negotiator. Since Yu Jinghao had already started to ask for their conditions, it meant that they had already given in. Since they had already given in, this was no longer their home ground. Sacred Heaven had the final say in this meeting room!
They would buy each share for two yuan per share!
For a moment, everyone widened their eyes and looked at the young man who spoke. Wasn’t this a joke?!
Previously, the Flying Fish stocks were worth more than 30 yuan each!
Now, they actually wanted to buy their shares at a super low price of two yuan per share?!
“Is this your idea?”
Yu Jinghao looked at Zhou Jingyi and asked in a low voice.
Zhou Jingyi looked relaxed. “I don’t have that much power. These are all Director Chen’s orders.”

“I really feel that it’s not worth it for you. Originally, Director Chen was already giving you enough face by spending ten million yuan on your platform. However, you slapped Director Chen in the face. I really admire your guts.”
“I don’t know if you don’t think highly of Director Chen or the entire Sacred Heaven!”

Everything Zhou Jingyi said was true. If not for what happened last night, Chen Yun would not have been interested in setting up a live-stream platform at all. It was not that he did not dare to, but he was disdainful!
“We can’t agree!”

“You don’t agree? That’s good.” Zhou Jingyi stood up. “According to your current stock market, you’ll close down in less than three days. At that time, I’ll see how you can pay the sky-high default fees of those streamers. If you can’t afford it, you’ll have to sell everything! You’ll sell your houses and go to jail! Directors, don’t you think so?”
With that, Zhou Jingyi led her people out.
All the directors looked at Zhou Jingyi’s figure with mixed feelings. One of the directors stood up and hurriedly called out, “Manager Zhou, please wait.”
For a moment, a few more directors stood up. “Manager Zhou, can I treat you to a meal at noon?”
“Manager Zhou...”
In just a few seconds, almost all the directors stood up and chased after Zhou Jingyi.
When Yu Jinghao saw this scene, his eyes almost popped out of their sockets! He was prepared to stop them.
“Get lost!”
“Yu Jinghao, if it weren’t for your damned son, we wouldn’t have fallen to this state!”
“Just you wait, we’re not done!”
Various scoldings suddenly sounded, and Yu Jinghao was also pushed down by everyone.

Meanwhile, Liu Bo slowly stood up. The corners of his mouth curled into a cold smile as he slowly walked in front of Yu Chengzhi. “General Manager Yu, you’re really too awesome. You tricked your damned father.”
With that, he laughed and walked out.
Only Yu Chengzhi was left standing on the spot, trembling with anger!

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Let’s See If It Can Withstand the Gust!
paragraphs: At this moment, Yu Chengzhi looked at Yu Jinghao beside him. “Dad, what should we do now? We can’t just sit around and wait for death!”
“Dad, say something!”

Yu Chengzhi grabbed Yu Jinghao’s shoulders and shook them desperately. He was now relying on Flying Fish and his position as the general manager to show off. Every night, he had different female streamers accompanying him. If Flying Fish fell, what right did he have to do this?!
Not only would he lose his women, but most importantly, he would also lose his money and status!
It was easy to go from a simple life to an extravagant one, but difficult to go from an extravagant life to a frugal life!
“Dad! Say something! What should we do?!”
In the next moment, Yu Jinghao pushed Yu Chengzhi’s hand away.
Then, he slapped Yu Chenghi!
Pa!
One slap!
He directly drew blood from the corner of Yu Chengzhi’s mouth!
“Unfilial son! How did I give birth to such a blind beast like you?!”
“Get lost! Get lost immediately!”
Yu Jinghao spoke. Then, after his anger subsided, he collapsed onto the boss chair. He knew that everything was over!
Everything he had was gone!
What bargaining chip did he have now? Without Flying Fish, he was nothing!
At this moment, in an office on the highest floor of the Huaying Entertainment Building, a girl walked in with documents.
Su Yuncheng looked at the girl in front of him. “Have you investigated?”
“Yes, Chairman Su, Sacred Heaven has already taken down the Flying Fish live-stream platform.”
What?!
Su Yuncheng stood up for a moment and took the documents from the girl. He slowly read it.
He did not answer Yu Chengzhi’s call previously because he did not want to get into trouble. Secondly, he wanted to fight to the death with Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
However, he did not expect the Flying Fish live-stream platform to submit directly!
“F*ck, trash!” Su Yuncheng threw the documents in front of him to the ground.
This time, Sacred Heaven had simply picked up a huge bargain. They had paid a price that was almost nonexistent to obtain the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
Moreover, if the Flying Fish was allowed to recover from this attack by itself, it would probably take a few years to recover. However, it was different when they were in the hands of Sacred Heaven.

Sacred Heaven had a terrifying Public Relations Department. Moreover, they still had the trump card of the Desert Island Survival show. When the time came, they would clear their name and introduce the Desert Island Survival show to the live-stream platform. At that time, this live-stream platform would reorganize.
They could still maintain their previous top-notch standards in China!
This time, the gap between them and Sacred Heaven widened again!
“Damn it!”
Su Yuncheng took a deep breath. His face was extremely dark.
Meanwhile, after Zhou Jingyi completed the mission given by Chen Yun, she returned to the Sacred Heaven Headquarters.
“Director Chen, CEO Ma, the acquisition mission has been completed. What do you think we should do next?” As Zhou Jingyi spoke, she handed over the documents in her hand.
She called Chen Yun by his name in private, but now, she still had to call him Director Chen.
Chen Yun took a look and nodded.

“How about this? Change the name of Flying Fish Live-Stream to Tianyun Live-Stream and start to salvage their reputation. Get those streamers to stream again.” Chen Yun made the arrangements and then looked at Zhou Jingyi. “Jingyi, has Liu Bo contacted you?”
“Manager Liu contacted me.”

“How about this? On one hand, you’ll take care of the Operations Department. On the other hand, you’ll watch over Tianyun Live-Stream. Leave the operations to Liu Bo. I’ll leave the human resources to you. You must treat the people better than them. We don’t raise useless people here.”

Zhou Jingyi had nothing to say about Chen Yun’s words. Liu Bo had many veterans who knew how to operate live-stream platforms. If not for Yu Chengzhi suppressing them from above, they would have long let the Flying Fish live-stream platform soar.
Zhou Jingyi nodded and looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, Huaying and the Su family seem to be behind Flying Fish’s actions this time.”
The Su family?
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered. The Su family seemed to be really dishonest.
“Ma Ke, quickly organize a copy of materials about the Su family for me.”
“Alright, Director Chen.” As Ma Ke spoke, he frowned. “Director Chen, what do you mean? Are you going to touch the Su family?”
Looking at Ma Ke’s expression, Chen Yun chuckled. “Why? What’s wrong with the Su family?”

Although Chen Yun had a smile on his face, his eyes were already cold. Ever since Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei joined forces to snatch the jade seal, he had already put the Su family on his blacklist.

“This... This Su family is considered an old family in Jiang City. Previously, they were a family faction. After establishing Huaying, they became one of the top families in Jiang City after two generations of management. Therefore, they have a foundation of decades. They have a wide network in Jiang City.”

“As a large company, many companies are inextricably linked to them. They either collaborate or interact with them. In addition, the Su family not only has Huaying, but they also have many businesses, so their roots are widespread.”

“We naturally have the ability and confidence to take down Huaying. However, if we want to deal with the Su family, Director Chen, we have to plan carefully. Let’s put it this way. The entire Su family is like a towering tree nailed to Jiang City! They hold up the sky and their roots are everywhere. If we want to pull out this tree, I’m afraid the entire Jiang City will tremble.”
With a few words, Ma Ke summarized the current situation of the Su family in Jiang City.

When Chen Yun heard this, he nodded. After all, many companies relied on the Su family to survive. Cutting off their path to wealth was like killing their parents. If Chen Yun really wanted to uproot the Su family, who knew how many companies would jump out to stop him or stand against Sacred Heaven.
“In that case, take a look at this.” Chen Yun took out a small jar from his pocket. There was a blue liquid inside that was extremely demonic. It was none other than the antioxidant water.
Of course, Chen Yun named it the Heavenly Spirit Water.
“Try drinking it.”
This...
Ma Ke looked at the Heavenly Spirit Water Chen Yun handed over and looked at the color. He was a little hesitant, but in an instant, he opened it and drank it.
In an instant, a refreshing feeling filled his entire body.

The soreness from sitting in the office for a long time immediately disappeared. The pain in his spine and neck also eased a lot. He seemed to be filled with vitality, as if every cell had been awakened.
It was as if his body had become ten years younger in a few seconds!
“What is this, Director Chen!” Ma Ke’s eyes were filled with excitement. This thing was good!
It was simply like a miracle pill. If this thing was revealed to the public, it would definitely be sold for an astronomical price!
If this could be mass-produced, its value would be immeasurable!
At that moment, he looked at Chen Yun like an ancient official looking at an emperor. His eyes were filled with respect!

Chen Yun looked at Ma Ke’s eyes and immediately chuckled. “Don’t think about it. This thing can’t be mass-produced. There can only be a small portion, so we have to employ our limited resources to where they are needed most. Anyway, isn’t the Su family a big family with widespread roots?”
“I want you to use this to pull out their roots one by one.”
“When the time comes, I’ll see if a rootless tree can withstand the gust!”

Su Yuncheng stood up for a moment and took the documents from the girl.
He slowly read it.
He did not answer Yu Chengzhi’s call previously because he did not want to get into trouble.
Secondly, he wanted to fight to the death with Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
However, he did not expect the Flying Fish live-stream platform to submit directly!
“F*ck, trash!” Su Yuncheng threw the documents in front of him to the ground.
This time, Sacred Heaven had simply picked up a huge bargain.
They had paid a price that was almost nonexistent to obtain the Flying Fish live-stream platform.
Moreover, if the Flying Fish was allowed to recover from this attack by itself, it would probably take a few years to recover.
However, it was different when they were in the hands of Sacred Heaven.
Sacred Heaven had a terrifying Public Relations Department.
Moreover, they still had the trump card of the Desert Island Survival show.
When the time came, they would clear their name and introduce the Desert Island Survival show to the live-stream platform.
At that time, this live-stream platform would reorganize.
They could still maintain their previous top-notch standards in China!
This time, the gap between them and Sacred Heaven widened again!
“Damn it!”
Su Yuncheng took a deep breath.
His face was extremely dark.
Meanwhile, after Zhou Jingyi completed the mission given by Chen Yun, she returned to the Sacred Heaven Headquarters.
“Director Chen, CEO Ma, the acquisition mission has been completed.
What do you think we should do next?” As Zhou Jingyi spoke, she handed over the documents in her hand.
She called Chen Yun by his name in private, but now, she still had to call him Director Chen.
Chen Yun took a look and nodded.
“How about this?
Change the name of Flying Fish Live-Stream to Tianyun Live-Stream and start to salvage their reputation.
Get those streamers to stream again.” Chen Yun made the arrangements and then looked at Zhou Jingyi.
“Jingyi, has Liu Bo contacted you?”
“Manager Liu contacted me.”
“How about this?
On one hand, you’ll take care of the Operations Department.
On the other hand, you’ll watch over Tianyun Live-Stream.
Leave the operations to Liu Bo.
I’ll leave the human resources to you.
You must treat the people better than them.
We don’t raise useless people here.”
Zhou Jingyi had nothing to say about Chen Yun’s words.
Liu Bo had many veterans who knew how to operate live-stream platforms.
If not for Yu Chengzhi suppressing them from above, they would have long let the Flying Fish live-stream platform soar.
Zhou Jingyi nodded and looked at Chen Yun.
“Director Chen, Huaying and the Su family seem to be behind Flying Fish’s actions this time.”
The Su family?
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered.
The Su family seemed to be really dishonest.
“Ma Ke, quickly organize a copy of materials about the Su family for me.”
“Alright, Director Chen.” As Ma Ke spoke, he frowned.
“Director Chen, what do you mean?
Are you going to touch the Su family?”
Looking at Ma Ke’s expression, Chen Yun chuckled.
“Why?
What’s wrong with the Su family?”
Although Chen Yun had a smile on his face, his eyes were already cold.
Ever since Su Yuncheng and Kawakaze Kei joined forces to snatch the jade seal, he had already put the Su family on his blacklist.
“This...
This Su family is considered an old family in Jiang City.
Previously, they were a family faction.
After establishing Huaying, they became one of the top families in Jiang City after two generations of management.
Therefore, they have a foundation of decades.
They have a wide network in Jiang City.”
“As a large company, many companies are inextricably linked to them.
They either collaborate or interact with them.
In addition, the Su family not only has Huaying, but they also have many businesses, so their roots are widespread.”
“We naturally have the ability and confidence to take down Huaying.
However, if we want to deal with the Su family, Director Chen, we have to plan carefully.
Let’s put it this way.
The entire Su family is like a towering tree nailed to Jiang City!
They hold up the sky and their roots are everywhere.
If we want to pull out this tree, I’m afraid the entire Jiang City will tremble.”
With a few words, Ma Ke summarized the current situation of the Su family in Jiang City.
When Chen Yun heard this, he nodded.
After all, many companies relied on the Su family to survive.
Cutting off their path to wealth was like killing their parents.
If Chen Yun really wanted to uproot the Su family, who knew how many companies would jump out to stop him or stand against Sacred Heaven.
“In that case, take a look at this.” Chen Yun took out a small jar from his pocket.
There was a blue liquid inside that was extremely demonic.
It was none other than the antioxidant water.
Of course, Chen Yun named it the Heavenly Spirit Water.
“Try drinking it.”
This...
Ma Ke looked at the Heavenly Spirit Water Chen Yun handed over and looked at the color.
He was a little hesitant, but in an instant, he opened it and drank it.
In an instant, a refreshing feeling filled his entire body.
The soreness from sitting in the office for a long time immediately disappeared.
The pain in his spine and neck also eased a lot.
He seemed to be filled with vitality, as if every cell had been awakened.
It was as if his body had become ten years younger in a few seconds!
“What is this, Director Chen!” Ma Ke’s eyes were filled with excitement.
This thing was good!
It was simply like a miracle pill.
If this thing was revealed to the public, it would definitely be sold for an astronomical price!
If this could be mass-produced, its value would be immeasurable!
At that moment, he looked at Chen Yun like an ancient official looking at an emperor.
His eyes were filled with respect!
Chen Yun looked at Ma Ke’s eyes and immediately chuckled.
“Don’t think about it.
This thing can’t be mass-produced.
There can only be a small portion, so we have to employ our limited resources to where they are needed most.
Anyway, isn’t the Su family a big family with widespread roots?”
“I want you to use this to pull out their roots one by one.”
“When the time comes, I’ll see if a rootless tree can withstand the gust!”

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Genius!
paragraphs: After hearing this sentence, whether it was Ma Ke or Zhou Jingyi, disbelief appeared on their faces. However, Ma Ke still packed the bottles of Heavenly Spirit Water that Chen Yun had given him. After all, this might be a secret weapon.

Over the next few days, Ma Ke handed over a portion of the rights to Zhou Jingyi. Then, Zhou Jingyi began to reorganize Tianyun Live-Stream. A large number of streamers resumed streaming. Sacred Heaven even spent 300 million yuan for the users they had lost to return.
Coupled with the Desert Island Survival live-stream at the top of the homepage, the Tianyun Live-Stream app obtained a score above eight points in the various app stores.
What a joke!
What business did Sacred Heaven engage in?
They had the people!
They had the money!
As long as they had money, they would have a good app and a good user interface!
They would also use money to clear their name and bring their users back!
“Isn’t this streamer on Tianyun Live-Stream the same as the one on Flying Fish Live-Stream?”
“Haven’t you heard? Flying Fish Live-Stream closed down. Tianyun Live-Stream is a new platform. Moreover, they even invested a red packet of 300 million yuan recently.”
“Let me try it.” The person beside him downloaded it skeptically. After opening it, his eyes lit up. “F*ck! This is the first time I’ve seen such a gorgeous user interface. I love it!”

In terms of operations, Liu Bo was even more involved. He promoted new streamers while ensuring that the old streamers were provided with recommended spots. The entire Tianyun Live-Stream was thriving. In just a few days, it had already exceeded the scale of Flying Fish Live-Stream. Moreover, after a few events, they had earned back 300 million yuan from hunger marketing.
The rise of Tianyun Live-Stream allowed Zhou Jingyi to have a place in Sacred Heaven.
This time, no one looked down on this former little apprentice. It was this little apprentice who had grown so quickly in such a short period of time!
From a newcomer, she had grown into an extremely mature and experienced manager. She was ruthless and knew how to use people. She was famous in the entire Sacred Heaven.
Ma Ke looked at the report Zhou Jingyi handed over and smiled bitterly. “Manager Zhou, if you continue like this, my position will be snatched away by you.”

“Master, how dare I snatch your seat?” Zhou Jingyi rolled her eyes. “The reason I’m where I am today is because you taught me step by step. Others don’t know, but I don’t know. I haven’t even learned much compared to you.”
Haha.
Ma Ke laughed loudly. “We’re all responsible for Director Chen and serve the board of directors. This is our duty.”
“Master, I understand.” Zhou Jingyi took the report and turned to leave. Coincidentally, someone knocked on the door. After Zhou Jingyi opened it, she looked at the person. “CEO Jiang, you’re here.”
“Aiya, Manager Zhou, long time no see.”

The person who came was none other than Jiang Zhengyu. At this moment, he looked at Zhou Jingyi with a smile on his face. After all, he was not someone who worked behind closed doors. He naturally knew that such a management talent had recently risen in Sacred Heaven. Moreover, he was Ma Ke’s personal disciple and someone Director Chen trusted.
Such a person naturally had to build a good relationship with her.
He stretched out his hand, and Zhou Jingyi shook it.
“CEO Jiang, you can talk to my master. I still have some things to do. Excuse me.”
“Okay.” Jiang Zhengyu looked at Zhou Jingyi’s back and then at Ma Ke, who was walking over. “You really have a good disciple.”

“Jingyi was brought over by Director Chen. To be honest, I didn’t expect her to grow so quickly. It’s as if she was born with prior training. Such a person is not called a talent, but a genius!” Ma Ke looked at Jiang Zhengyu. Then, he asked him to sit down and poured him a cup of tea.
“CEO Ma, why did you call me here today?”
Jiang Zhengyu was from the military, so he naturally liked to be straightforward.
Ma Ke stretched out his hand and placed a small bottle on the table. “Look at this.”
Jiang Zhengyu looked at the small bottle in front of him, his eyes filled with confusion.
“Director Chen asked me to give this to you. Try it. It’s good stuff.”

Jiang Zhengyu looked at Ma Ke’s yearning gaze as he looked at the bottle. He could not believe what he was seeing. As the CEO of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke had seen everything. He actually had such a yearning gaze for this blue liquid now.
Needless to say, this thing was definitely good stuff!
Without any doubts, Jiang Zhengyu picked up the bottle. “Then I won’t refuse.”
He drank it all in one gulp.
The next moment, Jiang Zhengyu’s eyes widened. This!
This feeling!
It was as if a bomb had exploded in his body!
A refreshing feeling filled his entire body!
Moreover, his entire body became light!
Not only that, but the pain from his previous military career also gradually disappeared!
This was too magical!
Moreover, the effect of this thing was still continuing!
Jiang Zhengyu suddenly stood up and looked at Ma Ke. “CEO Ma, where did you get this thing? I’ll buy some. State your price!”
Haha.
“Director Chen gave this to me. It’s priceless.” Ma Ke looked at Jiang Zhengyu’s expression and smiled. Then, he instructed him.
Gradually, he understood, but then he smiled. He was originally on Sacred Heaven’s side. With this thing, he saw Director Chen’s strength!
His determination became even stronger!

“CEO Jiang, I do have more of these things, but I can’t give them to you. I have other uses for these things. If you really want them, you might as well visit Director Chen.” Ma Ke pointed out a clear path for Jiang Zhengyu.

After Jiang Zhengyu heard this, he slapped his head. “Look at my brain. However, although Director Chen is younger than me, every time I see him, I feel a sense of fear. It’s as if I’m talking to my superior in the military.”
That aura, that aura!
It was simply too shocking!
Even though he was born in the military and had been drifting along in Shanghai for so many years, he could not resist how sharp Chen Yun was!
When Ma Ke heard this, he smiled. Jiang Zhengyu was like this, but so was he.
“Alright, I’ll go back and prepare some expensive gifts to visit Director Chen.” Jiang Zhengyu was swift and decisive. After making the decision, he walked out.
“Sigh, Old Jiang.” Ma Ke shook his head.
Meanwhile, in Villa No. 3, Chen Yun was drinking tea in the courtyard with a purple clay pot.
Under the big tree, the fragrance of tea filled the air. Coupled with the magnificent scenery of the courtyard, it was simply too satisfying.

chapters.title: Chapter 76: You and Him Are Not on the Same Level!
paragraphs: “Brother! What are you doing?”
Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun, who was lying on a rattan chair under the tree and drinking tea. She had a helpless expression. “Why did you step into old age early?”
“Come, shall we have tea together?” Chen Yun waved the teacup in his hand.
“No, no. Xiao Xue and I still have to practice. Do you want to come and take a look?”

“No. By the way, you guys are about to take the art exam, right? After the art exam, let’s take some time to go home and take a look,” said Chen Yun. After all, he had not been home for such a long time. He also missed it.
Chen Mengmeng suddenly nodded. “Okay.”
She missed home too.
On the other side, Chen Yun’s phone rang. It was Jiang Zhengyu.
After ending the call with Jiang Zhengyu, Chen Yun stood up from the recliner. After all, there would be guests at home later.
“Mengmeng, there will be guests at home later. It’s CEO Jiang Zhengyu of Cauldron Dragon Security. Prepare for them. In the meantime, I’ll go out and pick them up.”
“Alright, Brother.”
Chen Yun pressed a button at the entrance. Soon, a sightseeing bus arrived at the entrance of the villa.
“Mr. Chen, please get in the car.”
“Okay.”
Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was known as the number one luxurious district in Jiang City. It was not only reflected in the houses and location.
There was even a property management company that was more considerate than Haidilao!
Here, the owners were undoubtedly God.

For example, if Chen Yun did not pick Jiang Zhengyu up or did not instruct the property management, Jiang Zhengyu would definitely not be able to enter. Without the permission of the owner, even if the heavens came, they would definitely not let him in!
The property management here was very serious and responsible.
Of course, the property management fee was not cheap either.
Without money, who would be willing to serve the house owners like a servant?

When Chen Yun reached the entrance, Jiang Zhengyu had yet to come over. After strolling outside for a while, they saw Jiang Zhengyu’s Maybach drive over. It was a million-dollar Maybach, but it could only be parked in the public parking lot outside.
Chen Yun walked over and the few of them alighted.
“Director Chen.”
“Brother Yun.”
“Big Brother.”
The three of them spoke at the same time. They were none other than Jiang Zhengyu, Jiang Shouheng, and Jiang Lai.
Just as Jiang Zhengyu had said, he really didn’t dare to come alone, so he brought these two along.
Chen Yun looked at the things in their hands. “Just come. Why did you bring these things along?”

“It’s just a small gift to show my respect.” Jiang Zhengyu looked at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion in front of him and smiled bitterly. “The property management here is really good. If outsiders like us want to enter, unless the master comes to pick us up, it’s absolutely impossible.”
“The houses here are also luxurious enough. It’s enough to be the most luxurious villa area in Jiang City. It makes me want to buy a house here.”
“CEO Jiang, don’t be humble. I’ve heard about your mansion behind Cauldron Dragon Security. A mansion of that scale is bigger than any villa here.”
Jiang Zhengyu sighed. How could he have the confidence to show off in front of Chen Yun?!
If Chen Yun only had Villa No. 3 of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, his villa might be comparable. However, damn it! The East Mountain Villa belonged to him now!
No matter how big his villa was, could it be as big as the East Mountain Villa?
What a joke!
“Alright, stop standing around. Let’s go in.”
Chen Yun turned around and happened to see a car in the distance. It was Auntie Song’s E-Class Mercedes-Benz.
Oh?
Why were they here?
Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu and the other two and smiled. “You guys go in first. Go to Villa No. 3. There’s someone at home. Take a seat first. I have something on.”
“Alright, Director Chen, go ahead.” Jiang Zhengyu had no objections and brought the two of them into the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
The security guard looked at Chen Yun’s gesture and naturally let Jiang Zhengyu and the other two pass.
He sent them to Villa No. 3.

On the E-Class Mercedes-Benz, Wang Yuanyuan looked at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion with envy in her eyes. “If I had known earlier, I would have followed Dad in to take a look. This is the most luxurious neighborhood in Jiang City.”
“That’s why I said that if you work hard to buy a house here, I might be able to benefit from it in the future,” said Auntie Song with a smile.

Wang Yuanyuan rolled her eyes and looked to the side. She happened to see Chen Yun welcoming Jiang Zhengyu and the other two in the parking lot. She did not know Jiang Zhengyu, but she saw Jiang Shouheng. This young man was the young man who had walked with Zheng Jianghao at the East Mountain Villa that day. Moreover, when she saw the Maybach they were sitting in and the “Jiang AA58888” license plate, she knew that this was not an ordinary car.
At this moment, seeing Chen Yun walking towards them, Wang Yuanyuan and Auntie Song got out of the car.
“Auntie Song.” Chen Yun greeted Auntie Song, who looked surprised. “Xiao Yun, what are you doing here?”
“I just picked up a few friends.”
Friends?
Auntie Song glanced at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. She did not expect Xiao Yun to have friends living in such a place.
Meanwhile, Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun and snorted.
She walked towards Chen Yun and pulled him away.
Hey!
“This girl.” Auntie Song looked at the two of them and smiled bitterly. It seemed that the last time she let the two of them go out to play, they had progressed quickly. However, this was also good.
She watched as Wang Yuanyuan pulled Chen Yun away and naturally turned around to get into the car.
In the distance, Chen Yun looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “Why did you pull me over?”
“I really didn’t expect you to be so bold. You’re bragging more and more.” Wang Yuanyuan snorted. “Your friend lives here? Which of the three people just now was your friend?”
“That’s none of your business.” Chen Yun looked at Wang Yuanyuan and sneered. If she wasn’t Auntie Song’s daughter, he definitely wouldn’t have said anything to her.
“Moreover, you said something wrong. It’s not my friend who lives here, but me!”
“Heh!”
He lived here?
Did he know what place this was?!
It was Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, the most luxurious villa area in Jiang City!
Any one of the villas was worth tens of millions or hundreds of millions!
Who were the people living here?! They were all high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City!
How could he say that he lived here? It was simply ridiculous!
Wang Yuanyuan sneered. “There’s only the two of us here. Are you still going to be stubborn?!”
“I know the young man among the three people just now. That person can walk side by side with Zheng Jianghao. His identity must be extraordinary, but so what? He’s him, and you’re you.”

“You just blindly went up to him like this and even said that you are closer than friends. Do you know how big the gap between the two of you is? People like them are all arrogant. Think about it carefully. Why did they help you settle Tan Zekun at the club that day? Wasn’t it because they saw that you could fight?!”

“Wake up. They just want you to be their underling and their fighter!” Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun and spoke as if she expected better from him. “Do you think they will really treat you as a friend? We’re not on the same level as them.”
