A mansion of that scale is bigger than any villa here.”
Jiang Zhengyu sighed.
How could he have the confidence to show off in front of Chen Yun?!
If Chen Yun only had Villa No.
3 of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, his villa might be comparable.
However, damn it!
The East Mountain Villa belonged to him now!
No matter how big his villa was, could it be as big as the East Mountain Villa?
What a joke!
“Alright, stop standing around.
Let’s go in.”
Chen Yun turned around and happened to see a car in the distance.
It was Auntie Song’s E-Class Mercedes-Benz.
Oh?
Why were they here?
Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu and the other two and smiled.
“You guys go in first.
Go to Villa No.
There’s someone at home.
Take a seat first.
I have something on.”
“Alright, Director Chen, go ahead.” Jiang Zhengyu had no objections and brought the two of them into the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
The security guard looked at Chen Yun’s gesture and naturally let Jiang Zhengyu and the other two pass.
He sent them to Villa No.
On the E-Class Mercedes-Benz, Wang Yuanyuan looked at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion with envy in her eyes.
“If I had known earlier, I would have followed Dad in to take a look.
This is the most luxurious neighborhood in Jiang City.”
“That’s why I said that if you work hard to buy a house here, I might be able to benefit from it in the future,” said Auntie Song with a smile.
Wang Yuanyuan rolled her eyes and looked to the side.
She happened to see Chen Yun welcoming Jiang Zhengyu and the other two in the parking lot.
She did not know Jiang Zhengyu, but she saw Jiang Shouheng.
This young man was the young man who had walked with Zheng Jianghao at the East Mountain Villa that day.
Moreover, when she saw the Maybach they were sitting in and the “Jiang AA58888” license plate, she knew that this was not an ordinary car.
At this moment, seeing Chen Yun walking towards them, Wang Yuanyuan and Auntie Song got out of the car.
“Auntie Song.” Chen Yun greeted Auntie Song, who looked surprised.
“Xiao Yun, what are you doing here?”
“I just picked up a few friends.”
Friends?
Auntie Song glanced at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
She did not expect Xiao Yun to have friends living in such a place.
Meanwhile, Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun and snorted.
She walked towards Chen Yun and pulled him away.
Hey!
“This girl.” Auntie Song looked at the two of them and smiled bitterly.
It seemed that the last time she let the two of them go out to play, they had progressed quickly.
However, this was also good.
She watched as Wang Yuanyuan pulled Chen Yun away and naturally turned around to get into the car.
In the distance, Chen Yun looked at Wang Yuanyuan.
“Why did you pull me over?”
“I really didn’t expect you to be so bold.
You’re bragging more and more.” Wang Yuanyuan snorted.
“Your friend lives here?
Which of the three people just now was your friend?”
“That’s none of your business.” Chen Yun looked at Wang Yuanyuan and sneered.
If she wasn’t Auntie Song’s daughter, he definitely wouldn’t have said anything to her.
“Moreover, you said something wrong.
It’s not my friend who lives here, but me!”
“Heh!”
He lived here?
Did he know what place this was?!
It was Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, the most luxurious villa area in Jiang City!
Any one of the villas was worth tens of millions or hundreds of millions!
Who were the people living here?!
They were all high-ranking officials and nobles in Jiang City!
How could he say that he lived here?
It was simply ridiculous!
Wang Yuanyuan sneered.
“There’s only the two of us here.
Are you still going to be stubborn?!”
“I know the young man among the three people just now.
That person can walk side by side with Zheng Jianghao.
His identity must be extraordinary, but so what?
He’s him, and you’re you.”
“You just blindly went up to him like this and even said that you are closer than friends.
Do you know how big the gap between the two of you is?
People like them are all arrogant.
Think about it carefully.
Why did they help you settle Tan Zekun at the club that day?
Wasn’t it because they saw that you could fight?!”
“Wake up.
They just want you to be their underling and their fighter!” Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun and spoke as if she expected better from him.
“Do you think they will really treat you as a friend?
We’re not on the same level as them.”

chapters.title: Chapter 77: I’m Waiting Online, It’s Quite Urgent!
paragraphs: As she spoke, Wang Yuanyuan became agitated. Previously, at the fitness fighting club, she was indeed shocked by Chen Yun. However, later on, when she saw Chen Yun and Zheng Jianghao together, she instantly understood.

That day, it was Zheng Jianghao who finally settled the matter. She had overestimated Chen Yun. Come to think of it, how could a poor boy from a small county be able to settle a rich young master like Tan Zekun, the young master of Jiang City?!

However, what was laughable was that Chen Yun really thought that Zheng Jianghao had settled the matter for him to befriend him. Who was Zheng Jianghao? What could someone who could settle Tan Zekun want from Chen Yun? It was only because of his skills!

Now, although Zheng Jianghao and the others were on good terms with him and addressed him as a friend, to put it bluntly, Chen Yun was now a dog of those young masters. He was at their mercy and could be played by others!
“Are you really willing to work for others for the rest of your life?! Can you work harder yourself?!”
“I didn’t expect you to be such a person!”
Wang Yuanyuan snorted and looked at Chen Yun.
However, she saw Chen Yun looking at her with a smile on his face. His eyes were filled with mockery, as if he was looking at an idiot.
For a moment, Wang Yuanyuan was furious!
Meanwhile, Wang Qing also walked out of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion and looked at the man beside him with a respectful expression.
“Secretary Wang, am I really not able to see CEO Lin today?” Wang Qing asked regretfully.
The man chuckled and shook his head. “CEO Lin is very busy every day. Not everyone can meet him. In the future, if there’s a chance in the future, I’ll tell CEO Lin about what I’ve given you.”
“Then... Alright, sorry to trouble you, Secretary Wang.” As he spoke, Wang Qing took out an envelope from his pocket. “Secretary Wang, this is a token of appreciation.”
“What do you mean?” Secretary Wang frowned.
“It’s just a small gift.” Wang Qing smiled apologetically.
“You’re really interesting.” Secretary Wang laughed. “Alright, your wife is already waiting. Go back first.”

Wang Qing nodded and turned around. His face was cold and stern. He wanted to climb up. CEO Lin was the only shortcut. However, his status was too low. He had not seen him a few times. He did not know what would happen after giving this heavy gift.
Even such a heavy gift made his heart ache.
Just now, he was smiling apologetically. How could his expression be good now?
After getting into the car, Auntie Song sighed when she saw Wang Qing’s expression. Then, she honked.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “You can’t interfere in my matters. Are you saying that they want me to be their underling? That’s really impossible. Your horizons are too low.”
“You!”
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun, her eyes almost spewing fire!

“Alright, my horizons are low! Chen Yun, don’t think that you can rely on Zheng Jianghao and the other young masters for the rest of your life. In the end, you’ll realize that you’re nothing without them!”
After Wang Yuanyuan finished her last sentence, she ran towards the Mercedes-Benz.
After getting into the car, Wang Yuanyuan’s expression was extremely ugly.
Auntie Song looked at her. “What’s wrong? Did you have a bad chat with Xiao Yun?”
“Heh, he only knows how to brag and curry favor with the powerful!”
Wang Yuanyuan spoke fiercely.
Beside them, Wang Qing looked at the two of them. “Huh? You saw Chen Yun here?”
“That’s right! I might as well not see him. He even said that my horizons are too low!”

These words amused Wang Qing. He thought to himself, “Kids nowadays don’t know the situation at all. However, this is good. It’s good that they broke up. Otherwise, if he really fell in love with Yuanyuan, I would have to break up the couple.”
After all, Wang Qing would never allow his daughter to fall in love and marry a poor boy from a small county!
“Alright, stop talking.” Auntie Song glared at Wang Yuanyuan. Then, she smiled and waved at Chen Yun in the distance. She stepped on the accelerator and drove away.

Chen Yun looked at the Mercedes-Benz that was leaving and recalled Wang Yuanyuan’s words. He shook his head. If he was still the same as before, he would definitely be so shocked by Wang Yuanyuan’s words that he would not be able to raise his head. However, now, he had listened to Wang Yuanyuan’s words.
It was simply ridiculous!
How could a sparrow understand the ambition of a swan?!
How would she know his current status?!
At this moment, in the villa, Han Xue and Chen Mengmeng welcomed the three members of the Jiang family.
“CEO Jiang, have some tea.” Chen Mengmeng poured tea for Jiang Zhengyu and handed them fruit platters, dried fruits, and so on.

Jiang Zhengyu was a little flattered by Chen Mengmeng’s thoughtfulness. For the first time in his life, he felt uneasy. He could not help but sigh. The upbringing of the Chen family was still good. The sister of such a big chairman knew so much about hospitality.
In comparison, his son was hopeless.
For a moment, he looked at Jiang Shouheng. Jiang Shouheng met his father’s gaze and immediately pouted. “Dad, why are you looking at me like that?”
“Don’t you know why I’m looking at you?!”
Jiang Shouheng was also speechless.

Jiang Zhengyu did not say anything and stood up. “This is the first time I’ve come to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. It’s also the first time I’ve seen such a luxurious villa in my life. It’s really eye-catching.”
He was stunned when he was outside the main entrance. When he entered the main villa, he was even more shocked.
As soon as he entered, he saw a golden cauldron placed there!
How shocking!
What kind of family could have such decorations?
Needless to say, he saw a few antiques as far as the eye could see. According to his judgment, these antiques were definitely worth more than ten million yuan!
When Chen Mengmeng saw Jiang Zhengyu get up, she accompanied him.
“Director Chen’s house is really imposing.”
After Jiang Zhengyu took a few glances, he could not help but sigh. Then, he glanced over and suddenly exclaimed in surprise. He stared at a place and his eyes could not help but widen.
“This!”
“What is this?!”

This cry of surprise made Jiang Shouheng stand up involuntarily. “Dad, why are you always shouting today? Didn’t I tell you that Director Chen bought a few things at the auction? Why are you still so agitated?”
He looked at Jiang Zhengyu and saw him walking quickly to a table. He looked at the vase placed on it and was on the brink of tears.
“This, this is a blue-and-white porcelain vase worth hundreds of millions of yuan. Who is it? Who was so careless? Who poured water and arranged flowers inside?”
In short, he was cynical!
Chen Mengmeng was speechless. She was very flustered and felt that this old man would hit her. What should she do?
She thought, “I’m waiting online, it’s quite urgent!”

chapters.title: Chapter 78: Picked Up a Chef?
paragraphs: Just as Jiang Zhengyu was feeling excited, Chen Yun walked in.
“Mengmeng, why didn’t you arrange for the guests to sit?” Chen Yun glanced at her.
“Director Chen, you’re back.” Jiang Zhengyu quickly changed his expression. “No, no. It has nothing to do with Miss Chen. I’ve never seen such a luxurious hall, so I stood up to take a look.”
“However, Director Chen, this... is too much.” Jiang Zhengyu pointed at the vase in front of him. “Do you know what this is?”
Chen Yun looked at the blue-and-white porcelain vase and nodded slightly. “It’s a blue-and-white porcelain vase.”
“Do you know how much such an item can be sold for?”
“About a hundred million.” Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu. “It’s for decoration. Is there a problem?”
Jiang Zhengyu was speechless.
He was ruthless! He was really ruthless!
A vase worth more than a hundred million yuan was filled with water and flowers.
He even said that it was used for decoration!
Even Jiang Shouheng, who was beside him, widened his eyes and looked at the vase. He simply could not believe what he had heard!
This was a f*cking blue-and-white porcelain vase?!
When he first entered, he only thought that this was a replica, a contemporary work of art!
In the end, this was a treasure!
How rich was he?!
For a moment, Jiang Shouheng’s hand that was holding the teacup trembled. He looked at the beautiful and cracked teacup in his hand.
Damn it!
Could it be the legendary ice crack porcelain?!
Oh my god. He felt that his blood pressure was a little high.
He quickly held the teacup with both hands and placed it gently on the coffee table.
Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu’s shocked expression and waved his hand. “There are three more similar ones upstairs. I’ll bring you up to take a look later.”
What?
There were more upstairs!
Moreover, there were three of them!

If these four blue-and-white porcelain vases were sold together, they would be worth at least five to six hundred million yuan. It was enough to buy another mansion in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion!

However, thinking about it, his son had said back then that Chen Yun had spent 500 million yuan to obtain the jade seal in the East Mountain Villa. In comparison, it was not strange for these vases to be placed here.
With money, background, and the magical Heavenly Spirit Water, Jiang Zhengyu looked at Chen Yun as if he was looking at a monster. He was simply too monstrous!
“Sit down, Mengmeng, Xiao Xue. You don’t have to work anymore.”
After they sat down, Jiang Zhengyu waved his hand. Jiang Shouheng quickly handed over the things he had brought.

“These are two bottles of wine brewed by my own winery. They’re usually brewed for me to drink. Don’t mind them, Director Chen.” Then, Chen Yun looked at the wine and then at Jiang Zhengyu’s pained expression. The corners of his mouth curled up into a smile.
How could this thing be as simple as he said?
If it was really something unimportant, would he be like this?

In fact, Chen Yun was really right. This wine could be said to be Jiang Zhengyu’s trump card. Eight years ago, it was personally made by a top Western brewing master. He only made two barrels and there were less than 80 bottles!
It could be said that every bottle contained the essence!
Even Lafite and Domaine de la Romanée-Conti were inferior.
All these years, even if it was Ma Ke, Jiang Zhengyu had only taken it out for him to try once.
“CEO Jiang, one never visits unless they need something. Tell me, what’s the matter?”

“Then I’ll get straight to the point.” Jiang Zhengyu looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, I’d like to ask you for two more bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water. As you know, I was born in the military. Back then, I had two brothers in the military. They were also discharged from the military due to injuries. Now that they’re old and have many hidden illnesses, they suffer day and night, so I want to ask you for two more bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water for them.”
“I know. This thing is very precious. I won’t take it for nothing. I’ll buy it. Name a price,” said Jiang Zhengyu hurriedly.

When Chen Yun heard Jiang Zhengyu’s words, he thought that something else was the matter. The effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water was not only to extend one’s lifespan, but also to revive one’s cells. Therefore, it was quite effective in dealing with hidden illnesses.
“Give me a moment.”
Chen Yun spoke. Then, he returned to his room to retrieve two small bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water. “Take them.”

Chen Yun always had a lot of respect for soldiers. After all, during the disaster, they were the ones who rushed to the front line. They were the ones who resisted disasters and went against the flow. They were the ones who worked hard and complained. They were still the ones who protected the country.
Only they could make Chen Yun take out such a thing.
“Director Chen, how much is it?”
“It’s free.” Seeing that Jiang Zhengyu was about to say something, Chen Yun waved his hand. “There’s no need to say anything.”
“Well ...”
Jiang Zhengyu pondered for a moment and nodded.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with gratitude.
“By the way, Director Chen, I’ll be the host tonight. Let’s have a meal together. You don’t know about this, but I recently picked up a chef.”
He picked up a chef?
Was there such a way to describe employing a chef?

“It can be considered a coincidence. This chef’s background is not minor. How about this? I’ll keep you in suspense for now. After we finish eating, if you think it’s delicious, I’ll tell you about his background.” Jiang Zhengyu was simply beaming with joy as he spoke. Even Jiang Shouheng, who was beside him, had a confident expression.
Looking at them, Chen Yun’s curiosity was aroused.
After all, as the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu had eaten all kinds of good things. Someone who could make him admire them so much should have some skills.
“Alright, you’re just in time. Let’s open a bottle tonight and try your wine.”
Chen Yun smiled and took out a bottle of wine, making Jiang Shouheng’s eyes widen.
It was as if stars had been released.
One had to know that he had never gotten a sip of this red wine in his life. He did not expect to be in luck today.
The group drove out. After arriving at Cauldron Dragon Security, a villa stood there.

Chen Yun was amused. The security of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was not as good as the security of Jiang Zhengyu’s villa. If anyone dared to come here, with Jiang Zhengyu’s order, all the bodyguards of Cauldron Dragon Security would come out in full force. It would not take much. Two to three minutes was enough to surround the villa.
One had to know that these bodyguards were all armed and trained!
Their combat strength was not something the security guards of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion could compare to.
However, no one would be stupid enough to provoke Jiang Zhengyu.
After entering the villa, an old man hurried over. “Sir, you’re back!”
Then, he looked at the people behind him. “Hello, sirs.”
Hm?
Was there such a title in this era?

“I know.
This thing is very precious.
I won’t take it for nothing.
I’ll buy it.
Name a price,” said Jiang Zhengyu hurriedly.
When Chen Yun heard Jiang Zhengyu’s words, he thought that something else was the matter.
The effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water was not only to extend one’s lifespan, but also to revive one’s cells.
Therefore, it was quite effective in dealing with hidden illnesses.
“Give me a moment.”
Chen Yun spoke.
Then, he returned to his room to retrieve two small bottles of the Heavenly Spirit Water.
“Take them.”
Chen Yun always had a lot of respect for soldiers.
After all, during the disaster, they were the ones who rushed to the front line.
They were the ones who resisted disasters and went against the flow.
They were the ones who worked hard and complained.
They were still the ones who protected the country.
Only they could make Chen Yun take out such a thing.
“Director Chen, how much is it?”
“It’s free.” Seeing that Jiang Zhengyu was about to say something, Chen Yun waved his hand.
“There’s no need to say anything.”
“Well ...”
Jiang Zhengyu pondered for a moment and nodded.
Then, he looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with gratitude.
“By the way, Director Chen, I’ll be the host tonight.
Let’s have a meal together.
You don’t know about this, but I recently picked up a chef.”
He picked up a chef?
Was there such a way to describe employing a chef?
“It can be considered a coincidence.
This chef’s background is not minor.
How about this?
I’ll keep you in suspense for now.
After we finish eating, if you think it’s delicious, I’ll tell you about his background.” Jiang Zhengyu was simply beaming with joy as he spoke.
Even Jiang Shouheng, who was beside him, had a confident expression.
Looking at them, Chen Yun’s curiosity was aroused.
After all, as the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu had eaten all kinds of good things.
Someone who could make him admire them so much should have some skills.
“Alright, you’re just in time.
Let’s open a bottle tonight and try your wine.”
Chen Yun smiled and took out a bottle of wine, making Jiang Shouheng’s eyes widen.
It was as if stars had been released.
One had to know that he had never gotten a sip of this red wine in his life.
He did not expect to be in luck today.
The group drove out.
After arriving at Cauldron Dragon Security, a villa stood there.
Chen Yun was amused.
The security of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was not as good as the security of Jiang Zhengyu’s villa.
If anyone dared to come here, with Jiang Zhengyu’s order, all the bodyguards of Cauldron Dragon Security would come out in full force.
It would not take much.
Two to three minutes was enough to surround the villa.
One had to know that these bodyguards were all armed and trained!
Their combat strength was not something the security guards of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion could compare to.
However, no one would be stupid enough to provoke Jiang Zhengyu.
After entering the villa, an old man hurried over.
“Sir, you’re back!”
Then, he looked at the people behind him.
“Hello, sirs.”
Hm?
Was there such a title in this era?

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Random Distribution Skill Triggered!
paragraphs: “Director Chen, this is the person I told you about. His name is Xu Bin.” Jiang Zhengyu looked at Xu Bin. “Old Master, there’s no need to be so reserved. Go to the kitchen and cook us a few dishes.”
“Okay.”
After Xu Bin heard this, he quickly walked towards the kitchen.
“Director Chen, let’s go in first.”
After the few of them sat down, a rich fragrance wafted through the air. Chen Yun smelled the fragrance and a playful smile appeared on his face. This smell.
It seemed that this old man was really interesting.

Putting everything else aside, the fragrance from the cooking of ordinary people could not match up to this fragrance. Chen Yun realized that after eating for so many years, few dishes could have such an alluring fragrance.
Even the dishes cooked by the top chefs in East Sea City were inferior.
He was a capable person.
Beside him, Chen Mengmeng’s eyes were also shining.

Not long after, a few waiters carried the dishes over and placed them on the round table. There were a few dishes and a few soups. Every one of them was filled with a rich fragrance. At this moment, they were mixed together, making people’s cravings rise.
Chen Yun looked at the dish in front of him. It was the most common stewed pork. However, Chen Yun was surprised to discover that strands of sugar had appeared on the stewed pork.
One had to know that this could only be done at an extremely high level of attainment.
There were various ingredients in the remaining dishes. Every one of them was of excellent color.
In the end, Old Man Xu personally walked up with several plates.
“Young Master, Miss, please eat.” Old Man Xu placed the small bowls in his hands in front of everyone.
In the bowl was a cabbage core. However, this cabbage core was cut into the shape of a lotus. There was also clear water-like soup.
“Is this boiled cabbage?”
Chen Yun was stunned as such a term appeared in his mind.
“Director Chen, you’re right. It’s boiled cabbage.”
“The wine has been opened, right? Hurry up and serve the wine to Director Chen.” As Jiang Zhengyu spoke, Chen Yun and the others also picked up their chopsticks.
Chen Yun picked up a piece of pork in front of him.
When he picked it up, the strands of sugar on the pork seemed to break but remained connected. Chen Yun was slightly surprised.
Unexpectedly, the white sugar that Old Man Xu stir-fried had reached such a level. Its color was as bright as malt candy, but it was not too sticky.
Crack!
With a bite, the crisp sound of the flour on the meat immediately resounded in his ears.
It was as if he was about to eat a mille-feuille.
Moreover, there was a faint salty smell, and the fragrance of meat wafted out.
After lightly biting the crispy outer layer, a few textures instantly filled his mouth, as if they had exploded!
“Not bad.”
Chen Yun said, “It’s sweet but not greasy. It’s crispy but not dry. The gravy inside is sweet and delicious.”
Coupled with a mouthful of top-notch red wine brewed by Jiang Zhengyu, it was as if he was in the clouds and could not calm down for a long time.
“Thank you for your praise, Young Master.” Old Man Xu looked at Chen Yun and bowed.

Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng and simply wanted to laugh. She clearly wanted to eat, but she had to consider her posture. She did not even dare to turn the Lazy Susan. She could only eat the dish in front of her, looking like she was about to cry.

“Come, everyone, try the other dishes.” Chen Yun placed his hand on the Lazy Susan in front of him and slowly spun it. Chen Mengmeng took the opportunity to pick up a few dishes with her chopsticks. An extremely satisfied expression immediately appeared on her face.
It was as if she had eaten the most delicious food in the world.
Han Xue was the same.
Chen Yun looked at the two little girls and smiled bitterly in his heart.
The banquet continued. After Chen Yun finished eating the dishes, he kept nodding in admiration. “Not bad, really not bad.”
“CEO Jiang, how long are you going to keep me in suspense?”

“Haha, then I’ll tell you.” Jiang Zhengyu laughed. “When Old Man Xu was in dire straits, I saved him. His ancestor was a chef in the imperial kitchen. Although his family was in dire straits, his culinary skills were still there.”
His ancestor was a chef from the imperial kitchen!
These words were powerful enough!
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at the dishes on the Lazy Susan and cherished them even more. One had to know that these were dishes that only the former royal family could eat!
Chen Yun touched his chin. No wonder.
“It’s a pity not to pass on such good culinary skills.” Chen Yun pondered for a moment. “CEO Jiang, show me some respect. I want this person.”
Jiang Zhengyu almost cried. How could he snatch his chef away?!
Although he did not want Old Man Xu to leave, he had no choice. Chen Yun had already spoken.
“Of course. Old Man Xu, follow Director Chen in the future.”
Jiang Zhengyu looked at Old Man Xu and thought to himself, “My delicacies have gone far!”

Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu’s pained expression and laughed. “CEO Jiang, I’m not asking him to cook for me. I’m asking him to pass down his skills. How about this, Elder Xu? I plan to open a restaurant and let you take charge of the kitchen. How about that?”
“Ah!”
When Xu Bin heard Chen Yun’s words, his eyes widened. He simply could not believe what he had heard.
“Director Chen wants to promote you. Why are you still standing there?” Jiang Zhengyu immediately spoke.
“Thank you, Young Master.”
Xu Bin hurriedly thanked him, and Jiang Zhengyu heaved a sigh of relief.
Chen Yun immediately called Zhou Jingyi and asked her to help find a place to renovate as soon as possible.
After giving his instructions, he transferred 100 million yuan to her.
[Random Distribution skill triggered.]
[Reward: Dimensional Space. The size of the space is a total of one cubic meter. It can be controlled at the host’s will. Others can’t see it.]
The Dimensional Space?
With a thought, Chen Yun suddenly punched in a space beside him. It was not big and was only one square meter large.
This thing was good.

In the end, even though the two little girls had maintained their ladylike appearance throughout, their stomachs were still bulging. It was obvious that they had eaten too much. Even so, their eyes still lit up as they looked at the dishes in front of them.

Chen Yun picked up the boiled cabbage in front of him and slowly ate it. The more he ate it, the more he felt that Elder Xu was impressive. He could remove the oil from the stock and turn it into a soup that resembled clear water, yet had such a taste. Just his culinary skills were superb.
Of course, this was also a skill passed down by the ancestors of China.
There were eight major cuisines in China, and there was even the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast!
How could those foreign dishes compare?

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Blinding!
paragraphs: After settling the preliminary matters with Xu Bin, Jiang Zhengyu pulled Chen Yun to drink tea.

That tea could also be said to be top-notch. It was much better than the special Zhengshan xiaozhong tea that Zheng Jianghao had stolen from his father last time. At a glance, it was also Jiang Zhengyu’s trump card.
At the side, Chen Mengmeng and the other two girls also looked like they were enjoying themselves.
The next moment, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
“Huh? Auntie Song, what’s wrong?”
“Xiao Yun, did Yuanyuan make you angry today?” Auntie Song sighed. “She’s been spoiled by her father and me since she was young. Her words are impolite!”
“Auntie Song, it’s nothing. I’ll go to your company tomorrow and bring you something. Ever since your company moved, I haven’t gone to take a look.”
“Alright, I’ll wait for you at the company tomorrow. I’ll send you the address later.”
After hanging up, Auntie Song looked at Wang Yuanyuan beside her and recalled Chen Yun’s words just now. Why didn’t he come to the house? Wasn’t it because of the two of them?!
How infuriating!

“I’ve spoiled you too much!” Auntie Song looked at Wang Yuanyuan with an angry expression. Under her interrogation just now, Wang Yuanyuan had mentioned a portion of what the two of them had talked about today, making her furious. If these words reached the ears of Chen Yun’s parents, what would she become?!
She said that she wanted to take good care of Xiao Yun, but in the end, no one but her daughter bullied him!

“I think Yuanyuan is right.” Wang Qing sat on the sofa and said, “You shouldn’t have said anything about taking care of him back then. He’s an outsider and he’s already so old. If he doesn’t achieve anything, he’ll die on his own.”
“What outsider?! Heh, in your eyes, only those CEOs and big shots are family, right?”

“Look at what you’ve taught for so many years. Yuanyuan has become like this because she thinks that you’re currying favor with the rich and powerful! You’re a snob! Look at yourself. You’ve been in the industry for so many years and sent so many gifts to climb up here. If I didn’t support you, the family would have collapsed long ago!”
When Wang Qing heard this, he was also furious. He suddenly stood up. “What did you say?!”
When Wang Yuanyuan saw that her parents were about to quarrel, tears welled up in her eyes and she silently returned to her room.
Then, she made a call to Ye Xinyu, who fell into deep thought for a while.
“Your mother looks like she has her eyes on that kid.”

“As long as she knows that there are better boys pursuing you, won’t that be fine?” Ye Xinyu said, “Isn’t this perfect? Tomorrow, I’ll bring Wang Huawei and the others to your mother’s company. Coincidentally, Wang Huawei is pursuing you. Tsk tsk, Wang Huawei’s family background is even better than mine. It’s just right to beat that kid. This way, that kid will give up.”
“Moreover, if you and Wang Huawei act more intimately, you can also make your mother give up on this idea.”
After hearing this, Wang Yuanyuan gritted her teeth. “Alright!”
She no longer had any good impression of Chen Yun that she had accumulated in the club.
After hanging up, Chen Yun looked at Jiang Zhengyu. “CEO Jiang, don’t worry. In the future, when I open a restaurant, it will be free for friends like you.”
“I don’t make money from this.”
Chen Yun smiled and looked relaxed.
If it were anyone else who said this, Jiang Zhengyu would really not believe it. However, it was different when it came from Chen Yun!
Chen Yun possessed Sacred Heaven, the East Mountain Villa, and a huge cash flow!
Now, other than a few large families in Jiang City and even the entire Jiangbei, no one else had such a huge cash flow like Chen Yun.
“Then I’ll thank Director Chen first.”
After chatting for a while, Chen Yun looked at his phone and realized that Zhou Jingyi had already booked the restaurant and was preparing to design and renovate it.
“Elder Xu, I’ll give you a number. Contact this person tomorrow and see how to design this restaurant. If you do it well, I’ll give you 30% of the restaurant’s profits.”
Thirty percent!
Xu Bin’s eyes widened. He simply could not believe what he had heard!
Not only was he shocked, but even Jiang Zhengyu’s body trembled!

He could imagine how terrifying the restaurant would be after this restaurant was established. With Chen Yun’s influence in the entire Jiang City and Old Master Xu’s culinary skills, how profitable would it be?!
At that moment, he was also shocked by Chen Yun’s generosity!
They were silent for a long time.
After staying for a while, Chen Yun brought the two little girls with bulging stomachs home.
“Brother, I’ve never eaten such delicious food before. It’s really awesome.”
“I didn’t expect to enjoy the treatment of the royal family in my lifetime.”

Chen Yun drove and looked at Chen Mengmeng in the backseat. “If you want to eat those dishes in the future, go ahead. Also, Xiao Xue, that’s our family’s business. How can we not care about your meals?”
“Okay!”
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Chen Yun. The two of them were like two little princesses who were doted on by Chen Yun.
When she returned home, Chen Mengmeng looked at the vase at the door. Seriously, after waiting for so long, no one told her what to do.
They took a shower, washed up, and slept...

Early the next morning, after Chen Yun finished eating, he looked at the other bottle of red wine Jiang Zhengyu had brought yesterday and asked Chen Mengmeng and Xiao Xue, “Xiao Xue, Mengmeng, do the two of you like to drink this?”
They both shook their heads.

They were still young girls and had not reached the age where they could taste the beauty of red wine. Naturally, they could not savor all kinds of tastes. Needless to say, Chen Yun did not drink at all. Unless they had a good relationship, he would use tea as a substitute for wine when others toasted him.
Since no one was drinking it, he would bring it to Auntie Song.
Chen Yun drove out and bought some other gifts on the way. Before long, he arrived at a mall on Third Ring Road. Auntie Song’s light decoration company was there.
She didn’t make lights and decorations, but sold them, so she would earn more money.
“Hello, I’m looking for Song Xinyu.”
“Oh, you’re looking for CEO Song. Are you Chen Yun?”
“Yes.”
“Come with me quickly. CEO Song told me yesterday that she had already come down a few times to ask if you were here.” The receptionist looked at Chen Yun with tears in her eyes.
This was because Chen Yun was simply too handsome. Today, he was wearing a slim-fit shirt and looked like a young master of a wealthy family. He was dazzling!

She didn’t make lights and decorations, but sold them, so she would earn more money.
“Hello, I’m looking for Song Xinyu.”
“Oh, you’re looking for CEO Song.
Are you Chen Yun?”
“Yes.”
“Come with me quickly.
CEO Song told me yesterday that she had already come down a few times to ask if you were here.” The receptionist looked at Chen Yun with tears in her eyes.
This was because Chen Yun was simply too handsome.
Today, he was wearing a slim-fit shirt and looked like a young master of a wealthy family.
He was dazzling!

chapters.title: Chapter 81: I Thought You Were Very Awesome
paragraphs: She had never expected CEO Song’s nephew to be so handsome.
He was even more handsome than the popular young hunks.

She turned around from time to time and took out her phone. “Mr. Chen, why don’t you add me on WeChat? If you come again in the future, you can tell me in advance. There’s no need for CEO Song to come down.”
Chen Yun was speechless.
What kind of logic was this?
If he had the time, he could just tell Auntie Song.
“Come on.” The girl had already pulled out her WeChat QR code, making Chen Yun smile bitterly.
After adding him, the girl was satisfied. Her face was red, as if she had obtained the entire world with just a WeChat contact.
When they arrived at the office, Auntie Song suddenly looked up at Chen Yun.
“Xiao Yun, you’re here.”
“Aiya, you! Why did you bring these things?”
“Why did you bring red wine? You must have spent a lot of money.”
Chen Yun put down the bags. “It didn’t cost much. This wine was given to me by a friend. I heard that red wine nurtures beauties, so I have to give it to a beauty like Auntie Song, right?”
“You’re so sweet.” Auntie Song arranged for Chen Yun to sit down and placed two cups of coffee.
“Then, CEO Song, I’ll go down first,” said the receptionist. Then, she turned to leave.
Chen Yun looked around and thought to himself that Auntie Song’s career was really not minor.
For a woman to be able to do this from scratch, she could be considered a strong person.
“Xiao Yun, I didn’t expect Yuanyuan to be so arrogant. She made you unhappy. Don’t lower yourself to her level.” Auntie Song sighed.
Chen Yun waved his hand. “It’s fine.”
“However, Auntie Song, I have a good girl by my side.” Chen Yun smiled.
The meaning of this sentence was very obvious!
If Auntie Song still didn’t understand, she would have lived for so many years in vain!
At that moment, she sighed. “You’re a good child.”
“Auntie Song, it’s good that you understand what I mean. However, Auntie Song, in my heart, you’re like family. In the future, if there’s anything I can help you with, I’ll definitely help you.”

“Alright, I’ll remember it. When you make a name for yourself in the future, Auntie Song will definitely look for you to help.” As Auntie Song spoke, she did not take it to heart. After all, in her heart, Chen Yun was still in university. What ability did he have?
If she couldn’t solve the problem now, it would be even more impossible to look for Chen Yun to solve the problem.
At this moment, Ye Xinyu and seven to eight others walked over from the reception downstairs.
“Xiao Mei, is Chen Yun here?” Wang Yuanyuan asked the girl who was older than her.
“He’s here.”
After saying this, they walked upstairs.
Xiao Mei’s face instantly darkened. Another receptionist came over and looked at Wang Yuanyuan’s figure. “Who do you think you are? Auntie Song can call her Xiao Mei, but can you call her that? Tsk!”
“Sister Mei, don’t be angry.”
“It’s fine. Don’t say anything else. Sister Song has treated us well. Furthermore, we don’t work directly with her, so let’s not argue with her.”
However, Xiao Mei’s eyes were filled with worry. These people were aggressive and asked about Chen Yun as soon as they arrived. They probably did not come with good intentions.
At this moment, Chen Yun had sent the gifts and said what he wanted to say. Since there was nothing else, he was prepared to leave.
The next moment, there was a commotion outside.
A few young men and women laughed as they pushed open the door and walked in. It was Wang Yuanyuan and the others.
“Mom, I brought some friends to the company to play.”
Then, Wang Yuanyuan looked at Chen Yun. “You’re here too?”
Auntie Song looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “Do you know where this is? Why are you making so much noise with so many people?!”
“Mom, I’m just here with some friends.”

At the side, Ye Xinyu quickly explained, “Auntie, we’re not here to play. Let me introduce you. This is Wang Huawei, the son of the General Manager of Elysium Real Estate. His father happens to have a lot of renovation orders, so we wanted him to talk to you.”
Beside her, Wang Zhouning also nodded. Wang Huawei’s father was quite powerful. Even his family background could not compare to Wang Huawei’s.

Wang Yuanyuan also took this opportunity to move closer to Wang Huawei. The surrounding people naturally moved aside to reveal the two of them. They looked like a couple for Auntie Song and Chen Yun to see.
You!
After all, Wang Yuanyuan was her daughter. As a mother, how could she not know what Wang Yuanyuan was doing?
At that moment, Auntie Song was about to flare up when Xiao Mei rushed in from the door. “CEO Song, bad news.”
She glanced at the crowd and whispered into Auntie Song’s ear.
The next moment, Auntie Song’s expression darkened. “Where is he now?”
“He’s downstairs.”
Auntie Song sighed and hurried out.
Meanwhile, Wang Yuanyuan and the others were baffled. It was as if they had punched empty air.
At this moment, Ye Xinyu looked at Chen Yun in front of her. She sneered and looked at Wang Huawei. “Brother Wang, I heard that you’ve been in contact with Brother Dong Yuekun recently.”
These words shocked everyone. Who was Brother Kun? He was a big shot in this area who ran many entertainment venues. He was also a ruthless person.

Wang Huawei smiled and said, “I like to make friends. I went to school while wandering around. Later on, I obtained Brother Kun’s recognition and could be considered to have some small achievements. Coupled with my father, I was able to have some influence in Jiang City.”
For a moment, the way everyone looked at Wang Huawei changed.
Even Ye Xinyu began to envy Wang Yuanyuan. If she got together with Wang Huawei, it would be a beautiful thing.
Wang Zhoning looked at Wang Huawei and joked, “Huawei, I heard that you went out with Brother Kun last night, right?”
“Of course!”
A proud smile immediately appeared on Wang Huawei’s face. He was extraordinarily proud.
Even Wang Zhouning looked at him with anticipation, let alone the other young people present.
“Brother Wang, did the ruthless people under Brother Kun also go? How impressive would that be?”

Wang Huawei looked at the person who had asked the question just now and sneered. “Idiot, is there a need to ask such a question? Who is Brother Kun? With a single shout, he has dozens of fans. How can he not be awe-inspiring when he goes out? Let me tell you, the people who go out with him are all managers of this entertainment venue. Usually, others bow to them.”
“However, in front of Brother Kun, they’re all as obedient as little sheep.”
As soon as he said this, everyone felt a chill run down their spines. They were all flowers in a greenhouse. They had heard of such a ruthless person, but they had never seen him before.
After hearing Wang Huawei’s words, they immediately wanted to curry favor with him.
“Brother Wang, can you help to recommend us to him?”

“You guys?” Wang Huawei looked at them and chuckled. “You don’t have to say such nonsense. Regardless of what kind of person Brother Kun is, I can recommend you guys to him. You guys can follow me. As long as I have a share of the cake, I won’t forget about you guys.”

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Master Chen!
paragraphs: When everyone heard this, there was no resentful expression on their faces. After all, Wang Huawei was right. What kind of identity did he have? What kind of identity did they have?
Wang Huawei’s words raised his status among the crowd again, causing Wang Zhouning’s leadership status in this circle to plummet.

However, Wang Zhouning did not dare to complain. Instead, he looked like he was trying to curry favor with Wang Huawei. After all, if he could get close to Wang Huawei, he might be able to get in touch with Brother Kun.
Meanwhile, Wang Yuanyuan did not expect Wang Huawei to have such power. She immediately changed her mind about using Wang Huawei as a shield and took the initiative to lean towards Wang Huawei.
“Chen Yun, we’re all standing. Is it appropriate for you to sit like this?” Ye Xinyu looked at Chen Yun. “Hurry up and get to know Brother Wang. Who knows, he might even promote you in the future.”

At this moment, Wang Huawei also looked at Chen Yun, his eyes flashing with maliciousness. “Now, when Brother Kun’s subordinates see me, they have to get up. However, this brother is sitting there like a mountain. It seems that he must have a shocking background. I wonder where he’s working?”

“There are some things that you can’t control.” However, Chen Yun’s words made Ye Xinyu laugh. “Brother Wang, don’t be fooled by him. This kid is just a county boy who can fight. He can’t understand our realm at all.”
As soon as he said this, everyone laughed.
Chen Yun sneered, stood up, and walked out. In the next moment, Wang Huawei stopped him and coughed lightly. “Brother, are you trying to embarrass me?”
Chen Yun turned around and his eyes turned cold. He grabbed Wang Huawei’s neck and sneered. “Is your face worth a lot?”
“Is your face worth a lot?’
This sentence stunned everyone!
They looked at Chen Yun!
This was crazy!
This kid was crazy!
However, no one dared to step forward!
After all, it was not as if they had never seen Chen Yun defeat more than ten burly men that day!
Wang Yuanyuan looked at Wang Huawei, who was short of breath, and grabbed Chen Yun’s hand.
“Let go of him! Do you know who he is?!”
“You won’t have a good time if you touch him!”
“Aren’t you just relying on your ability to fight?! In the end, you still want to be their lackey!”
As soon as she finished speaking, Chen Yun let go of Wang Huawei’s neck.
Then, he slapped her!
He directly slapped Wang Yuanyuan’s face!
Pa!
One slap!
It was extremely clear!
Everyone present was shocked!
Even Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes widened as she felt the pain on her face!
Her face was filled with disbelief!
Chen Yun!
How dare he hit her!
She had never been beaten up by anyone since she was young!
Initially, she just wanted Chen Yun to retreat in the face of difficulties. However, it was different now!
“I slapped you because of Auntie Song!” Chen Yun sneered. “Otherwise, do you have the right to stand in front of me?! What a joke!”
“Good!”
At the side, Wang Huawei looked at Chen Yun and gritted his teeth. He even enunciated every word angrily!
“You’re very good! Chen Yun, right? Just you wait. I’ll definitely tell Brother Kun...”
Before he could finish speaking, he looked at Chen Yun’s extremely cold eyes and was so frightened that he swallowed the second half of his sentence.
The entire place was silent.
The next moment, a commotion came from below. Everyone was stunned. Chen Yun took a step forward and walked out of the door.
Everyone heard the commotion below and hurried down.
At this moment, a group of men was standing at the door on the first floor with sneers on their faces.
Auntie Song was comforting Xiao Mei, who had been slapped. Then, she looked at them. “How can you hit someone?!”

“B*tch, it’s not like we didn’t warn you. I told you before to move out of here within three days, but you still dared to ignore me. So what if I hit her? Do you believe that I still dare to hit you?!”

“Let me tell you, Brother Yu will come over in a while. If you know what’s good for you, start moving now. Otherwise, things will be different when Young Master Yu comes. I think the things here are all glass. It should be quite satisfying to smash them, right?”
“You!” Auntie Song was so angry that she panted heavily.
Meanwhile, a group of people came down from the elevator. Wang Yuanyuan was also stunned when she saw this scene.
Chen Yun narrowed his eyes and walked towards Auntie Song. “Auntie Song, are you alright?”
“I’m fine.”

On the other side, when Wang Huawei saw this, he roughly knew what was going on. He immediately looked at Wang Yuanyuan’s flustered expression and sneered. If he could perform at this time, it would be a short period of time before he captured Wang Yuanyuan.
At that moment, he walked towards the burly man at the door. “Brothers, what can’t we talk nicely?”
The leader observed Wang Huawei and sneered. “Who do you think you are?”
“You!” Wang Huawei puffed out his chest. “Do you know Brother Kun?! That’s my big brother!”
“Brother Kun?” The man in the lead was immediately puzzled. “Which Brother Kun?”

“Dong Yuekun, Brother Kun, do you know him? He’s the boss of this entertainment industry!” This sentence was extremely arrogant, as if Wang Huawei was Dong Yuekun. This sentence made everyone behind him feel relieved.
They became much braver when facing this group of burly men.
Hahahaha...
A laugh came from a young man in a gold-rimmed suit and sunglasses, who was walking over from a distance.
“Young Master Yu.”
“Young Master Yu, you’re here.”
The men looked at the young man and automatically retreated into two rows.

At this moment, the young man looked at Wang Huawei and laughed when he heard his words. Then, he spat on the ground. “F*ck, Dong Yuekun? He’s just a f*cking hooligan. He’s even good enough for some people to call him Brother Kun.”
You!
These words made Wang Huawei glare at him. “Who are you?! How dare you insult Brother Kun!”
Hearing his clamor, the burly man in the lead walked forward and slapped Wang Huawei’s face, causing blood to flow from the corner of his mouth!
“Are you bloody blind? Why don’t you take a look at yourself? How dare you shout at Young Master Yu?”
“I wonder where you’re from. You don’t even know Young Master Zheng Wenyu. A little ruffian like Dong Yuekun isn’t even worthy of carrying Young Master Yu’s shoes!”
“You still dare to use him to suppress Young Master Yu? You’re asking for death!”
Zheng Wenyu!
As soon as these three words were spoken, Wang Huawei was simply dispirited.
Why was this ruthless person here?!
In the entire Jiang City, there were a total of two young masters surnamed Zheng. One was Zheng Jianghao, and the other was Zheng Wenyu!
None of them were to be trifled with!
Although Zheng Wenyu was not as good as Zheng Jianghao, in their eyes, he was an unattainable existence.
At that moment, Wang Huawei’s legs trembled, let alone Wang Zhouning and the others behind him.
They were so frightened that their souls almost left their bodies.
Zheng Wenyu walked forward and looked at Wang Huawei. Then, he kicked him in the crotch.
“Ah!” A shrill voice suddenly sounded.

“F*ck your mother. I’ll teach you a lesson this time. If you dare to block the way again, I’ll chop you up and feed you to the dogs.” Zheng Wenyu looked at the hall in front of him and snorted. “You guys didn’t do your job well.”
Sweat seeped out of the leader’s forehead. He immediately waved his hand. “Don’t you understand what Young Master Yu means?! Smash him!”
“I’ll see who dares to fight back.”
A voice slowly sounded. It was not loud, but it was filled with dignity.

“F*ck! Am I going against the flow today? Why are there always people making things difficult for me?” Zheng Wenyu looked in the direction of the voice and saw Chen Yun, stunning him. Then, his hand trembled as he reached for his sunglasses. After taking them off, his pupils were constricted again.
The next moment!
The sunglasses fell to the ground!
He also collapsed to the ground!
This!
“Master... Master Chen!”
Zheng Wenyu looked at Chen Yun and simply could not believe what he was seeing!
This ruthless person!
Wasn’t he the ruthless person who crippled Gai Lingjie on the cruise ship?!
He was doomed. He had f*cking bumped into this master today!
Gai Lingjie’s encounter seemed to be still vivid in his mind!
Zheng Wenyu’s action shocked the others.
Wang Huawei was stunned. Wang Zhouning was shocked. Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes were about to pop out!
However, they did not know why!
Why did the arrogant Zheng Wenyu, Young Master Zheng, look like he had seen a ghost now?!
Moreover, he even said two words with a trembling voice.
Master Chen!

At this moment, the young man looked at Wang Huawei and laughed when he heard his words.
Then, he spat on the ground.
“F*ck, Dong Yuekun?
He’s just a f*cking hooligan.
He’s even good enough for some people to call him Brother Kun.”
You!
These words made Wang Huawei glare at him.
“Who are you?!
How dare you insult Brother Kun!”
Hearing his clamor, the burly man in the lead walked forward and slapped Wang Huawei’s face, causing blood to flow from the corner of his mouth!
“Are you bloody blind?
Why don’t you take a look at yourself?
How dare you shout at Young Master Yu?”
“I wonder where you’re from.
You don’t even know Young Master Zheng Wenyu.
A little ruffian like Dong Yuekun isn’t even worthy of carrying Young Master Yu’s shoes!”
“You still dare to use him to suppress Young Master Yu?
You’re asking for death!”
Zheng Wenyu!
As soon as these three words were spoken, Wang Huawei was simply dispirited.
Why was this ruthless person here?!
In the entire Jiang City, there were a total of two young masters surnamed Zheng.
One was Zheng Jianghao, and the other was Zheng Wenyu!
None of them were to be trifled with!
Although Zheng Wenyu was not as good as Zheng Jianghao, in their eyes, he was an unattainable existence.
At that moment, Wang Huawei’s legs trembled, let alone Wang Zhouning and the others behind him.
They were so frightened that their souls almost left their bodies.
Zheng Wenyu walked forward and looked at Wang Huawei.
Then, he kicked him in the crotch.
“Ah!” A shrill voice suddenly sounded.
“F*ck your mother.
I’ll teach you a lesson this time.
If you dare to block the way again, I’ll chop you up and feed you to the dogs.” Zheng Wenyu looked at the hall in front of him and snorted.
“You guys didn’t do your job well.”
Sweat seeped out of the leader’s forehead.
He immediately waved his hand.
“Don’t you understand what Young Master Yu means?!
Smash him!”
“I’ll see who dares to fight back.”
A voice slowly sounded.
It was not loud, but it was filled with dignity.
“F*ck!
Am I going against the flow today?
Why are there always people making things difficult for me?” Zheng Wenyu looked in the direction of the voice and saw Chen Yun, stunning him.
Then, his hand trembled as he reached for his sunglasses.
After taking them off, his pupils were constricted again.
The next moment!
The sunglasses fell to the ground!
He also collapsed to the ground!
This!
“Master...
Master Chen!”
Zheng Wenyu looked at Chen Yun and simply could not believe what he was seeing!
This ruthless person!
Wasn’t he the ruthless person who crippled Gai Lingjie on the cruise ship?!
He was doomed.
He had f*cking bumped into this master today!
Gai Lingjie’s encounter seemed to be still vivid in his mind!
Zheng Wenyu’s action shocked the others.
Wang Huawei was stunned.
Wang Zhouning was shocked.
Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes were about to pop out!
However, they did not know why!
Why did the arrogant Zheng Wenyu, Young Master Zheng, look like he had seen a ghost now?!
Moreover, he even said two words with a trembling voice.
Master Chen!

chapters.title: Chapter 83: This Wine!
paragraphs: Beside Zheng Wenyu, the men were also at a loss. They were completely stunned and could not believe what they were seeing. Who was this person?
That was Young Master Zheng Wenyu!
Why was he so frightened?
Chen Yun slowly walked over and looked at Zheng Wenyu. “Do you know me?”
“I... Of course I know you. I still remember your heroism on the cruise ship. My admiration for you...”
Zheng Wenyu’s voice trembled, but his flattery was still loud.
“Tell me what happened today.”
“Master Chen, listen to my explanation. It’s all my fault. I wanted to clear the area and start a shop myself.”
Chen Yun sneered. “Then what are you going to do now?”

“This... How about this, Master Chen? I promise you that I won’t come again in the future. I don’t want the rent at all. Moreover, my... my father still has many projects in his hands, and some of them are renovation projects. We’ll buy the lights and accessories from this place. I only have so much power. I’m relying on my father’s power, so Master Chen, please be magnanimous.”
Zheng Wenyu was about to cry.
“Take your men and get lost!”

Chen Yun’s words were simply like a gold medal to Zheng Wenyu. He felt as if he had been pardoned and quickly ran back with his men. As he ran, he even fell on his face and was carried away by the burly man beside him.
In the distance, the burly man swallowed his saliva and said, “Young Master Yu, who is that?”
“Who is it? It’s someone I, no, even my father can’t afford to offend! That’s the f*cking chairman of Sacred Heaven!”
“The person who holds 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares!”
These words almost made the burly man stagger and fall to the ground.
What?
He held 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares?!
It must be fake!
“What do you know? Do you know who crippled Gai Lingjie?! It’s this master!”
“Back then, I watched Gai Lingjie being crippled from the side! Moreover, Gai Tianyuan was also by the side. He didn’t even dare to do anything when he saw his son being crippled!”
“If he didn’t let me off today, my father wouldn’t dare to stand up for me!”
“Tell me if I should be afraid. Tell me if I should panic!”
“F*ck you! Run faster! Did you not eat?!” Zheng Wenyu’s words were like a hammer that shook the man’s heart, making his legs go weak. How could he run quickly?
Meanwhile, everyone else looked at Zheng Wenyu’s sorry state and Chen Yun’s figure. They swallowed a few mouthfuls of saliva.
No one present had expected Chen Yun to have such power!
It was Young Master Zheng Wenyu!
However, when he saw Chen Yin, he was so frightened that he called him Master Chen!
Then, he was scolded by Chen Yun and fled in a sorry state!
What kind of identity did Chen Yun have?!
At this moment, Wang Zhouning, Wang Huawei, and the others’ jaws almost dropped to the ground!
For a moment, regret filled their hearts. If they had sought favor with Chen Yun previously...
In that case, they would no longer have to care about Zheng Wenyu!
“Xiao Yun, you...”
Auntie Song wanted to say something, but she didn’t know what to say.
“Auntie Song, just work in the company in peace. No one will cause trouble for you in the future. I’ll go back first,” said Chen Yun before walking out.
He left behind a hall with people who were extremely regretful.
However, so what if they regretted it? There was no longer a chance.
At this moment, Ye Xinyu lost her strength and sat on the ground.

When Wang Yuanyuan thought of her previous words, she could not help but feel ridiculous. She originally thought that Chen Yun was only Zheng Jianghao’s lackey, but she did not expect him to have already gotten to this extent.
Even Zheng Wenyu called him Master Chen!
Chen Yun had probably already reached the point where he was on the same level as Zheng Jianghao and called each other brother!
That was Zheng Jianghao.
He was one of the top young masters in Jiang City.
Even if she worked hard for her entire life, he might not even open his eyes to look at her!
For a moment, Wang Yuanyuan had mixed feelings. This might be the best opportunity in her life. With her mother’s help, she could have enjoyed the benefits of a favorable position, but...
She had courted death and ruined everything.
Everything was gone.
After that, Wang Huawei left silently.
Wang Zhouning’s expression turned dark. No one knew what he was thinking. He did not even care about Ye Xinyu and left in a hurry.
The young people present were terrified, afraid that Chen Yun would bring up old scores.
Ye Xinyu was so frightened that her legs were still weak at night.
Wang Yuanyuan’s expression was even more sluggish. She had been in a daze the entire morning.
At night, Auntie Song and Wang Yuanyuan sat in the car with different thoughts.
At this moment, at home.
Wang Qing was drinking tea with a man.
“Secretary Wang, how is it? Has CEO Lin been free recently?”

“Of course. I even put in a good word for you in front of CEO Lin.” Secretary Wang chuckled. Wang Qing immediately knew and took out an envelope from his side. “Secretary Wang, thank you. This is a small token.”
“Haha, well said. I’ll put in a good word for you in front of CEO Lin when I get back.” Secretary Wang’s face was glowing. “Alright, I should go too.”
Wang Qing quickly stood up. “Secretary Wang, it’s already so late. I’ll ask my wife to buy some vegetables. There’s still some seafood at home. Please eat here.”
“Alright, that works too.”
The next moment, Auntie Song and Wang Yuanyuan entered the house.

“Aiya, why are you back so early? I wanted to ask you to buy some vegetables and a few bottles of good wine. Secretary Wang and I will have a good drink.” As Wang Qing spoke, he looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “Yuanyuan, go down and buy something.”
“Yuanyuan?”
Wang Qing looked at Wang Yuanyuan’s expression and felt that something was wrong. “What’s wrong?”
Auntie Song looked at Wang Yuanyuan and snorted. “Look at your good daughter. Look at her now. She even deliberately looked for someone to humiliate Xiao Yun this morning.”
“That kid is asking to be humiliated. Heh, even a toad wants to eat swan meat.”
Auntie Song looked at Wang Qing and was about to flare up when she saw that Secretary Wang was also there. She tried her best to suppress her anger.
“Brother Wang, what’s going on?” Secretary Wang chuckled.
“It’s the child of my wife’s friend. She wants to matchmake them, but the other party came from a small county. We’re not of the same status, so I’m not too happy.”
“That’s what you should do.” Secretary Wang nodded.
“By the way, Xinyu, there’s no more wine at home. Go buy some good wine.” As Wang Qing spoke, he glanced at her. “Eh? There’s a bottle of red wine here. Where did you get it?”
“Xiao Yun gave it to me.”
“Tsk! What good stuff can he give us?” Wang Qing sneered and was about to throw the wine in his hand into the trash can.
The next moment.
Secretary Wang shouted, “What are you doing!”
Wang Qing was instantly stunned. “Secretary Wang, what are you doing?”
Secretary Wang quickly walked up and snatched the red wine. Then, he looked at it carefully. “There’s no mistake. This red wine is amazing! Did someone give you such a precious thing?”
As he spoke, his eyes were filled with disbelief.
Wang Qing was also stunned. He looked at the wine in Secretary Wang’s hand. Wasn’t this just a bottle of wine?
Furthermore, it was from that poor kid.
What was it? Was there anything else special about it?

chapters.title: Chapter 84: First-Grade Restaurant!
paragraphs: “Secretary Wang, what are you doing? It’s just wine given by a poor kid. Why are you treating it like a treasure?” Wang Qing smiled.
Then, a cold snort sounded.
“Brother Wang, previously, I really didn’t understand why you’re so good at dealing with things, yet you’re only where you are now. It turns out that your horizons are too low.”
“Do you know what this is?”
“It’s red wine.” Wang Qing looked at it. “It’s not a branded red wine.”
“Heh!”

Secretary Wang touched the red wine. “I’ve seen this red wine before. This was made by the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu. CEO Jiang hired a top foreign brewing master to make it a few years ago. There were only two barrels and a few dozen bottles.”
What?
It was made by the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Zhengyu!
Furthermore, he had hired a top-notch brewing master. There were only a few dozen bottles!
If Secretary Wang had not said these words confidently, he would have thought that Secretary Wang had gone crazy!

“The time I saw it was when CEO Jiang treated more than ten CEOs to a meal. Other than CEO Jiang and CEO Ma Ke of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, whose wine glasses were more than half-filled, the other CEOs only had one-third of their glasses filled!”
“The other higher-ups can only smell the fragrance of this wine.”
“People like me can only satisfy my eyes by looking at the wine!”
This!
How was this possible!
This wine was actually so precious!
Secretary Wang took a deep breath. “CEO Lin only drank a third of this glass. Yet, it still lingers in his mind.”
“Now, you’re telling me that this is a gift from a county boy. Do you think I’m stupid?”
When Wang Qing heard Secretary Wang’s words, his eyes widened. He simply could not believe what he had heard.
At the side, Auntie Song was also stunned when she heard these words. She had been in Jiang City for so long. If she didn’t know about Cauldron Dragon Security, she would be too ignorant!
However, she could not understand why Xiao Yun had CEO Jiang’s wine. Furthermore, it was such a precious wine!
Wang Yuanyuan was even more stunned. She burst into tears.
Her crying shocked Wang Qing.
“Yuanyuan, what’s wrong?”
“Dad! I...”
Wang Yuanyuan told everyone what had happened between her and Chen Yun. Everyone was shocked!
Chen Yun!
He fought against more than ten of Tan Zekun’s knife-wielding subordinates alone!
In less than a minute, they were all knocked down! They were beaten into dead dogs!
He even walked side by side with Zheng Jianghao at the East Mountain Villa!
Today, he had scared Young Master Zheng Wenyu!
The words “get lost” made Young Master Yu flee in a sorry state!
He even gave away such high-end red wine that even the upper echelons of Jiang City could only dream of obtaining!
After saying that, Wang Yuanyuan sat on the ground and looked at Auntie Song in front of her. “Mom, I was wrong. Can you... tell Chen Yun? I actually...”
Auntie Song glanced at Wang Yuanyuan and shook her head. “I’m really disappointed in you. Even as your mother, I can’t do that.”

Beside him, Wang Qing was also the same. He was stunned. He never expected that the poor boy from a county city that he had looked down on previously would actually jump up and become like a phoenix on a branch, like a true dragon that leaped across the sea!

Beside him, Secretary Wang looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “I think that your friend isn’t as simple as you say. According to your description, if I’m not wrong, the other young man who was walking beside Zheng Jianghao the other day at the East Mountain Villa that day should be Jiang Shouheng!”
“He’s Jiang Zhengyu’s son!”

“Furthermore, heh. Even Young Master Jiang Shouheng can’t give such a bottle of red wine. If it weren’t for CEO Jiang’s approval, who would dare to give it away?!” Secretary Wang gasped. “You guys are really... Hehe, you let go of a big shot that even CEO Jiang respects.”
As he spoke, he took out the card he had received previously from his pocket. “I’m sorry, Brother Wang. I won’t help you with this matter. Take care!”
“Let me tell you one last thing. Even CEO Lin is nothing in front of CEO Jiang. CEO Jiang is a person with a net worth of more than two billion yuan!”
“If you have such a friend, even CEO Lin will have to rely on you, let alone me!”
“You’re really interesting.”
After Secretary Wang finished speaking, he gestured to Auntie Song and left.
The next moment, Wang Qing collapsed on the sofa, his eyes listless.
Why...
Why did a poor boy from the countryside instantly become a popular person beside CEO Jiang?
If he didn’t show such an attitude to Chen Yun previously, as long as he had a word from CEO Jiang, it would be more useful than 20 years of him working.
This time!
He had missed too much!
Auntie Song looked at the two of them from the side and snorted, ignoring them.

She turned around and sighed. While she was happy for Chen Yun, she was also worried. According to her daughter, Chen Yun was extremely skilled. Moreover, Jiang Zhengyu was a security guard. With the connection between the two, Jiang Zhengyu should have thought highly of Chen Yun’s skills.
If Xiao Yun really joined the Cauldron Dragon security team, would there be any danger?
Auntie Song’s mind was a mess. Coupled with the troubles she had today, not only did she not eat dinner, but she also did not sleep much the entire night.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun had a good sleep.
Early the next morning, Zhou Jingyi called and said that the basic arrangements were ready. She invited Chen Yun over to take a look.
It had to be said that Zhou Jingyi was extremely efficient. In just a day, she was almost done setting up.
Chen Yun drove over and looked at the restaurant in front of him. Although the scale was not as good as the top East Sea City in Jiang City, it was mainly charming and had an antique aura.

Compared to East Sea City, it was much more noble. It was as if East Sea City could let people who could afford to pay for food enter, but this was a place where only high-ranking officials and nobles could come.
“Director Chen.” Zhou Jingyi was giving instructions inside. When she saw Chen Yun, she hurriedly walked out.
Old Master Xu Bin also walked out quickly. He looked at Chen Yun with tears in his eyes. “Young Master, thank you for giving me this chance. I will definitely...”
Hearing Xu Bin’s guarantee, Chen Yun could imagine how a person who had fallen from grace would feel now that he had such an opportunity.

“Alright, Elder Xu, you don’t have to call me Young Master. Just call me Boss.” As Chen Yun spoke, he changed the topic. “I’ve handed this place to you. Not only do you have to retain your customers, but you also have to nurture a group of disciples and pass down your skills. These requirements aren’t high, right?”
These words were a little cold, making Xu Bin’s body tremble. “Boss, I’ll definitely do it well and spread my skills. If I don’t do anything well, I’ll get lost immediately!”
“Good!”
Chen Yun looked at Xu Bin and smiled. The way to control people was to use both kindness and power.
Then, he looked up at the huge golden plaque in front of him.
“First-grade Restaurant!”
This was a nice name.
Chen Yun strode in and looked at the decorations inside. His eyes lit up.
