If it weren’t for CEO Jiang’s approval, who would dare to give it away?!” Secretary Wang gasped.
“You guys are really...
Hehe, you let go of a big shot that even CEO Jiang respects.”
As he spoke, he took out the card he had received previously from his pocket.
“I’m sorry, Brother Wang.
I won’t help you with this matter.
Take care!”
“Let me tell you one last thing.
Even CEO Lin is nothing in front of CEO Jiang.
CEO Jiang is a person with a net worth of more than two billion yuan!”
“If you have such a friend, even CEO Lin will have to rely on you, let alone me!”
“You’re really interesting.”
After Secretary Wang finished speaking, he gestured to Auntie Song and left.
The next moment, Wang Qing collapsed on the sofa, his eyes listless.
Why...
Why did a poor boy from the countryside instantly become a popular person beside CEO Jiang?
If he didn’t show such an attitude to Chen Yun previously, as long as he had a word from CEO Jiang, it would be more useful than 20 years of him working.
This time!
He had missed too much!
Auntie Song looked at the two of them from the side and snorted, ignoring them.
She turned around and sighed.
While she was happy for Chen Yun, she was also worried.
According to her daughter, Chen Yun was extremely skilled.
Moreover, Jiang Zhengyu was a security guard.
With the connection between the two, Jiang Zhengyu should have thought highly of Chen Yun’s skills.
If Xiao Yun really joined the Cauldron Dragon security team, would there be any danger?
Auntie Song’s mind was a mess.
Coupled with the troubles she had today, not only did she not eat dinner, but she also did not sleep much the entire night.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun had a good sleep.
Early the next morning, Zhou Jingyi called and said that the basic arrangements were ready.
She invited Chen Yun over to take a look.
It had to be said that Zhou Jingyi was extremely efficient.
In just a day, she was almost done setting up.
Chen Yun drove over and looked at the restaurant in front of him.
Although the scale was not as good as the top East Sea City in Jiang City, it was mainly charming and had an antique aura.
Compared to East Sea City, it was much more noble.
It was as if East Sea City could let people who could afford to pay for food enter, but this was a place where only high-ranking officials and nobles could come.
“Director Chen.” Zhou Jingyi was giving instructions inside.
When she saw Chen Yun, she hurriedly walked out.
Old Master Xu Bin also walked out quickly.
He looked at Chen Yun with tears in his eyes.
“Young Master, thank you for giving me this chance.
I will definitely...”
Hearing Xu Bin’s guarantee, Chen Yun could imagine how a person who had fallen from grace would feel now that he had such an opportunity.
“Alright, Elder Xu, you don’t have to call me Young Master.
Just call me Boss.” As Chen Yun spoke, he changed the topic.
“I’ve handed this place to you.
Not only do you have to retain your customers, but you also have to nurture a group of disciples and pass down your skills.
These requirements aren’t high, right?”
These words were a little cold, making Xu Bin’s body tremble.
“Boss, I’ll definitely do it well and spread my skills.
If I don’t do anything well, I’ll get lost immediately!”
“Good!”
Chen Yun looked at Xu Bin and smiled.
The way to control people was to use both kindness and power.
Then, he looked up at the huge golden plaque in front of him.
“First-grade Restaurant!”
This was a nice name.
Chen Yun strode in and looked at the decorations inside.
His eyes lit up.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Supreme-Grade Mission!
paragraphs: When Zhou Jingyi bought the shop, the interior had already been renovated. At this moment, there were high-end tables and chairs, as well as various decorative calligraphy and paintings.
[Host, please check-in here now.]
Chen Yun was stunned for a moment before pressing the button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast recipe.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a complete menu of the eight cuisines.]
[The recipes have already been sent to your car.]
Had he obtained recipes?
On the other hand, Chen Yu smiled. He truly obtained what he needed at this moment.
He immediately turned around and walked towards the Maserati Quattroporte outside. He went to the trunk and opened it. There were two stacks of books piled there.
Chen Yun waved his hand. Then, Zhou Jingyi and Xu Bin immediately walked over.
“Elder Xu, take these things and study them.”
This was!
Elder Xu looked at the first book, his eyes simply shining. He could not believe what he was seeing. It was a full set of recipes for the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast!
This!
One had to know that although his ancestors were chefs from the imperial kitchen, there was really no such recipe for the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast!
After all, it took too long. Furthermore, that was also a secret. Even the recipe was passed down by word of mouth.
Even now, he could only deduce the recipe.
After flipping through a few pages, Xu Bin’s face turned red, as if he had seen a peerless treasure.
Although the recipes of some dishes on it were different from what he had deduced, they were more authentic.
There was no mistake!
Then, he looked at the recipes of the eight major cuisines!
Each recipe was especially clear!
It made Xu Bin love it so much that he could not bear to part with it.
“Boss, are these really for me to read?”

“Of course, but don’t spread the recipes.” The corners of Chen Yun’s mouth curled up as he looked at First-Grade Restaurant. With these recipes and Mr. Xu Bin’s cooking, it could be said that the First-Grade Restaurant would not reach a ceiling.
Chen Yun looked at Zhou Jingyi, who also looked slightly tired.

After all, the current Zhou Jingyi was in charge of Sacred Heaven’s Operations Department. Then, she controlled the various matters of Tianyun Live-Stream. Next, she would be in charge of the First-Grade Restaurant.
It was no wonder that she looked so tired.
“Jingyi, I’ll give you something.” Chen Yun took out a bottle of Heavenly Spirit Water from the car and handed it to Zhou Jingyi.
“What is this? Is it drinkable?”
“Try it.”

Zhou Jingyi almost did not hesitate to open it and simply drank it. After all, it was all thanks to Chen Yun that she could have everything she had now. Otherwise, without Chen Yun, she would still be a small salesperson in Motor City or elsewhere. This was also the reason why she worked so hard.
A scholar would die for his confidant, while a woman would dress up for her lover.
She was like this.
She had absolute trust in Chen Yun!
After drinking a mouthful of the Heavenly Spirit Water, Zhou Jingyi’s eyes widened. The fatigue on her body instantly disappeared, and her entire body seemed to have woken up.
Moreover, this feeling would not gradually dissipate like the effects of injections. It was as if all the cells in her body had been reborn.
“After you return, choose some people from Sacred Heaven to form your own team. In the future, you will be in charge of Tianyun Live-Stream and the First-Grade Restaurant,” said Chen Yun slowly.

This time, Zhou Jingyi was flattered. She naturally knew the potential of Tianyun Live-Stream and First-Grade Restaurant. Chen Yun actually asked her to take care of them. How could she not be surprised?
“Alright, Director Chen. I’ll definitely do my best.”

“In two days, the opening ceremony will be held at noon, while there will be a discount at night. As for how to promote it, think about it yourselves. The first thing is to spread the reputation of the First-Grade Restaurant,” said Chen Yun before getting into the car and heading home.
[Check-in Mission: Three days later at noon, at the medicinal herb market.]
Oh?
Was there a new check-in mission?
Then.
[A supreme-grade check-in mission has been activated.]
What was this?
Chen Yun looked at the golden words on the screen.
Had a supreme-grade check-in mission been activated?
Just this name alone was scary!
Usually, he would check-in or receive check-in missions. However, this time, not only was the name very impressive, but even the words had changed from black to gold.
[From now on, you have to complete all check-ins or check-in missions. If there are additional missions, they also have to be completed perfectly!]
[After completion, you will randomly obtain a supreme-grade card.]
[If you gather three supreme-grade cards, you can exchange them for the supreme-grade reward for this mission.]
[Reward unknown.]
A supreme-grade reward!

Among the rewards that Chen Yun had received now, the Gun King Skill Pack and the antioxidant chlorella were obtained from the supreme-grade spinner wheel. The rewards this time were probably even more terrifying than those two items.
For a moment, the corners of Chen Yun’s mouth curled up into a smile. No matter what top-grade reward it was, he would definitely take it!

For the next two days, Zhou Jingyi and Xu Bin were busy with the First-Grade Restaurant. From the renovation to the purchasing channel to the selection of chefs in the kitchen, they were extremely strict.
Moreover, the hostesses here were all chosen by Zhou Jingyi. Every one of them was given a high salary, which was double the salary of the hostesses in East Sea City!
At the same time, Sacred Heaven used the promotional power in Jiang City to promote the First-Grade Restaurant.
They even launched an online lottery event where one could win a free meal worth 20,000 yuan, causing the entire First-Grade Restaurant to instantly become popular.
At this moment, in the Jiang City University of Science and Technology.

“Wang Liang, look, another high-end restaurant is about to open in Jiang City. It’s called the First-Grade Restaurant. It’s being promoted. A total of 30 lucky winners will be able to eat a free meal worth up to 20,000 yuan.”
“I saw it. I’ve participated in it.” Wang Liang waved his phone. “Hurry up and participate too. It’s fine as long as we have one prize. Then, we can eat there together.”
“Okay!” His roommates quickly agreed. However, in the next moment, they smiled bitterly. “Can we really win?”
Although Wang Liang did not have much hope, he still wanted to give it a try.
After registering, the few of them did not care. After all, they did not have the confidence to obtain such a a deal.
At noon, they went out to get food as usual.
However, after eating, Wang Liang received a message on his phone.
[Congratulations on winning the reward!]
Just looking at these words, Wang Liang almost deleted the message.
Heh!
Those damned scammers were still using such a trick!
However, he took another look.
[Congratulations on obtaining a free meal at First-Grade Restaurant. You can bring up to eight friends...]
This!
“F*ck!”
Wang Liang shouted on the spot, scaring his two roommates. “What are you doing?! You almost scared me to death!”
“I won the lottery!”
“What lottery?” His two roommates also came over and looked at Wang Liang’s message.
“F*ck!”
“Brother Liang, your face is simply that of a pretty boy.”
Pui, pui, pui.
Wang Liang pursed his lips. Wasn’t this cursing?
The three of them looked at the food in their hands and immediately felt that it was no longer fragrant. After all, the feast tomorrow night was waiting for them!
They could eat whatever they wanted, as long as the total was below 20,000 yuan!
The three of them decided on the spot that from now on, they would only eat one bowl of porridge every meal.
“They said that we can bring eight people. I’ll call a few fellow friends.” Wang Liang took out his phone and made the first call. “Hello? Brother Yun? What have you been doing recently?”
“I’ll treat you to dinner tomorrow night. Are you free?”
“There’ll be young ladies present.”

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Opening Ceremony!
paragraphs: “What? Are you not coming even though there’ll be young ladies?”
“Alright, alright. Brother Yun, that’s all for now.”
Wang Liang put down his phone and shrugged. It seemed that he could only call someone else.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun looked at his phone and smiled. Wang Liang was one of his childhood friends and was also admitted to a university in Jiang City. They ate together almost once a month.
However, he really couldn’t make it tomorrow. Tomorrow was the opening ceremony of the First-Grade Restaurant.
He had just put down his phone when he received a message.
[Xiao Xin: Brother Yun, are you free tomorrow? I’ll treat you to a meal.]
Chen Yun was speechless. What was going on today? Did everyone receive their salaries? Everyone thought of him.
Then, Chen Yun also rejected Xiao Xin.
The next day.

Chen Yun woke up in the morning and found a light green custom-made suit from his wardrobe. After putting it on, he walked downstairs and saw that the two little girls had already woken up early and changed into their gowns.

Chen Mengmeng was wearing a pink gown, while Han Xue was wearing a light blue gown. They were both wearing high heels and looked like daughters of wealthy families. Chen Mengmeng also restrained herself a lot and became dignified.
Indeed, clothes made the man.
They looked like completely different people when they wore gowns.

The two of them looked at Chen Yun, who was walking down the stairs, and their eyes widened. Chen Yun was wearing a green and white suit with pure white leather shoes, giving off an extremely refreshing feeling.
“Are you all dressed up?”
“Let’s go. We’ll set off after eating.”
After eating, Chen Yun drove the Mercedes-Benz G and brought the two little girls to the First-Grade Restaurant.
After arriving, many people had already arrived, including Jiang Zhengyu, Ma Ke, and the others.

There was a man standing beside Jiang Zhengyu. He was chatting and laughing with Jiang Zhengyu. Then, when they heard the sound of a car, they turned around and saw Chen Yun jumping out of the Mercedes-Benz G.
“Director Chen is here.”
“Let’s go over.”
For a moment, the few of them walked over. Beside them, many CEOs were at a loss when they saw this situation.
“Where are these CEOs going?”
“I don’t know.”
“What are you waiting for?!” A middle-aged man looked at them and quickly said, “Director Chen is here. Do you know him?”
Director Chen was here!
These words made the few of them tremble and they immediately followed quickly.
What a joke!
Why were they here today?!
They were here to support Director Chen and give Sacred Heaven Entertainment some respect!
Otherwise, no matter how big the restaurant was or how delicious the dishes were, it would not be able to gather so many CEOs and directors.
When Zhou Jingyi saw Chen Yun arrive, she jogged over.
The moment Chen Yun got out of the car, he became the focus of everyone.
“Director Chen, you’re here.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, I’m...”
“Director Chen, I’ve admired you for a long time.”
Chen Yun looked at these people and nodded first. Then, he looked at Zhou Jingyi, who had squeezed over. “Jingyi, how’s the preparation for the opening ceremony later?”
“It’s ready.”
“Okay.”
At the side, Ma Ke, Jiang Zhengyu, and the others came over.
“Director Chen.”
“You guys are early,” said Chen Yun with a smile.
Jiang Zhengyu waved his hand. “Director Chen, the First-Grade Restaurant is opening today. How can we not come and congratulate you earlier?”
“Director Chen, I’m Zheng Yuan, Zheng Jianghao’s father. I’ve long heard of your name, but I haven’t had the chance to visit you. I’ve finally seen you today.”
Chen Yun looked at Zheng Yuan and nodded. “Then we must drink more today.”
“Alright, when I come back, I’ll toast a few cups to you.” When Zheng Yuan heard Chen Yun’s words, he immediately beamed with joy. This was all thanks to his son. He was really hardworking!

Ma Ke stepped forward and introduced the CEOs present to Chen Yun one by one. Meanwhile, those executives or ordinary directors knew their status and did not approach him. After all, with Chen Yun’s status, their CEOs were not worthy in front of him, not to mention them.
After the introduction, Chen Yun gestured. “Everyone, stop standing outside. Go in and sit.”

When most of the people had entered, Ma Ke looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, this time, we distributed the invitation cards to the CEOs and the Chairmen of Jiang City. Everyone who indicated that they were attending should be here now. I estimate that nearly 40% of them aren’t coming.”

“These people are all from corporations and families that follow the Su family’s lead, or the CEOs or Chairmen of companies that are related to Huaying and the other businesses of the Su family,” said Ma Ke said with a sinister gaze.
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered. “It seems like the Su family and Huaying want to fight me. Do they have the strength to fight me?”
His words were extremely arrogant.
Beside him, Zheng Yuan and Jiang Zhengyu were also stunned. Their eyes were filled with surprise as they looked at Chen Yun.
If someone else had said this just now, they would definitely scoff!
After all, what kind of role did the Su family play?
That was an aristocratic family that had been around for decades. They owned Huaying and many businesses!
Moreover, they had a wide network. It was already considered small to say that the Su family was a tyrant in Jiang City.
However, when Chen Yun said this, it was different.
Chen Yun alone controlled Sacred Heaven, Tianyun Live-Stream, the East Mountain Villa, and the magical Heavenly Spirit Water. He had the strength to match or even surpass the Su family!
“Give me a list of the CEOs who weren’t present today. I want to see who isn’t giving me respect.”
These words were extremely cold, causing the people beside Chen Yun to immediately feel a chill run down their spines. The hair on their bodies stood on end.
“Alright, Director Chen. I’ll do it immediately.” Ma Ke quickly agreed.
“Alright, let’s go in too. You guys probably haven’t gone in to take a look.” Chen Yun’s expression changed as he brought the few people around him in.
After entering, even though these CEOs were used to big scenes, they were still shocked.
He was really generous!
It was more than luxurious. It could only be described as extravagant!
After looking around, everyone’s horizons were broadened.
“It’s indeed a restaurant opened by Director Chen. This is simply extraordinary.”
“I wonder how the dishes are?”
“I heard from CEO Jiang that the chef is also extraordinary.”
“That’s right. Director Chen spent a lot of money to set up this restaurant. How can he not hire a good chef?”
Everyone discussed these issues until noon.
The opening ceremony officially began!

Chen Yun put on his corsage and went on stage to give a speech. The CEOs stood on both sides and listened to Chen Yun’s words. From time to time, they would nod in agreement. At the side, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Chen Yun on the stage, their eyes practically sparkling.
Their brother was too handsome!
At this moment, his sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes were simply like the face of a king!
He looked down on everyone!
With a wave of his hand, he guided the world!
To outsiders, this was just a normal speech, but to Chen Mengmeng, it was very different.
After the speech.
Zhou Jingyi waved her hand.
Eight rows of 64 cannons instantly roared!
There were a total of 800 cannon shots!
It shook the world!

The two lions came from the east and west to perform a lion dance. They stepped on the plum blossom stakes and moved along with the rhythm of the drums. Each of their movements was extremely difficult, making everyone present exclaim.
The CEOs present were all shocked by such a big scene!

Then, he looked at Zhou Jingyi, who had squeezed over.
“Jingyi, how’s the preparation for the opening ceremony later?”
“It’s ready.”
“Okay.”
At the side, Ma Ke, Jiang Zhengyu, and the others came over.
“Director Chen.”
“You guys are early,” said Chen Yun with a smile.
Jiang Zhengyu waved his hand.
“Director Chen, the First-Grade Restaurant is opening today.
How can we not come and congratulate you earlier?”
“Director Chen, I’m Zheng Yuan, Zheng Jianghao’s father.
I’ve long heard of your name, but I haven’t had the chance to visit you.
I’ve finally seen you today.”
Chen Yun looked at Zheng Yuan and nodded.
“Then we must drink more today.”
“Alright, when I come back, I’ll toast a few cups to you.” When Zheng Yuan heard Chen Yun’s words, he immediately beamed with joy.
This was all thanks to his son.
He was really hardworking!
Ma Ke stepped forward and introduced the CEOs present to Chen Yun one by one.
Meanwhile, those executives or ordinary directors knew their status and did not approach him.
After all, with Chen Yun’s status, their CEOs were not worthy in front of him, not to mention them.
After the introduction, Chen Yun gestured.
“Everyone, stop standing outside.
Go in and sit.”
When most of the people had entered, Ma Ke looked at Chen Yun.
“Director Chen, this time, we distributed the invitation cards to the CEOs and the Chairmen of Jiang City.
Everyone who indicated that they were attending should be here now.
I estimate that nearly 40% of them aren’t coming.”

“These people are all from corporations and families that follow the Su family’s lead, or the CEOs or Chairmen of companies that are related to Huaying and the other businesses of the Su family,” said Ma Ke said with a sinister gaze.
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered.
“It seems like the Su family and Huaying want to fight me.
Do they have the strength to fight me?”
His words were extremely arrogant.
Beside him, Zheng Yuan and Jiang Zhengyu were also stunned.
Their eyes were filled with surprise as they looked at Chen Yun.
If someone else had said this just now, they would definitely scoff!
After all, what kind of role did the Su family play?
That was an aristocratic family that had been around for decades.
They owned Huaying and many businesses!
Moreover, they had a wide network.
It was already considered small to say that the Su family was a tyrant in Jiang City.
However, when Chen Yun said this, it was different.
Chen Yun alone controlled Sacred Heaven, Tianyun Live-Stream, the East Mountain Villa, and the magical Heavenly Spirit Water.
He had the strength to match or even surpass the Su family!
“Give me a list of the CEOs who weren’t present today.
I want to see who isn’t giving me respect.”
These words were extremely cold, causing the people beside Chen Yun to immediately feel a chill run down their spines.
The hair on their bodies stood on end.
“Alright, Director Chen.
I’ll do it immediately.” Ma Ke quickly agreed.
“Alright, let’s go in too.
You guys probably haven’t gone in to take a look.” Chen Yun’s expression changed as he brought the few people around him in.
After entering, even though these CEOs were used to big scenes, they were still shocked.
He was really generous!
It was more than luxurious.
It could only be described as extravagant!
After looking around, everyone’s horizons were broadened.
“It’s indeed a restaurant opened by Director Chen.
This is simply extraordinary.”
“I wonder how the dishes are?”
“I heard from CEO Jiang that the chef is also extraordinary.”
“That’s right.
Director Chen spent a lot of money to set up this restaurant.
How can he not hire a good chef?”
Everyone discussed these issues until noon.
The opening ceremony officially began!
Chen Yun put on his corsage and went on stage to give a speech.
The CEOs stood on both sides and listened to Chen Yun’s words.
From time to time, they would nod in agreement.
At the side, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at Chen Yun on the stage, their eyes practically sparkling.
Their brother was too handsome!
At this moment, his sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes were simply like the face of a king!
He looked down on everyone!
With a wave of his hand, he guided the world!
To outsiders, this was just a normal speech, but to Chen Mengmeng, it was very different.
After the speech.
Zhou Jingyi waved her hand.
Eight rows of 64 cannons instantly roared!
There were a total of 800 cannon shots!
It shook the world!
The two lions came from the east and west to perform a lion dance.
They stepped on the plum blossom stakes and moved along with the rhythm of the drums.
Each of their movements was extremely difficult, making everyone present exclaim.
The CEOs present were all shocked by such a big scene!

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Taking Advantage of me?
paragraphs: “Eight hundred cannon salutes!”
“Oh my god, isn’t this Second Master Huang, known as the Lion King of Jiang City? He actually came to help personally!” A CEO looked at the lion dancer in front of him and gasped.
Second Master Huang was said to be the descendant of Huang Feihong. Not only was his appearance fee high, but he was also not someone ordinary people could invite.
For example, when his company opened for business, he spent a lot of money to invite Second Master Huang over, but Second Master Huang ignored him.
But now!
Not only did the other party come!
He even personally went on stage!
Moreover, he brought his best disciple!
There was no need to mention such a comparison!
There were also many passers-by around them. They did not know Second Master Huang, but they were shocked by this scene.
Eight hundred cannon salutes had been fired!
Luxury cars had gathered!
None of the cars parked there were worth less than a million yuan!
Any one of them was a good car that ordinary people could not drive in their entire lives!
Back then, when East Sea City opened for business, the crowd was less than one-tenth of this crowd.
Chen Yun looked at the scene in front of him and smiled. Jingyi had done well in such a short period of time. Beside him, Xu Bin had a shocked expression.
He had never seen such a scene before. It was too shocking!
“Elder Xu, go in and cook first. We have to entertain the guests later.”
“Alright.” When Xu Bin heard this, he walked in.
The opening ceremony was very grand!

After the ceremony, Jiang Zhengyu held a calligraphy scroll and handed it to Chen Yun. “Director Chen, this is Zheng Banqiao’s real work. I don’t know what else to give you. I wish you a happy opening!”
“Director Chen, this gift represents my sincerity. This is an oriental jasper carving of a toad. I wish you a prosperous business.” Zheng Yuan quickly went forward as well.
“Director Chen...”
Although the gifts from the others were not as valuable as the gifts given by Jiang Zhengyu and Zheng Jianghao, they had also prepared generous gifts.
“Alright, everyone, please come in and try the cooking of my chef.”
“Alright, then we must taste it well.” Zheng Yuan laughed. Then, he looked at Jiang Zhengyu. “Brother Jiang, let me see if what you said is true. You’re not allowed to lie to me.”
“No, just watch. I guarantee that after this meal, you’ll want to come for every meal.”
“Are you serious, CEO Jiang?”

There were also some CEOs who did not believe him. After all, they were all people who were used to eating delicacies. There was nothing they had not eaten before. They immediately thought that Jiang Zhengyu was bragging.
Jiang Zhengyu did not explain and walked in with a smile.
As soon as they entered the First-Grade Restaurant, a dense fragrance filled the air, shocking everyone.

They had been standing for almost the entire morning. Coupled with the fact that they woke up early in the morning, how could they withstand such temptation? They could not help but swallow a few mouthfuls of saliva.
When the dishes were served.
Everyone’s eyes lit up.
“Is... is this the legendary boiled cabbage?”
“What’s this?”
“This is dried sea cucumber!” A CEO exclaimed. Then, he looked at the dishes on the table. “These... These are all dishes from the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast!”
What?
There was only one thing to say about this!
The entire table was shocked!
These were the dishes of the Manchu-Han Imperial Feast!
Everyone felt their breathing stagnate!
Hahaha...
At the side, Jiang Zhengyu’s lips curled into a smile. “I’m not afraid to tell you the truth. Director Chen’s chef in this restaurant is from the imperial kitchen. So, do you understand?”
Although Jiang Zhengyu was talking, he looked at the things on the table and felt extremely uncomfortable. Damn it, Old Man Xu did not make these dishes when he was at his house previously.
He even learned to hide his skills. They were now fully exposed!
However, Jiang Zhengyu did not know that Xu Bin did not know these dishes previously. He only learned them after reading the recipes Chen Yun gave him.
When the group of CEOs heard Jiang Zhengyu’s words, they couldn’t wait.
“Alright.” Chen Yun stood up and raised his cup. “Thank you for coming to support me today and giving me some respect.”
These words made everyone present stand up and raise their glasses.
“Congratulations, Director Chen!”
“Wishing you a prosperous business!”
“Hoping that the source of your wealth is vast!”

In the afternoon, the CEOs were invited to a banquet. For the entire afternoon, the guests were all happy. Chen Yun also drank a few glasses. However, with his current physical fitness, putting everything else aside, two bottles of high-level wine could only make him slightly tipsy.
After the meal, almost all the plates were empty.

It had to be known that when these CEOs went out to discuss business, they would only move their chopsticks in the face of delicacies. However, such a scene today was enough to acknowledge Xu Bin’s strength.
If even these CEOs with picky mouths could be attracted, there was no need to mention the others.
At night, they began to welcome guests.
There were two rows of hostesses. Their slender legs made one’s imagination run wild, and the service was even more thorough.
On the first night, the restaurant was full. There were many people queuing outside. The scene was like the queue outside Haidilao on New Year’s Eve.
It was simply terrifying!
After tonight, the scene would probably become even more explosive!
At night, Chen Yun continued to eat with Jiang Zhengyu and the others. Ma Ke had already made a list. Chen Yun looked at it and nodded. “Alright, I’ve roughly remembered it.”
His voice was not loud, and there was almost no displeasure in it. However, when everyone looked into Chen Yun’s eyes, their bodies trembled.
At this moment, coldness surged in Chen Yun’s eyes, like frost.
After eating for a while, Chen Yun stood up and prepared to go downstairs to take a look.
When he went downstairs, the scene was really terrifying.
The next moment, his gaze suddenly locked onto a seat. He narrowed his eyes and walked down.
Walking to a table, Chen Yun looked at the three girls wolfing down their food in front of him. They did not care about their image at all and looked helpless.
“Everyone, did you have a good time eating?”
These words made the three girls look up immediately. In the next moment, strange expressions appeared in their eyes.
The three girls were none other than Lin Yu, Zhang Jing, and Xiao Xin.
“Brother Yun!” Xiao Xin’s face immediately turned red. She patted the seat beside her. “Brother Yun, quickly sit down and eat with us.”
Then, Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun. “I invited you, but you didn’t come. In the end, you ran over yourself. You’re really a little arrogant.”
Chen Yun was speechless. She didn’t even tell him that she wanted to invite him here.
He rubbed Xiao Xin’s face. “Are you taking advantage of me now?”
Chen Yun laughed bitterly. He should’ve known that if Xiao Xin participated in this lucky draw, how could she not win?
This girl now had the title of the God of Luck on the Internet. She was said to have special abilities.
This was despite the fact that she obtained her special abilities from freeloading.
The three of them were stunned when they heard Chen Yun’s words. Then, they looked around. “Brother Yun, what did you say just now?”
“Do you own the First-Grade Restaurant?”
“That’s right. Is there a problem?” Chen Yun smiled, making the three girls fall for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Whoever Used Up Their Luck First Would Pass Away First
paragraphs: “This is such a big restaurant.” Xiao Xin looked at the restaurant here, her eyes filled with yearning.
Although she was now an internet celebrity who was popular all over the Internet, such a restaurant was still something she did not dare to think about.
After Chen Yun sat down and chatted with them for a while, Zhang Jing looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, where’s the washroom?”
“I’ll take you there. Coincidentally, I’m preparing to go up too. I still have friends upstairs.”
The two of them stood up and Zhang Jing followed behind Chen Yun.
The next moment, a figure jumped over and hugged Chen Yun from behind. “Brother Yun!”
“Oh?”
Chen Yun turned around and his eyes lit up. “Wang Liang? Brother, why are you here?”
It was none other than Wang Liang, who was wearing sportswear and Nike shoes.

“Are you asking me? I haven’t asked you yet. Brother Yun, you’re doing well now. You’re so handsome.” Then, Wang Liang looked at Zhang Jing, who was behind Chen Yun. “No wonder you didn’t come with us. It turns out that you’re here with your girlfriend.”
“Hello, sister-in-law. I grew up with Brother Yun. My name is Wang Liang.”

Wang Liang acted as if they were close friends and reached out to shake Zhang Jing’s hand. When Zhang Jing heard Wang Liang’s words, her face turned red. Then, she felt ashamed of her inferiority. The current Chen Yun was simply the true dragon of Jiang City. In contrast, she was a student of the Jiang City University of the Arts. If not for her relationship with Xiao Xin, she would probably not have been able to speak to such a big shot in her life.
At that moment, she explained, “No, no. Brother Yun and I don’t have that kind of relationship.”

Wang Liang immediately looked embarrassed. Then, he looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, I won the reward from the First-Grade Restaurant. We can eat anything as long as the total bill is below 20,000 yuan. Let’s go. The students who are attending university in Jiang City like us are also here. Shall we go over and have a drink?”
“I’m not too close with them. When I get home, I’ll call Yuhan and our childhood friends. At that time, I’ll be the host. We won’t go home until we’re drunk.”
“Alright!” Wang Liang knew that Chen Yun did not like such an occasion, so he nodded.
Chen Yun patted Wang Liang’s shoulder and was about to say that he would treat him to dinner.
However, on second thought, this restaurant was his after all.
“I still have friends over there. Just eat well.”

“Alright.” Wang Liang nodded and walked to the back. He even sighed. Although they had grown up as childhood friends and brothers, among this group of people, Lin Yuhan had the best relationship with Brother Yun.
They seemed to be slightly inferior.
Without thinking too much, Wang Liang went back. Everyone looked at him. “What’s wrong?”
“I just met Brother Yun. He also brought his friends here, so he didn’t come over first.” Wang Liang casually lied.

“Chen Yun? How is he now? Previously, when he was in the first year of junior high, he was a famous figure in the entire school.” A girl recalled Chen Yun’s previous appearance and could not help but sigh.

At that time, not only was Chen Yun handsome, but his father was also promoted to the boss of an industrial factory. However, later on, he did not know why his father was only a boss for a very short period of time before he was demoted to a worker.

“When I saw Brother Yun just now, it was as if he had changed into a different person. He was so handsome that I almost didn’t recognize him. Moreover, he was in high spirits and wasn’t as lonely as before.” As Wang Liang spoke, he recalled the past. This girl didn’t know, but he knew that back then, Brother Yun’s brother was recognized as corrupt back then. Thus, he was stripped of his career.
Chen Yun was also affected and his personality became silent.

However, Wang Liang did not think that Uncle Chen would do such a thing. The two families had been very close since they were young. He still remembered that his father often said that Uncle Chen was meticulous and fair.
He did not know these things, nor did he want to know.
“Come, everyone, eat quickly. There’s a limit of 20,000 yuan. Don’t just stand there.” Wang Liang smiled. Then, two waitresses walked over, each holding a bottle of red wine.
“Eh? Miss, we didn’t order red wine,” said a boy with a smile.
The waitresses also had smiles on their faces. “Hello, our boss instructed us to give this Latour Red Wine for everyone to try.”
It was Latour Red Wine!
Wang Liang looked at the wine and immediately gasped. This wine probably cost tens of thousands a bottle!
Why?!
Why did the boss suddenly give them wine?
They had originally come here to take advantage of the restaurant, but now, they were given such precious wine. Did the boss of the First-Grade Restaurant not earn money?!
“No, no, no. We can’t take it. Don’t open it.” Wang Liang quickly waved his hand. “Help me thank your boss for his kindness. We’ve already benefited a lot from him. We really can’t take it anymore.”
The two waitresses looked at each other and then looked at Wang Liang. “You’re Mr. Wang Liang, right? Does your phone number end with 5580?”
“Yes, that’s me.”

“Actually, it’s like this. Your phone number drew a super lucky prize. The gift is this membership card. There’s a limit of 300,000 yuan inside. You can come to the First-Grade Restaurant to spend at any time.”
The waitress handed the membership card in her hand to Wang Liang and bent down slightly. Then, she turned around and left, not giving Wang Liang a chance to refuse.
“F*ck! Brother Liang, you’re f*cking lucky!”
“You’re simply lucky! First, you drew 20,000 yuan, and now, you obtained another 300,000 yuan!”
For a moment, Wang Liang felt a little smug from the praise. Could it be that he was really possessed by the God of Luck?
He looked at his hands. The next moment, his grandmother’s words woke him up.
“Xiao Liang, people have to work hard and not rely on luck. Whoever uses up their luck first will pass away first.”
Not only was he awake, but he was also trembling in fear!
Whoever used up their luck first would pass away first...
On the other hand, Chen Yun also went upstairs when he saw that the waitresses had completed their mission.
At this moment, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were still eating. Without Chen Yun beside them, they sat beside a group of big shots and were so nervous that they did not dare to move.
What should they do? Their brother was impressive, but they were not as impressive as him.
They could only rely on how impressive their brother was.
Now that they were facing a group of big shots, what should they do?
They were urgently waiting for a solution.

Without Chen Yun here, the group of big shots relaxed. They chatted and toasted from time to time. Jiang Zhengyu saw that Chen Mengmeng was reserved, so he stood up and led the way. He walked over and toasted Chen Mengmeng.

Chen Mengmeng was immediately flattered. However, Chen Yun did not let her drink alcohol, so she could only drink soft drinks. Everyone toasted her. After drinking it, Chen Mengmeng felt that she was like a bucket now. She couldn’t even walk steadily.

However, later on, he did not know why his father was only a boss for a very short period of time before he was demoted to a worker.
“When I saw Brother Yun just now, it was as if he had changed into a different person.
He was so handsome that I almost didn’t recognize him.
Moreover, he was in high spirits and wasn’t as lonely as before.” As Wang Liang spoke, he recalled the past.
This girl didn’t know, but he knew that back then, Brother Yun’s brother was recognized as corrupt back then.
Thus, he was stripped of his career.
Chen Yun was also affected and his personality became silent.
However, Wang Liang did not think that Uncle Chen would do such a thing.
The two families had been very close since they were young.
He still remembered that his father often said that Uncle Chen was meticulous and fair.
He did not know these things, nor did he want to know.
“Come, everyone, eat quickly.
There’s a limit of 20,000 yuan.
Don’t just stand there.” Wang Liang smiled.
Then, two waitresses walked over, each holding a bottle of red wine.
“Eh?
Miss, we didn’t order red wine,” said a boy with a smile.
The waitresses also had smiles on their faces.
“Hello, our boss instructed us to give this Latour Red Wine for everyone to try.”
It was Latour Red Wine!
Wang Liang looked at the wine and immediately gasped.
This wine probably cost tens of thousands a bottle!
Why?!
Why did the boss suddenly give them wine?
They had originally come here to take advantage of the restaurant, but now, they were given such precious wine.
Did the boss of the First-Grade Restaurant not earn money?!
“No, no, no.
We can’t take it.
Don’t open it.” Wang Liang quickly waved his hand.
“Help me thank your boss for his kindness.
We’ve already benefited a lot from him.
We really can’t take it anymore.”
The two waitresses looked at each other and then looked at Wang Liang.
“You’re Mr.
Wang Liang, right?
Does your phone number end with 5580?”
“Yes, that’s me.”
“Actually, it’s like this.
Your phone number drew a super lucky prize.
The gift is this membership card.
There’s a limit of 300,000 yuan inside.
You can come to the First-Grade Restaurant to spend at any time.”
The waitress handed the membership card in her hand to Wang Liang and bent down slightly.
Then, she turned around and left, not giving Wang Liang a chance to refuse.
“F*ck!
Brother Liang, you’re f*cking lucky!”
“You’re simply lucky!
First, you drew 20,000 yuan, and now, you obtained another 300,000 yuan!”
For a moment, Wang Liang felt a little smug from the praise.
Could it be that he was really possessed by the God of Luck?
He looked at his hands.
The next moment, his grandmother’s words woke him up.
“Xiao Liang, people have to work hard and not rely on luck.
Whoever uses up their luck first will pass away first.”
Not only was he awake, but he was also trembling in fear!
Whoever used up their luck first would pass away first...
On the other hand, Chen Yun also went upstairs when he saw that the waitresses had completed their mission.
At this moment, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were still eating.
Without Chen Yun beside them, they sat beside a group of big shots and were so nervous that they did not dare to move.
What should they do?
Their brother was impressive, but they were not as impressive as him.
They could only rely on how impressive their brother was.
Now that they were facing a group of big shots, what should they do?
They were urgently waiting for a solution.
Without Chen Yun here, the group of big shots relaxed.
They chatted and toasted from time to time.
Jiang Zhengyu saw that Chen Mengmeng was reserved, so he stood up and led the way.
He walked over and toasted Chen Mengmeng.
Chen Mengmeng was immediately flattered.
However, Chen Yun did not let her drink alcohol, so she could only drink soft drinks.
Everyone toasted her.
After drinking it, Chen Mengmeng felt that she was like a bucket now.
She couldn’t even walk steadily.

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Thousand-Year-Old Medicine!
paragraphs: In a day, the reputation of the First-Grade Restaurant had already spread throughout Jiang City. The next day, there were people waiting at the door early in the morning. Zhou Jingyi had no choice but to adopt a turnover system in the hall and an appointment system in the private rooms.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun brought Xiao Xin and her roommates to the medicinal herb market early in the morning.
Today’s check-in mission was here.
Chen Yun, Xiao Xin, and the other two girls got out of the car. Xiao Xin looked over. “Brother Yun, we’re here to get medicine. Why are you here?”
Yesterday, when Xiao Xin heard that Chen Yun was coming here today, she told him that Lin Yu’s health hadn’t been good recently. Her period was irregular, so she bought some herbs to recuperate.
“I’m here to buy some herbs too.” Chen Yun lied. He could not say that he was here to check in, right?
After shopping for a while.
[Host, please check in.]
He pressed the check-in button.
[Congratulations on obtaining a thousand-year-old ginseng.]
[Congratulations on obtaining a thousand-year knotweed.]
[Congratulations on obtaining a thousand-year-old Rhizoma Gastrodiae.]
[The items have been placed in your trunk.]
[Congratulations on obtaining the Unparalleled Medical Skill.]
The Unparalleled Medical Skill?

Chen Yun did not expect to obtain so much from checking in this time. He obtained three thousand-year-old Chinese medicines and the Unparalleled Medical Skill. However, Chen Yun really did not know what the use of the Unparalleled Medical Skill was.
He had the Heavenly Spirit Water now, so why did he need the Unparalleled Medical Skill?
Was he supposed to treat the illnesses of others?
Dream on!
Chen Yun sneered and turned to walk to the trunk. He looked at the three red arm-long boxes inside and slowly opened them.
“Damn! It’s so big!”

Even Chen Yun was shocked. The ginseng that entered his eyes was simply longer than an arm and a little red. There was a red string tied at the top. The fragrance also burst out the moment he opened the box.
He checked into the two boxes beside him. The Rhizoma Gastrodiae and knotweed inside were also ordinary. They were simply terrifyingly big.
“How much are these three things worth?” Chen Yun thought as he looked at De Ren Tang1. Then, he walked over with the three boxes.
“Brother Yun, what did you take out from the trunk?” Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun’s box and asked curiously.
“Herbs.”
Herbs?

The three girls looked at the boxes that Chen Yun was holding. Zhang Jing blinked. What was going on? It was not that she had never seen medicinal herbs before. However, other people’s medicinal herb boxes were the size of a palm. The largest was only the length of half an arm. However, Chen Yun’s boxes were more exaggerated. The boxes were longer than an arm.
How big could the herbs inside be? Why did they have to use such a big box to store them?
Xiao Xin and Lin Yu had the same thoughts.
After shopping for a while, Chen Yun looked at De Ren Tang in front of him and walked in.
Now that Western medicine was developed and Chinese medicine was desolate, there were naturally not many people in De Ren Tang. There were only ten or so patients picking up medicine at the entrance.
Seeing Chen Yun and the others enter, the girl at the counter quickly walked over.
“Hello, what can I do for you?”
“Do you have medicinal herbs that are more than a hundred years old here?” Chen Yun asked slowly, causing the girl’s smile to suddenly freeze. As if she did not hear him clearly, she asked him again.
Chen Yun repeated his question and the girl nodded. “Yes, yes, but I’m going to invite the old master. Please wait a moment.”
Chen Yun nodded.
After the girl left, Xiao Xin and the other two looked at Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, what are you doing?”
“I’m buying medicine.”

A moment later, an old man in his fifties or sixties walked out. He adjusted his reading glasses and looked at Chen Yun in front of him. “Young Sir, are you the one who wants to buy old medicine that is more than a hundred years old?”

Every old medicine above a hundred years old was extremely precious. Even De Ren Tang, which was known as the oldest pharmacy in the entire Jiang City, only had a dozen or so of such medicines. Therefore, when he heard that Chen Yun wanted to buy old medicine above a hundred years old, he was naturally surprised.
This was especially the case with Chen Yun’s young appearance.
“Yes, take it out and let me take a look.”
The old man took out a hundred-year-old ginseng and opened the box. A ginseng that was not much bigger than a palm appeared.
Chen Yun looked at the ginseng in front of him. “It’s a little small.”
“How much are all the herbs?”
After the old man finished calculating, he said, “A total of 50 million.”
Fifty million?
It was not enough to trigger the Random Distribution Skill.
“Alright, pack them up for me.”
Chen Yun’s words made the old man’s eyes light up. He met a big client today!
He bought 50 million yuan worth of medicinal herbs as if he was buying candy. The old man had never seen such a generous person!
The herbs were packed and the bill was paid.
Outside, a voice sounded. “Old Wang, long time no see. How have you been?”
The old man from De Ren Tang looked at the person outside and quickly walked out of the counter with a smile on his face. “Why do you have time to come to my place today?”
“I’ve been testing medicines recently, so I came to take a look.”
The old man’s voice was not soft, attracting the attention of the people beside him. It immediately caused a few exclamations.
“I didn’t expect to meet this person today.”
“Who is this? Is he very powerful?” A person who didn’t understand what was happening looked at the old man in a long coat and asked curiously.

“Don’t you know this person? To think that you’re a medical student. You’re planning to enter a Chinese Medicine Hospital in the future!” That person curled his lips. “This person is the pillar of Jiang City Chinese Medicine Hospital, Divine Doctor Zhang Ming. I heard that back then, the Chinese Medicine Hospital spent tens of millions of yuan to hire him with twice the salary. Don’t you think he’s amazing?!”
These few words made the few people beside him widen their eyes. F*ck, they spent tens of millions of yuan to hire him with twice the salary!
Just the conditions given by the Chinese Medical Hospital to this old man were enough to show this person’s strength!
It was simply terrifying!

At this moment, Zhang Ming looked at the red box beside him. He simply took one of the boxes and opened it. He looked at the ginseng inside and his eyes lit up. “Old Wang, why did you take out your treasure today? Coincidentally, I’m lacking a medicinal primer for testing medicine. How much is this ginseng? I’ll buy it.”
The old man paused, causing Zhang Ming to frown and ask, “What’s wrong?”
“This little brother has already bought this ginseng.”
Had it been bought?

Zhang Ming pushed the old man away and looked at Chen Yun. He observed Chen Yun and said, “You’re young, but you still dare to buy such things. Why did you buy them? It’s a waste of resources. If you give this to me, I’ll thank you.”
“Who are you? Is your thanks worth a lot?” Chen Yun looked at Zhang Ming and sneered.

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Is It Very Valuable?
paragraphs: “Who are you?”
“Is your thanks worth a lot?”
As soon as Chen Yun said this, many people beside him widened their eyes. They could not believe what they had heard. Someone actually dared to say that Zhang Ming’s thanks was worthless!
One had to know that it was simply impossible for ordinary people to invite Divine Doctor Zhang to take action!
Even those high-ranking officials and nobles who wanted Divine Doctor Zhang to take action had to see the price and Divine Doctor Zhang’s mood that day!

Now that Divine Doctor Zhang had taken the initiative to give this young man his thanks, it was equivalent to giving this young man a chance to be reborn. However, not only was this young man not confident, he even asked if Divine Doctor Zhang’s favor was worth anything!
No one knew what he was thinking!

Even Zhang Ming was stunned. He looked at Chen Yun and laughed loudly. “Are you saying that my thanks is worthless? How many high-ranking officials have invited me with precious money but couldn’t invite me? Little brother, even if you have some money, don’t be too arrogant. Can you guarantee that you won’t be sick for the rest of your life? What a joke.”
Zhang Ming shook his head and put the ginseng away. “Old Wang, refund his money. I’ll buy this thing.”

“Kid, some things belong to the virtuous. I, Zhang Ming, came from a family that studies Chinese medicine. I knew medicine at the age of three, read books at the age of five, and was already famous in the city at the age of ten. Up until now, I’ve treated hundreds, even thousands, of patients. I won’t brag anymore. In Jiang City or even Jiangbei, I can be among the top three Chinese medicine doctors. The value of this thing is definitely different in my hands compared to yours!”
“So, look at your position clearly. Don’t waste this treasure.”
You!

When Xiao Xin and the other two girls beside Chen Yun heard Zhang Ming’s words, they snorted. What did he mean by saying that some things belonged to the virtuous? When buying things, it was all about first come, first served. Brother Yun had already bought it, but this old man was simply here to snatch it!
Not only did he snatch it, but he also snatched it confidently and sanctimoniously!
How could they not be angry?!
However, at this moment, the public opinion didn’t support Chen Yun and the others.
At the side, many people looked at Chen Yun and spoke.
“Elder Zhang’s medical skills are rare even in China, let alone in Jiangbei!”
“That’s right. Do you still want to snatch the medicinal herbs from Divine Doctor Zhang? Hurry up and hand them over obediently. When the time comes, Elder Zhang can help you save your life!”
“That’s right!”
Haha.
Chen Yun sneered and shook his head. “How dare you call yourself the Divine Doctor when you can’t even treat your own illness? What a joke.”
“How dare you!” Someone beside him immediately jumped out. “Is Divine Doctor Zhang someone you can mock!”
“Why don’t you take a look at yourself?!”
“Hurry up and apologize to Divine Doctor Zhang!”
Even Old Man Wang looked at Chen Yun and frowned. “Young friend, your words are a little harsh.”
In his opinion, Chen Yun was looking down on Zhang Ming’s reputation with his words. He was simply asking for a scolding!
His own illness?
When Zhang Ming heard Chen Yun’s words, he frowned. “What did you say?!”

“Look at your right hand. There’s no need to say much. In another half a year, you won’t even be able to grab medicine. Sometimes, you should believe in Western medicine. Amputate your arm in half a year. Anyway, you won’t feel anything even if you keep it.”

When Zhang Ming heard Chen Yun’s words, his eyes suddenly widened. He looked at his right hand. His right hand had already shown signs of illness half a year ago. Now, it was spasming from time to time. How could this kid tell at a glance?!
He was stunned, and his eyes revealed disbelief.
He had also interviewed many friends about his illness. They all said that he could not tell what illness it was, that there was no way to treat it, and that there was no way to start.
However, today, Chen Yun could tell at a glance!
Traditional Chinese medicine consisted of looking, listening, asking, and feeling the pulse!
The other party could determine his illness just by looking! Moreover, he even gave a time limit!
This!
The other party’s medical skills were actually so terrifying!
A kid actually had such medical skills!
At the thought of amputation, Zhang Ming instantly lost his arrogance from before. The old man beside him also felt that something was wrong. “Old Zhang, could it be that you...”
However, the others did not notice Zhang Ming’s expression.
The scolding in the entire room became more and more intense. All of them were aimed at Chen Yun, including the three girls beside him.

However, in the next moment, the scolding in the entire room stopped abruptly. Everyone looked at the scene in front of them in disbelief. Even the three girls widened their eyes and covered their mouths in shock!
What did they see?
Divine Doctor Zhang took a few steps forward and bowed 90 degrees towards Chen Yun!
The dignified Divine Doctor actually bowed so respectfully!
The entire hall was instantly silent!
Everyone looked at Zhang Ming and their eyes almost popped out!
What was going on?!

After Zhang Ming bowed, he stood up and looked at Chen Yun. “Little Divine Doctor, I didn’t know that you had such ability at such a young age. You could tell where my illness was at a glance. Little Divine Doctor, please help me treat my hand illness. I will definitely be endlessly grateful!”
Little Divine Doctor!
These three words shocked everyone!
If anyone else said this, they might think that Chen Yun had deceived them. However, when these words came from Zhang Ming, the meaning was greatly different!
Furthermore!
Chen Yun had really seen through the other party’s illness!
Moreover, it only took a glance!
This...

When Chen Yun heard Zhang Ming’s words, he chuckled and took the ginseng from his hand. “I pointed out your illness to tell you that in terms of medical skills, you’re not qualified enough in front of me.”
“As for the path ahead, I’ve also pointed it out to you. Go amputate it in three months.”
Chen Yun turned to look at Old Man Wang. “Sir, can you help me estimate the price of these things?”
“Little Divine Doctor, what do you mean?” The old man, who was also dissatisfied with Chen Yun just now, did not expect such a thing to happen. He immediately became respectful to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun pointed at the three long boxes at the side. “These three things.”
The old man opened the boxes in confusion. Then, he looked at the things inside. His eyes widened and he gasped. This!
“These are priceless treasures, priceless treasures!”
With just a glance, the old man shouted, causing the desolate Zhang Ming to come over. Needless to say, the people who were stunned also came over to see what it was.
However, after coming over, everyone seemed to have been struck by lightning. They could not believe their eyes!
They even suspected that their eyes were playing tricks on them!
Damn it!
Inside the box was ginseng as long as an arm!

Even Zhang Ming had never seen such a scene before. His legs began to tremble. After all, he had studied Chinese medicine. Looking at the ginseng in front of him, he narrowed his eyes and said with a trembling voice, “This... This is a thousand-year-old ginseng!”
What?
A thousand-year-old ginseng!
Gulp!
This was a legendary thing that could allow people to become immortals on the spot!

The other party’s medical skills were actually so terrifying!
A kid actually had such medical skills!
At the thought of amputation, Zhang Ming instantly lost his arrogance from before.
The old man beside him also felt that something was wrong.
“Old Zhang, could it be that you...”
However, the others did not notice Zhang Ming’s expression.
The scolding in the entire room became more and more intense.
All of them were aimed at Chen Yun, including the three girls beside him.
However, in the next moment, the scolding in the entire room stopped abruptly.
Everyone looked at the scene in front of them in disbelief.
Even the three girls widened their eyes and covered their mouths in shock!
What did they see?
Divine Doctor Zhang took a few steps forward and bowed 90 degrees towards Chen Yun!
The dignified Divine Doctor actually bowed so respectfully!
The entire hall was instantly silent!
Everyone looked at Zhang Ming and their eyes almost popped out!
What was going on?!
After Zhang Ming bowed, he stood up and looked at Chen Yun.
“Little Divine Doctor, I didn’t know that you had such ability at such a young age.
You could tell where my illness was at a glance.
Little Divine Doctor, please help me treat my hand illness.
I will definitely be endlessly grateful!”
Little Divine Doctor!
These three words shocked everyone!
If anyone else said this, they might think that Chen Yun had deceived them.
However, when these words came from Zhang Ming, the meaning was greatly different!
Furthermore!
Chen Yun had really seen through the other party’s illness!
Moreover, it only took a glance!
This...
When Chen Yun heard Zhang Ming’s words, he chuckled and took the ginseng from his hand.
“I pointed out your illness to tell you that in terms of medical skills, you’re not qualified enough in front of me.”
“As for the path ahead, I’ve also pointed it out to you.
Go amputate it in three months.”
Chen Yun turned to look at Old Man Wang.
“Sir, can you help me estimate the price of these things?”
“Little Divine Doctor, what do you mean?” The old man, who was also dissatisfied with Chen Yun just now, did not expect such a thing to happen.
He immediately became respectful to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun pointed at the three long boxes at the side.
“These three things.”
The old man opened the boxes in confusion.
Then, he looked at the things inside.
His eyes widened and he gasped.
This!
“These are priceless treasures, priceless treasures!”
With just a glance, the old man shouted, causing the desolate Zhang Ming to come over.
Needless to say, the people who were stunned also came over to see what it was.
However, after coming over, everyone seemed to have been struck by lightning.
They could not believe their eyes!
They even suspected that their eyes were playing tricks on them!
Damn it!
Inside the box was ginseng as long as an arm!
Even Zhang Ming had never seen such a scene before.
His legs began to tremble.
After all, he had studied Chinese medicine.
Looking at the ginseng in front of him, he narrowed his eyes and said with a trembling voice, “This...
This is a thousand-year-old ginseng!”
What?
A thousand-year-old ginseng!
Gulp!
This was a legendary thing that could allow people to become immortals on the spot!

chapters.title: Chapter 91: I’m Here to Talk to You About the Heavenly Spirit Water
paragraphs: Legend had it that a thousand-year-old ginseng could transform into a human. After eating it, one could ascend to the highest realm and obtain the ability to fly.

However, Zhang Ming and the others knew that those were just myths and legends. However, even if they were myths and legends, they did not exaggerate the medicinal power of the thousand-year-old ginseng.
When necessary, this thing could definitely save a life and revive the dead with its powerful medicinal effects!
How could an ordinary person take out such a thing?!

At that moment, everyone’s gazes on Chen Yun changed again. Some people were even prepared to start retreating. After all, it seemed that Chen Yun had a powerful background. They had still dared to argue just now, but now, they were naturally scared out of their wits.

Even Zhang Ming’s body trembled. He naturally knew that even a traditional Chinese medicine family like his did not have such a thing in stock. He had been in Jiangbei for so many years, but he had never seen one. This thousand-year-old ginseng was the first time he had seen it in his life!
If not for today, he would have thought that the thousand-year-old ginseng in the ancient books was a piece of fiction made up by the ancient people.
Chen Yun looked at Old Man Wang. “Sir, help me estimate the price.”

“I... I can’t estimate its price.” The old man shook his head like a rattle drum. “This thing is a treasure among treasures. Little Divine Doctor, please forgive my incompetence. I really don’t dare to give a price. Any price would be considered an insult to this old medicine.”
Chen Yun looked at Zhang Ming beside him and saw that he was also shocked. He shook his head and left with the three girls who had bought the medicine.
After asking around for a long time, no one could give a price.
Chen Yun now had the Unparalleled Medical Skill. Although he knew the use of the thousand-year-old ginseng, he did not know the market price.
A long time after Chen Yun and the others left, everyone present came back to their senses.
“F*ck! What did I just see?”
“That was such a long ginseng!”
“It’s a thousand-year-old thing. Do you think I can ascend after taking a bite?!”
Zhang Ming also came back to his senses and sighed. Then, he looked at his hand. Could it be that his hand was really going to be amputated?
“Old Zhang, I have the phone number of the Young Divine Doctor here. You can contact him when you come back.”
“Thank you very much.” Zhang Ming’s eyes lit up, but then they dimmed. He had sinned against Chen Yun today, and the other party had already told him very clearly.
This...
For a moment, Zhang Ming regretted it.
Meanwhile, in the car, Chen Yun looked at the three girls. “Do you have anything on at noon today? If not, shall we go to the First-Grade Restaurant?”
“Okay!”
The three girls suddenly cheered. Xiao Xin was even more excited.

“Brother Yun, you don’t know about this, but after we made a booking by phone, the staff said that our booking could only be scheduled for three days later. Moreover, we booked a private room, where there’s a minimum expenditure. There’s no need to mention the hall. The queue was several times longer than the queue outside Haidilao on New Year’s Day. It’s too terrifying!”
Xiao Xin thought about it and looked forward to it. “Brother Yun, quickly open a few more branches.”
Chen Yun pondered for a moment. The First-Grade Restaurant was relatively popular now. It was time to open a few branches.
However, who would open a branch after one day of business?
When they arrived at the First-Grade Residence, even Chen Yun was stunned by the scene in front of him.
There were more than a hundred people lined up outside!
Moreover, people came one after another. When Zhou Jingyi saw this scene, she looked helpless. When she saw Chen Yun coming over, she quickly welcomed him.
“Sister Jingyi.” Xiao Xin greeted Zhou Jingyi when she saw her.
After Zhou Jingyi responded, she looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, why don’t we open another branch? We haven’t used up the 100 million yuan you gave last time. It’s enough to open another branch.”
“Do as you see fit. I’ll leave everything to you. Tell me if you don’t have enough money.” Chen Yun knew that people were good at using people and did not doubt them.
This was also the reason why Ma Ke and Zhou Jingyi worked so hard for him.
A scholar would die for his confidant.

“There’s one more thing. A young man from the Cold Plum Hall is looking for you. He said that he’s Song Jixing from the Song family in Jiangbei. He’s here to discuss something with you,” said Zhou Jingyi softly. “He’s from the Song family, one of the five major families in Jiangbei.”
The five major families in Jiangbei!
They were very famous!
Each of them was a family that had been operating businesses for a hundred years. Their strength and wealth were simply shocking.
The Song family was also among the five major families. Although they were not in the top three, they were quite powerful, especially in the food and medicine industry.
They had a place in the entire China.
In other words, in the field of food and medicine, they were like Sacred Heaven in the entertainment industry.
However, the food and medicine industries involved too many businesses. It was far from what the entertainment industry could compare to.

“I don’t have much of a relationship with the Song family. Forget it, let’s go see what they want from me.” Then, Chen Yun gestured to Xiao Xin and the other two behind him. Zhou Jingyi nodded and summoned a hostess. “Bring the three esteemed guests to the reserved Spring Flower Hall.”
“Please follow me.”

Meanwhile, Zhou Jingyi also brought Chen Yun to the Cold Plum Hall. The moment the door opened, they saw a young man sitting at the head of the table. He was wearing a maroon suit and holding a cup of fragrant tea in his hand. From his demeanor and aura, one could tell that he had a powerful background.
Zhou Jingyi walked forward. “Mr. Song, this is Director Chen Yun.”

Song Jixing stood up and looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with shock. If he had a strong aura, then Chen Yun’s aura was even stronger than his. With Chen Yun’s looks and aura, he was like the CEO of a top company in the world. No one dared to look down on him at all.
Most importantly!
He was too young!
He was shockingly young!
It was hard to imagine that such a young person had such a huge aura and such a huge industry!
One could imagine the power behind him.
For a moment, even Song Jixing was extremely cautious!

“Director Chen, please forgive me for visiting you so presumptuously. I’m Song Jixing from the Song family in Jiangbei. I’ve long heard of your name. It’s really better to see you with my own eyes. It’s said that Director Chen is young and promising. From the looks of it today, I finally know that the rumors outside are not as good as the real thing.”
Song Jixing greeted him with a smile. As soon as he spoke, everyone knew that he was as sly as a fox.
“Yes, sit.”
Chen Yun had heard too much flattery and did not feel anything. After sitting down, he gestured to Zhou Jingyi. Zhou Jingyi naturally understood and went down to prepare the dishes.
“What’s the matter?” Chen Yun sat there and simply went straight to the point. He did not want to waste time on someone he did not know.
Song Jixing was stunned for a moment before smiling. “Director Chen is really straightforward. Then I won’t hide it anymore. This thing was circulated from Director Chen, right?”
As he spoke, he took out a bottle of blue liquid from his pocket. It was none other than the Heavenly Spirit Water.
Chen Yun was not surprised to see people outside Jiang City holding the Heavenly Spirit Water. With the Song family’s financial resources, it was not surprising for them to obtain a bottle of this.
“That’s why I’m here. I want to discuss it with you, Director Chen.”

chapters.title: Chapter 92: A 30-70 Profit Split?
paragraphs: A discussion?
When Chen Yun heard this, he felt an inexplicable sense of ridicule. He was the one who asked Ma Ke to distribute this to the upper echelons of Jiang City.

Although the Song family had great strength in Jiangbei, they did not have any businesses in Jiang City. Therefore, this bottle of Heavenly Spirit Water was not from Ma Ke. Now that he had brought the Heavenly Spirit Water over, in Chen Yun’s opinion, it was as if they were showing off.

“I’m here to develop the Heavenly Spirit Water with Director Chen.” Speaking of serious matters, Song Jixing couldn’t help but praise Chen Yun. “The effect of your Heavenly Spirit Water is really magical. After I drank a bottle, I instantly felt the mental fatigue of the day dissipate. It’s simply a hundred times stronger than the best health supplements!”
“Yes, and then?” Chen Yun was still very calm.
Song Jixing didn’t expect this reaction. The corners of his eyes twitched as he spoke.

“We’ve analyzed your Heavenly Spirit Water. There are many antioxidant substances in it. It’s this substance that can eliminate the oxidizing substance in the cells and revitalize the cells. That’s why it has such an effect. However, we don’t know what the substance in your Heavenly Spirit Water is.”
“Moreover, I think you might have underestimated the value of the Heavenly Spirit Water. The method you’re using now is not correct.”

“If we hoard it and engage in hunger marketing, while spending money to buy news advertisements and hire celebrities to endorse it at the same time, we can increase its value, just like top luxury brands such as Hermès and Ferraris. The value of the Heavenly Spirit Water will be limitless.”
These words immediately made Chen Yun laugh softly. At the same time, his eyes turned cold.

The Song family was indeed the Song family. After obtaining it, they began to study it. However, how could they possibly study something produced by the antioxidant chlorella? It was probably because they could not study it that they came looking for him.
Moreover, he had never planned to sell the Heavenly Spirit Water. The main reason was that he could not mass produce it.
Song Jixing paused and continued.

“I heard that Director Chen and Wang Menghan are very close. I think Wang Menghan’s image is very compatible with the Heavenly Spirit Water. When the time comes, we can totally invite her to endorse it.”

Then, he looked at Chen Yun meaningfully. “Wang Menghan is an artiste from Huaying. I have a good relationship with Young Master Su Yuncheng of Huaying. If you want to have further interactions with her, I can pull the strings. However, this girl is more arrogant. We might have to spend more time pursuing her.”
“However, as a woman, as long as I coax her and give her some gifts, she’ll naturally be able to do it.”
As Song Jixing spoke, he had a proud expression.

In his opinion, compared to the Heavenly Spirit Water that was worth tens of billions or even more, what was the mere Wang Menghan worth? If he could hold the Heavenly Spirit Water in his hand and even obtain the formula for the Heavenly Spirit Water, it would not be difficult for him to jump into the list of the top 20 or even the top 10 richest people of China in the future. At that time, he would have everything he wanted.
Thinking of this, Song Jixing’s heart burned with passion.
“Oh? Is that so?” Chen Yun did not comment.
Seeing this, Song Jixing frowned, but he instantly relaxed.

“Director Chen, you might not know me, so you’re a little suspicious of my words.” Song Jixing said seriously, “I’m Song Jixing, from the Song family in Jiangbei. I’m the vice president of Shi Shang Delicacies and an independent Director of Weiguo Healthcare.”

After a pause, a proud expression appeared on his face. “The Song family controls three listed pharmaceutical companies. We occupy one-third of the market in the entire Chinese health products and pharmaceutical industry.”
“If you work with me to develop the Heavenly Spirit Water, you will definitely be able to sweep through any high-end health products on the market.”
“When the time comes, you’ll provide the technology and I’ll provide the funds and connections. We’ll split the profits 30-70. How about it?”
Chen Yun was silent.

“Do you think the price is too low?” When Song Jixing saw this, he explained earnestly, “You have to know that the production department takes up a very small proportion of the health products industry nowadays. The real deal is in sales. For example, the health products that swept through China in the past few years, such as Brain Yellow Platinum, mainly relied on hundreds of millions or even billions of yuan in advertising, sales, offline promotion, and so on to finally reach those shocking sales.”
At this point, Song Jixing gritted his teeth as if he had made a huge concession.
“Of course, if you really think it’s too low, I can take another step back and split the profits 40-60. How about that?”
After saying that, he looked at Chen Yun confidently.
Song Jixing was confident.
He controlled the funding channel in his hands. If Chen Yun wanted to promote his Heavenly Spirit Water to the entire country, working with the Song family was the best choice.

“First, I’ll pull you into a holding company. Then, in the name of technical analysis and industry testing, I’ll ask you to publicize the technical formula. Finally, I’ll find a reason to kick you out of the company. You can take the formula and change its name to officially sell it.”
The Song family could be said to have mastered this trick.
Nowadays, several popular health products and Chinese medicine on the market were produced by this method.
The business world was like a battlefield without smoke. There were no eternal friends, only eternal benefits.
The Song family had earned countless assets with this move. Song Jixing was prepared to replicate it.
In his opinion, although Chen Yun had a huge reputation, he was still a twenty-year-old youth with shallow knowledge.
“Is your lowest offer a 40-60 split?”
A mocking smile appeared on Chen Yun’s face. He suddenly asked.
“The Song family of Jiangbei is indeed famous.”
“However, what rank are you in the Song family? Do you have the right to speak?”

At this moment, Song Jixing’s expression was a little ugly, but he still said, “Although I can’t make the decision in the Song family, I still have 8% of the shares. You don’t have to worry about this at all. I can guarantee that the Song family will definitely use the greatest resources to promote you.”
“I’m not worried about that.”

Chen Yun shook his head and sneered. “What I mean is that you don’t even understand your status. How dare you fantasize? With my current power, even the head of the Song family is my equal. Who are you in the Song family? How dare you talk to me about a 30-70 profit split?”
“If you want to cooperate, get the Song family’s master to come and see me personally.”
With that, Chen Yun stood up and sneered before walking out.
In his seat, Song Jixing’s face was livid with disbelief.
He could not imagine that Chen Yun would embarrass and directly shut him out!
As the legitimate son of the Song family in Jiangbei and the Vice-President o a few listed companies, Song Jixing had never suffered such humiliation.

“He’s arrogant! He’s too arrogant!” He was so angry that his entire body was trembling. A trace of resentment flashed across his eyes. “Just you wait. One day, I’ll cripple you and make you kneel at my feet!”
Chen Yun did not care at all.
“Do you take me for a fool? Do you really think I don’t know anything?” Chen Yun sneered and shook his head.
“I produced the Heavenly Spirit Water alone without any cost. How dare you ask for 70%?”

Usually, healthcare products relied mainly on sales, so it was understandable for the seller to take a large share. However, the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water was divine. The supply could not meet the demand. Customers would come knocking on his door without any sales. However, Song Jixing wanted to take 70% of the profits. He was simply crazy.
Under normal circumstances, even if it was a 90-10 split, the Song family would have profited greatly!
