How about it?”
Chen Yun was silent.

“Do you think the price is too low?” When Song Jixing saw this, he explained earnestly, “You have to know that the production department takes up a very small proportion of the health products industry nowadays.
The real deal is in sales.

For example, the health products that swept through China in the past few years, such as Brain Yellow Platinum, mainly relied on hundreds of millions or even billions of yuan in advertising, sales, offline promotion, and so on to finally reach those shocking sales.”
At this point, Song Jixing gritted his teeth as if he had made a huge concession.
“Of course, if you really think it’s too low, I can take another step back and split the profits 40-60.
How about that?”
After saying that, he looked at Chen Yun confidently.
Song Jixing was confident.
He controlled the funding channel in his hands.
If Chen Yun wanted to promote his Heavenly Spirit Water to the entire country, working with the Song family was the best choice.
“First, I’ll pull you into a holding company.
Then, in the name of technical analysis and industry testing, I’ll ask you to publicize the technical formula.
Finally, I’ll find a reason to kick you out of the company.
You can take the formula and change its name to officially sell it.”
The Song family could be said to have mastered this trick.
Nowadays, several popular health products and Chinese medicine on the market were produced by this method.
The business world was like a battlefield without smoke.
There were no eternal friends, only eternal benefits.
The Song family had earned countless assets with this move.
Song Jixing was prepared to replicate it.
In his opinion, although Chen Yun had a huge reputation, he was still a twenty-year-old youth with shallow knowledge.
“Is your lowest offer a 40-60 split?”
A mocking smile appeared on Chen Yun’s face.
He suddenly asked.
“The Song family of Jiangbei is indeed famous.”
“However, what rank are you in the Song family?
Do you have the right to speak?”
At this moment, Song Jixing’s expression was a little ugly, but he still said, “Although I can’t make the decision in the Song family, I still have 8% of the shares.
You don’t have to worry about this at all.
I can guarantee that the Song family will definitely use the greatest resources to promote you.”
“I’m not worried about that.”
Chen Yun shook his head and sneered.
“What I mean is that you don’t even understand your status.
How dare you fantasize?
With my current power, even the head of the Song family is my equal.
Who are you in the Song family?
How dare you talk to me about a 30-70 profit split?”
“If you want to cooperate, get the Song family’s master to come and see me personally.”
With that, Chen Yun stood up and sneered before walking out.
In his seat, Song Jixing’s face was livid with disbelief.
He could not imagine that Chen Yun would embarrass and directly shut him out!
As the legitimate son of the Song family in Jiangbei and the Vice-President o a few listed companies, Song Jixing had never suffered such humiliation.
“He’s arrogant!
He’s too arrogant!” He was so angry that his entire body was trembling.
A trace of resentment flashed across his eyes.
“Just you wait.
One day, I’ll cripple you and make you kneel at my feet!”
Chen Yun did not care at all.
“Do you take me for a fool?
Do you really think I don’t know anything?” Chen Yun sneered and shook his head.
“I produced the Heavenly Spirit Water alone without any cost.
How dare you ask for 70%?”
Usually, healthcare products relied mainly on sales, so it was understandable for the seller to take a large share.
However, the effect of the Heavenly Spirit Water was divine.
The supply could not meet the demand.
Customers would come knocking on his door without any sales.
However, Song Jixing wanted to take 70% of the profits.
He was simply crazy.
Under normal circumstances, even if it was a 90-10 split, the Song family would have profited greatly!

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Super Leisure!
paragraphs: Chen Yun sneered. “If I really want to make Heavenly Spirit Water, do I need the Song family?”
If the Heavenly Spirit Water could be mass-produced, even the entire health supplement industry in China would be trampled under Chen Yun’s feet, let alone the Song family.
However, at the present moment, the production of those bottles of antioxidant chlorella was only enough for him to realize his plan.
Ma Ke could use what Chen Yun had given him to help him and help Sacred Heaven spread their connections. As the saying went, there were no eternal friends, only eternal benefits.
Sacred Heaven would stand proudly in Jiang City like a heavenly master!
At this moment, as soon as the Heavenly Spirit Water was released, it was as if Chen Yun had raised his arm high!
With a single call, hundreds of people would respond!

If the Su family had taken root in Jiang City for a long time, Chen Yun had now directly pulled out some of the Su family’s roots and placed them on his body. Moreover, he had already begun to shake this so-called towering tree!
Then, Chen Yun came to Xiao Xin’s room. At this moment, the three girls were eating happily.
“Brother Yun, are you done discussing business?” Xiao Xin asked Chen Yun.
“I guess so.” Chen Yun thought of the clown, Song Jixing, and sneered in his heart.
After sitting down, the screen immediately flashed.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission!]
He pressed the check-in button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining super sound.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining a supreme-grade card.]
Super sound?

Chen Yun had only heard of perfect pitch. Perfect pitch specifically meant that one did not need a baseline sound to distinguish the specific pitch of a sound. Most of this ability was innate, and it was very rare among ordinary people. It could be said to be one in a million.
In that case, what was super sound?
[Super sound is enough to instantly defeat perfect pitch.]
On the light screen, a line of words appeared. It resolved the doubts in Chen Yun’s heart. The words “instantly defeat” made him feel very comfortable.
What was even more precious was that Chen Yun actually obtained a supreme-grade card. One had to know that this supreme-grade card was used to exchange for a supreme-grade reward.
As the super sound skill was injected into his body, Chen Yun seemed to be connected to everything in the world. Everything had a sound, and Chen Yun was an admirer of the world.
This feeling was too strange.

Every drop of water, every sound of the wind, and even the sound of bowls and chopsticks colliding with the table seemed to appear in front of Chen Yun. The entire world appeared in front of Chen Yun with an extraordinary feeling.
“Brother Yun, what’s wrong?”
Xiao Xin saw that Chen Yun’s eyes were closed and did not know what had happened.
“I’m fine.”
Chen Yun opened his eyes and said something that stunned the three girls.

“Brother Yun, your voice seems to have changed a little.” Zhang Jing put down her chopsticks. “It’s even more deep and sonorous than before. It’s simply more comfortable than the voices of those popular livestreamers.”
“Is that so?” Chen Yun smiled. He did not expect super sound to have such a function.

When these three words fell into the ears of the three girls, they were even more shocked. His voice had really changed a little, but it was this little change that made a huge improvement. These few words landed in their hearts.
It made them feel a desire.
It was as if they had accidentally heard a good song and wanted to repeat it.
They wouldn’t get tired of it!
After dinner, Chen Yun drove home.

The two girls didn’t welcome him when he returned. After all, the art examination would be in a few days. In the past few days, they had either gone to Sacred Heaven to undergo professional training or locked themselves in the practice room to practice day and night.

They were very busy, but this was what made Chen Yun feel at ease. He would protect Chen Mengmeng, but he did not want anyone to talk about Chen Mengmeng in the future. They would say that she was a vase with no acting skills. That was not what he wanted his sister to do.
To be honest, Chen Yun was really a little nervous. He felt like a parent sending his child to the college entrance examination hall. He did not know what the outcome would be.
However, he smiled. With his current power in Jiang City, it was not a problem to arrange for the two little girls to enter the Jiang City University of the Arts.
When it was time for dinner, the two little girls walked down. “Eh? Brother, when did you come back?”
“I came back a long time ago. I didn’t call you guys because I was afraid of disturbing your practice.”
“Brother?”
“What’s wrong?”
“Brother?”
“What?” Chen Yun frowned. Chen Mengmeng immediately came over and looked around. “It’s Brother.”
“Why do I feel that your voice has changed a little? It’s so nice to listen to. With your voice, if you become a singer, you can instantly defeat a group of capable singers.”
“Come, come, come. Brother, sing a song. It’s called ‘Cruel Daylight1’.”
Chen Yun was speechless. He would not sing. He would not sing even if he was beaten to death.
Her brother was the dignified Chairman of Sacred Heaven and the top figure in Jiang City. Would he sing for these two little girls? Heh.
Not long after, singing came from the main villa.

“It’s good! It’s so good that it’s explosive! No, I have to send it to Sister Menghan and let her listen to your standard!” Chen Mengmeng looked at the recording on her phone. “I want to set this as my alarm ringtone.”

“No matter what song it is, as long as it’s set as your alarm ringtone, I guarantee that you won’t want to hear it again in a few days.” Chen Yun glanced at her. “Why don’t you set a time and I’ll kick you out of bed? How about that?”
If he didn’t fight with his sister, it would be meaningless.
Chen Mengmeng: “...” Someone wanted to hit her.
What should she do? This was the third time she had been waiting urgently for a solution, but no one had even come up with an idea.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun closed his eyes as a melody suddenly appeared in his mind.
He opened his hand and wrote down the melody. Chen Yun, who had the super sound ability, simply wrote down the melody in his mind like flowing water.
Chen Mengmeng came over and looked at the score. “Brother, are you writing a song?”
“Hum it.”
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked at the music score and hummed. As soon as they finished speaking, the two of them were shocked. This song!
It was as smooth as high mountains and flowing water!
It was as if it was natural!
It had a brainwashing effect, just like the immortal music in the Heavenly Palace!
Just humming it once was enough to make Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue love it!
It was too good!
If this song was composed into a song and sung, it would definitely cause a frenzy on the Internet.
The two of them hummed the song again.
Then, they turned around.
Both pairs of eyes widened. They could not believe what they were seeing.
Chen Yun wrote rapidly on a piece of A4 paper. Wherever his pen landed, it formed a musical score!
In a short period of time, he had already composed four songs!
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
F*ck!
She thought, “Brother, you can’t play like this!”
Was he Vincent Fang2 of Jiang City?!
However, Vincent Fang was hired to write lyrics instead!
Why was his composition so fierce?!
After writing for a while, Chen Yun slapped the scores on the table and shook his hand. “I’m too lazy to write.”
Looking at the four top-notch scores, Chen Mengmeng was stunned.
He was too lazy to write?!
Damn!
What a good way to show-off! She would give him full marks! She was not afraid of his pride at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 94: A Beautiful Painting!
paragraphs: Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue held the four scores as if they were treasures.

However, they then lost their spirit. After all, at their current level, they could only cover some other songs. They had no experience, no literary talent, and no corresponding level to write the lyrics for these four songs.
They immediately felt ashamed of their inferiority.
It was as if they were holding an unpolished jade in their hands, but their skills were not good. Any additional work on it seemed to add flaws to the natural unpolished jade.
“Brother, I’ll return the scores to you.” Chen Mengmeng returned the scores to Chen Yun, although there was still longing on her face.
“Why did you return the scores?” Chen Yun smiled and said, “Aren’t you going to add lyrics?”
“No, no.”
The two little girls shook their heads like rattle drums. Then, they looked at the scores reluctantly. “We’re going to practice. The art exam is the day after tomorrow. We’re so nervous.”
“Alright, go ahead. All the best.”
Chen Yun looked at the four scores. There was nothing he could do. After all, his super musical sense was only for music. He was only 20 years old now, so how could he have any experience?
He could write such songs, but he could not write lyrics for them.
Speaking of lyrics, Chen Yun immediately thought of a figure. It was Wang Menghan!
Back then, he liked Wang Menghan’s songs because of the style of the lyrics. In Chen Yun’s opinion, the style of the lyrics was not inferior to that of imperial scholars.
At that moment, he called Wang Menghan.
“Chen Yun?” On the other side, Wang Menghan, who was lying on the desk, was woken up by the ringtone. She picked it up in a daze. “Chen Yun, what’s wrong?”
“What time is it? Are you still not awake?”

“I haven’t been able to write my new song smoothly. I didn’t sleep well for a few nights and even stayed up all night last night. I think I might have used up all my talent.” Wang Menghan smiled. Ever since she debuted, she had released songs at an extremely terrifying speed and quality. Almost all the songs were top-notch. Every song was popular in Beijing.
However, recently, for some reason, whenever she wanted to write songs, the image of living in Chen Yun’s house appeared in her mind. She recalled everything about Chen Yun.
Often, she would be in a daze for half a day. As a result, she couldn’t write anything.
She wanted to write a love song, but she had never even been in a relationship. If she wrote it, she would simply be attempting to emulate something beyond her ability and fall flat on her face.
Hence, she was so worried that she had not slept well for the past few nights. Her dark circles appeared and could not be hidden even with high-end cosmetics.
On the other side of the line, Chen Yun smiled. “Coincidentally, I have four songs here. Take them and see if you can fill in the lyrics.”

Wang Menghan leaned her head on her hand and looked hazy. “Don’t tease me. You’re the director of Sacred Heaven and I’m from Huaying. Aren’t you giving me the song that your artiste worked so hard to write? That person will definitely have complaints. I know you’re good to me. It’s fine. Believe me, the new song won’t be far away.”

“Besides, Huaying and Sacred Heaven are in a competitive state. If I don’t release a song now, I can weaken Huaying slightly.” Wang Menghan mocked herself. However, she also knew that whether she released a song or not, it could not shake the battle between these two behemoths.
“I’ll send it to you first. I wrote the songs myself.”
Hm?
He wrote the songs himself?
DId he know how to compose music?
For a moment, Wang Menghan was interested. She had never heard Chen Yun sing, let alone seen him compose. In the next moment, four photos were sent.
Right on the heels of that, Chen Yun said something that made her break down. “Take these four songs and use them. I’m still confident. After all, I finished them in a few minutes.”
Wang Menghan was speechless.
What a good move!
What confidence!
He had written these songs in a few minutes!
How amazing!
When she was in good condition, it would take a few days to compose a song. In the end, this person wrote a song in a few minutes and even composed four songs!
“Alright, I’ll accept it respectfully. I’ll take a look at your scores first.”
Wang Menghan did not discourage Chen Yun. She opened the photo and hummed softly. As she hummed, her expression gradually changed.
It was as if her heart had been struck by a heavy hammer!
She instantly sobered up from her hazy mentality!
This song!
This song should only exist in the heavens. How many times could one hear it in the human world?!
It was not an exaggeration to describe the songs as such!
“Chen Yun, did you really write this in a few minutes?” Wang Menghan’s beautiful eyes widened in disbelief.

“Yes, Mengmeng saw it. If you don’t believe me, ask her. However, she’s going to take the art exam soon. She might not have time to look at her phone.” Chen Yun took a sip of tea. “Do you think you can use the songs? Coincidentally, Mengmeng said that they don’t have the experience to fill in the lyrics and inject a soul into the songs. It’s up to you.”
With that, he hung up.
“Hey! Chen Yun! You!”
Wang Menghan looked at the phone and was caught between laughter and tears. How could this be?!
This person!
He did not understand the value of these four songs at all!
These songs could become world-famous songs even without any lyrics!
At least, that was what Wang Menghan felt.
Now, Chen Yun had actually casually sent her these four photos.
“Can I write lyrics for these songs?”
Even Wang Menghan felt immense pressure if she wanted to fill in the lyrics for these four songs. She was afraid that her lyrics would ruin the song.
“Let’s find the feeling first.”

Wang Menghan pulled open the curtains. The sunset shone in through the huge French windows and reflected on the pure white piano in the room. She stood up and sat in front of the piano with her phone. Her soft and slender hand brushed across the piano keys.
Music notes floated out one after another.

Outside the room, Zhang Xiaozi was drinking coffee and enjoying the sunset. However, she had a worried expression on her face. As Wang Menghan’s manager, she was naturally worried about Wang Menghan’s condition.
For such a long time, as her manager, she had given all her resources to Wang Menghan. It could be said that she had played a great role in Wang Menghan’s achievements.

However, now that Wang Menghan could not write a song, she was too worried. Although Wang Menghan was now famous and it was alright if she could not produce a new song for a month, what if this continued for a year or two years?
She would gradually be forgotten by others, and there was no chance of her making a comeback.
“Sigh.” Zhang Xiaozi sighed softly and walked towards Wang Menghan’s room. “Menghan, why don’t we go on a trip for a while? Maybe when you relax, you can...”
The moment she opened the door, she stopped talking.

Zhang Xiaozi looked at the scene in front of her. The wind blew the curtains, causing them to sway gently. The setting sun danced and scattered its light. A beautiful woman sat in front of the snow-white piano and played passionately.
It formed a peerless painting!
Not only that!
After a while, Zhang Xiaozi finally reacted. What shocked her was not only this scene, but also this music!
This music!
Like an immortal song, it descended from the nine heavens!
The sound lingered for three days!
Unknowingly, tears were already streaming down Zhang Xiaozi’s face. It was unknown if she was touched by the song or happy for Wang Menghan.

However, she also knew that whether she released a song or not, it could not shake the battle between these two behemoths.
“I’ll send it to you first.
I wrote the songs myself.”
Hm?
He wrote the songs himself?
DId he know how to compose music?
For a moment, Wang Menghan was interested.
She had never heard Chen Yun sing, let alone seen him compose.
In the next moment, four photos were sent.
Right on the heels of that, Chen Yun said something that made her break down.
“Take these four songs and use them.
I’m still confident.
After all, I finished them in a few minutes.”
Wang Menghan was speechless.
What a good move!
What confidence!
He had written these songs in a few minutes!
How amazing!
When she was in good condition, it would take a few days to compose a song.
In the end, this person wrote a song in a few minutes and even composed four songs!
“Alright, I’ll accept it respectfully.
I’ll take a look at your scores first.”
Wang Menghan did not discourage Chen Yun.
She opened the photo and hummed softly.
As she hummed, her expression gradually changed.
It was as if her heart had been struck by a heavy hammer!
She instantly sobered up from her hazy mentality!
This song!
This song should only exist in the heavens.
How many times could one hear it in the human world?!
It was not an exaggeration to describe the songs as such!
“Chen Yun, did you really write this in a few minutes?” Wang Menghan’s beautiful eyes widened in disbelief.
“Yes, Mengmeng saw it.
If you don’t believe me, ask her.
However, she’s going to take the art exam soon.
She might not have time to look at her phone.” Chen Yun took a sip of tea.
“Do you think you can use the songs?
Coincidentally, Mengmeng said that they don’t have the experience to fill in the lyrics and inject a soul into the songs.
It’s up to you.”
With that, he hung up.
“Hey!
Chen Yun!
You!”
Wang Menghan looked at the phone and was caught between laughter and tears.
How could this be?!
This person!
He did not understand the value of these four songs at all!
These songs could become world-famous songs even without any lyrics!
At least, that was what Wang Menghan felt.
Now, Chen Yun had actually casually sent her these four photos.
“Can I write lyrics for these songs?”
Even Wang Menghan felt immense pressure if she wanted to fill in the lyrics for these four songs.
She was afraid that her lyrics would ruin the song.
“Let’s find the feeling first.”
Wang Menghan pulled open the curtains.
The sunset shone in through the huge French windows and reflected on the pure white piano in the room.
She stood up and sat in front of the piano with her phone.
Her soft and slender hand brushed across the piano keys.
Music notes floated out one after another.
Outside the room, Zhang Xiaozi was drinking coffee and enjoying the sunset.
However, she had a worried expression on her face.
As Wang Menghan’s manager, she was naturally worried about Wang Menghan’s condition.
For such a long time, as her manager, she had given all her resources to Wang Menghan.
It could be said that she had played a great role in Wang Menghan’s achievements.
However, now that Wang Menghan could not write a song, she was too worried.
Although Wang Menghan was now famous and it was alright if she could not produce a new song for a month, what if this continued for a year or two years?
She would gradually be forgotten by others, and there was no chance of her making a comeback.
“Sigh.” Zhang Xiaozi sighed softly and walked towards Wang Menghan’s room.
“Menghan, why don’t we go on a trip for a while?
Maybe when you relax, you can...”
The moment she opened the door, she stopped talking.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at the scene in front of her.
The wind blew the curtains, causing them to sway gently.
The setting sun danced and scattered its light.
A beautiful woman sat in front of the snow-white piano and played passionately.
It formed a peerless painting!
Not only that!
After a while, Zhang Xiaozi finally reacted.
What shocked her was not only this scene, but also this music!
This music!
Like an immortal song, it descended from the nine heavens!
The sound lingered for three days!
Unknowingly, tears were already streaming down Zhang Xiaozi’s face.
It was unknown if she was touched by the song or happy for Wang Menghan.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Art Examination
paragraphs: The song ended.
“Menghan!” Zhang Xiaozi wiped her tears and ran towards Wang Menghan. “That’s great. That’s really great.”
“I knew it. You’ve been holding it in for so long. So it’s because you’re preparing for another big move. The song just now can simply reach the top of this year’s music rankings!”
“You’re amazing!”
Zhang Xiaozi hugged Wang Menghan and screamed as if she was a fan who had seen her idol.
Wang Menghan looked helpless. “Xiaozi, I didn’t write this.”
“Huh?” Zhang Xiaozi immediately let go of Wang Menghan. “Then where did you get this song? I’ve never heard of the same or a similar tune.”
Wang Menghan took the phone and swiped it a few times. “Look, Chen Yun sent this to me just now. He composed these four songs just now. I’ve seen them. Every song is top-notch.”
As she spoke, Zhang Xiaozi took the phone and looked at the songs, one after another. “Menghan, is the Chen Yun you’re talking about the handsome man who picked you up in the McLaren?”
“Did you say he finished these songs in a few minutes?!”
“He even composed four imperial-level songs in a few minutes?!”
She stood up and touched Wang Menghan’s head. “You don’t have a fever.”
Wang Menghan slapped her hand away. “I’m telling the truth.”
“Then what should we do now? Shall we use these songs?”

“I don’t really want to. After all, I’ve signed a contract. If I really release these songs, the copyright will probably go to Huaying. At that time, even if I file a lawsuit, I’m afraid I won’t be able to snatch the copyright back.”

Zhang Xiaozi snorted coldly. “I don’t think we can give these four songs to them either. Hurry up and fill in the lyrics. I’ll go to the supervisor and develop a special contract so that you won’t have to hand over the copyright.”
She puffed out her chest and said proudly, “Don’t worry. If the songs are good, we’ll have a stable source of support!”
“Okay!”

At that moment, Wang Menghan began to fill in the lyrics. At the same time, she sang while filling in the lyrics. Zhang Xiaozi recorded a few parts and sent them to the supervisor, was also shocked when he heard the songs!

That day, the supervisor went to look for the upper management. When the manager heard the songs, he kept shaking his head. Then, when he heard that Wang Menghan wanted to keep the copyright, his expression darkened.
“Xiao Sun, I’m afraid this isn’t appropriate.”
“Manager Su, there’s nothing we can do. I’ve also said it, but Wang Menghan said that she didn’t write these four songs, so we can’t hand over the copyright if we want to release the songs.”

When Manager Su heard this, his eyes darted around. “Xiao Sun, you’ve been in Huaying for so many years. You should know that Huaying has always valued copyrights and that copyright contracts need to be signed by people above the manager level. However, I happen to be on a business trip over the next few days, so do you understand what I mean?”

“I understand, of course I understand. I’ll sign this contract.” When Supervisor Sun heard this, he nodded repeatedly. This was also a small trick of Huaying. Everyone in the upper echelons knew about it, but people at Zhang Xiaozi and Wang Menghan’s levels definitely wouldn’t understand. “I’ll draft the contract immediately and let them release the songs first.”

After the supervisor left, Manager Su’s lips curled into a cold smile. He had been in Huaying for so long, but he had never heard of anyone not handing over the copyright. It was fine for an artist signed by Huaying to leave Huaying, but what if they wanted their works too?
Dream on!
What a joke!
It was not the first time Huaying had benefited from the misfortune of others.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan and Zhang Xiaozi received the supervisor’s notice and stayed up all night again.
For some reason, Wang Menghan’s thoughts simply surged like a fountain. She filled in the lyrics extremely quickly, as if the song had already appeared in her mind after playing the piano previously.
After a night, Wang Menghan was extremely tired. She lay on the desk with Zhang Xiaozi and fell asleep.
There were four songs on the table.
“Moonlight of that Year”
“Phoenixes Above the Nine Heavens”
“My Carefree Heart”
“Remembrance”
At the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
When Chen Yun woke up in the morning, he invited a few actors from Sacred Heaven who graduated from the Jiang City University of the Arts to do the last day of special training for the two girls.
For the entire day, Chen Yun watched from the side. Seeing that the two of them were in good condition, he was rather gratified.
Then, it was time for the two girls to show their abilities.
Early in the morning, Chen Yun drove the Mercedes-Benz G and brought the two girls to Jiang City University of the Arts.
“Did you bring your admission tickets and identity cards?”
“Don’t be nervous, understand? You’re all the best.”

“Alright, Brother.” Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun and immediately pursed her lips into a smile. “Brother, look at you now. You’re simply like the parent of an older child. You don’t look like a big boss at all. Besides, Dad and Mom have already told me this this this morning.”
She naturally felt that there was no problem. Now that Chen Yun was like this, she was a little nervous.
“Haha, okay.”
Chen Yun looked at the two little girls. “Go ahead. Best of luck. After you finish your exams, I’ll cook whatever you want to eat.”
“Alright!”
Chen Mengmeng recalled the dishes from the First-Grade Restaurant and immediately drooled.
After sending them to the place, Chen Yun sat in the car and did not leave. Then, he saw Wang Menghan send over the singing version of the few songs.
Chen Yun put on his AirPods and her beautiful voice immediately sounded. When his tune was coupled with Wang Menghan’s words and her passionate singing, it was simply improved!
Not only did her lyrics and singing not destroy the beauty of the songs at all, but they also made the songs go up another level and make them more sentimental.
“It’s nice.”
After hearing that, even Chen Yun reminisced for a long time. His song was reborn in Wang Menghan’s hands.
“Chen Yun, have you finished listening to the songs? How do you feel? We’re preparing to sign the copyright contract now. We should be able to release the new songs today.”
Wang Menghan sent a voice message. Chen Yun replied with a few words, indicating that he understood.
Hearing Wang Menghan’s gratitude, Chen Yun chuckled. He had casually written these songs, or rather, it was to test his super sound ability and music creation skills.
If he wanted to, it would not be a problem for him to compose a few songs or even more than ten songs a day.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Four Songs Stirring the Winds and Clouds!
paragraphs: The art examination of the Acting Department mainly assessed the vocals, lines, figure, and performance of the examinees. In terms of these aspects, to be honest, he was confident in Mengmeng and Xiao Xue. He just didn’t know if they could catch the eyes of the examiners.
While Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were taking the exam, Wang Menghan was also preparing to record a new song.
The day passed in the blink of an eye.
After their first day of exams, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were simply exhausted.

“Aiya, the competition is too intense. Brother, you didn’t see it, but those who entered are all handsome men and beautiful women. Moreover, all of them seem to have added special abilities. They’re too difficult to deal with.”
“Those teachers were also getting more and more tricky.”
Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng and pursed his lips. She simply looked like a student who was complaining about the difficulty of the exam after the exam.
“Then how do you feel about yourselves?” Chen Yun asked.
“Fortunately, I think Xiao Xue and I can squeeze the competition out.” Chen Mengmeng puffed out her chest and spoke proudly. After all, she had practiced for so long and had professional guidance.
Chen Yun pressed the button to start the car. “I’ll believe you.”
When they returned home, the two little girls lay on the sofa after dinner. One look and one would know that they were exhausted.
Chen Mengmeng held her phone and listened to music with her earphones on. Then, her eyes widened.
This!
“Brother, did you give those four songs to Sister Menghan?!”
“That’s right.” Chen Yun took a sip of tea. “What’s wrong?”
“Look! These four songs have already started to be promoted crazily. The response is very good!”
“Moonlight of that Year”
“Phoenixes Above the Nine Heavens”
“My Carefree Heart”
“Remembrance”

The four songs were released on several music platforms at the same time. Moreover, because of Wang Menghan’s influence, many apps even created special topics for her and specially recommended these songs.
Chen Mengmeng simply turned on the speaker and played the four songs.
It was like the sound of nature!
Then, she looked at the response!
It had only been less than three hours since the songs were released!
“Moonlight of that Year” had been downloaded 500,000 times on the Handsome Dog app! Furthermore, there were now more than 990,000 comments!
Meanwhile, “Phoenixes Above the Nine Heavens” had been downloaded 400,000 times! There were also more than 990,000 comments!
The statistics for “My Carefree Heart” and “Remembrance” were slightly worse, but they had nearly 300,000 downloads and a terrifying 700,000 to 800,000 comments each!
Such results could be said to be unprecedented!
Everyone still remembered the fear of being dominated by the lyrics, “A break up should be honorable. Don’t say sorry1.”
It was a song that had become extremely popular because of film and television works. It was now a song which had more than 990,000 comments.
However, even at that time, the song did not rise like this?
Furthermore!

Furthermore, it was only shown that the first two songs had more than 990,000 comments. It was unknown exactly how many comments there were. One million? Two million? It was even possible that there were more comments!
Then, one looked at the Handsome Dog app rankings!
The songs were rising on the Handsome Dog rankings!
They were among the top 500 songs!
The new songs rose to the top of the charts!
As for the online popularity charts...
These four songs were all in the top four of all the rankings!
Moreover, their popularity was definitely domineering!
It was also the same on the other music apps!
It was absolutely domineering!
When one opened the lyrics page, Chen Yun’s name appeared!
Composer: Chen Yun.
Lyricist: Wang Menghan.
Generally speaking, the lyricist would be displayed first before the composer. However, the composer was placed in front for all four songs. Of course, this was also Wang Menghan’s strong request!
“It’s so scary!” Han Xue looked at her phone with the same expression. She hugged Chen Mengmeng. “Mengmeng, look. Sister Menghan has already exploded on Weibo!”
Chen Mengmeng came over and looked at the interface.
Wang Menghan’s fans had already increased from two million to six million!
The hashtag “Divine Song from the Heavens” had become a trending topic!
Moreover, these four songs were also trending on Weibo!
Wang Menghan’s latest Weibo post was a Weibo post about her new songs.
There were already hundreds of thousands of comments below!
“These are simply divine songs!”
“Did you guys see that? These four songs have already reached the top of the major music apps!”
“In the past, Sister Menghan wrote the songs and lyrics herself. Why were these songs written by a person called Chen Yun?”

“Although I don’t know who Chen Yun is, most of these four songs were supported by the melody. Damn it, these songs are too addicting. It feels as if you won’t be able to sleep at night if you don’t put on your earphones and listen to these four songs on repeat!”
Many people were already urging for new songs!
“A new song! I want a new song too!”
“Warning: Those who have not heard these four songs must not listen to them! It’s because they’re too poisonous! I’ve already lost myself after listening to them!”
“Sister Menghan, I want a new song!”
“New song! New song! New song!”
On Weibo, Wang Menghan’s popularity directly soared to second place!
The first place on the rankings was very familiar. It was none other than Xiao Xin!
Wang Menghan’s rise was very similar to Xiao Xin’s back then!

At this moment, Wang Menghan still did not know about these things. After recording the songs, she and Zhang Xiaozi returned to the hotel and fell asleep. The two of them had stayed up all night last night. Furthermore, they recorded the songs for a long time today. Their spirit and stamina were severely exhausted.
The next day, a cry of surprise sounded in Wang Menghan’s room.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at the data on her phone and her eyes widened. She simply could not believe what she was seeing.
This!
“Is my phone broken?”
“Ahhh! Menghan, get up quickly. Hurry up!”
“Don’t sleep, get up!”
At this moment, Wang Menghan frowned and snorted on the bed. “What are you doing, Xiao Zi? Let me sleep for a while more.”

“You’re popular all over the Internet! You’ve dominated all the major apps with the four songs! You already have eight million fans on Weibo! Look, the Huoyin app even specially made a MV for the four songs!”
Wang Menghan responded. After a few seconds, her eyes suddenly opened and she sat up. “Xiaozi! What did you say?!”
She looked at Zhang Xiaozi’s phone and almost thought that she was still dreaming!
This was because it was too terrifying!
She couldn’t help but doubt the authenticity of it!
“I want to be alone.”
Wang Menghan jogged to the washroom and splashed cold water on her face. When she returned, she looked at the data and saw that her songs were still rising terrifyingly!

The Huoyin short video platform even created fan-made music videos for her. The four music videos were incomparably exquisite. Below each video, there were also an explosive number of likes, comments, and shares!
She opened the comments section of “Remembrance”.

The top comment said, “If the person who came to watch this video is someone who has fallen out of love, please leave quickly. Close the video and leave quickly. Don’t look back! Otherwise, you’ll cry in public like me!”
Furthermore, this comment had two million likes!
There were 100,000 replies to this comment!
With this comment, this video could instantly defeat 99% of the videos on the Huoyin short video platform.
She expanded the comments below.
“Damn it, why didn’t you remind me earlier!”
“I’ve already cried in my university class. The teacher was frightened! They just ran over to comfort me.”
“Our entire dormitory...”
“I saw this comment as soon as I came in. I’ve stopped the video. I’m a little afraid. What should I do now? I’m panicking!”

The hashtag “Divine Song from the Heavens” had become a trending topic!
Moreover, these four songs were also trending on Weibo!
Wang Menghan’s latest Weibo post was a Weibo post about her new songs.
There were already hundreds of thousands of comments below!
“These are simply divine songs!”
“Did you guys see that?
These four songs have already reached the top of the major music apps!”
“In the past, Sister Menghan wrote the songs and lyrics herself.
Why were these songs written by a person called Chen Yun?”
“Although I don’t know who Chen Yun is, most of these four songs were supported by the melody.
Damn it, these songs are too addicting.
It feels as if you won’t be able to sleep at night if you don’t put on your earphones and listen to these four songs on repeat!”
Many people were already urging for new songs!
“A new song!
I want a new song too!”
“Warning: Those who have not heard these four songs must not listen to them!
It’s because they’re too poisonous!
I’ve already lost myself after listening to them!”
“Sister Menghan, I want a new song!”
“New song!
New song!
New song!”
On Weibo, Wang Menghan’s popularity directly soared to second place!
The first place on the rankings was very familiar.
It was none other than Xiao Xin!
Wang Menghan’s rise was very similar to Xiao Xin’s back then!
At this moment, Wang Menghan still did not know about these things.
After recording the songs, she and Zhang Xiaozi returned to the hotel and fell asleep.
The two of them had stayed up all night last night.
Furthermore, they recorded the songs for a long time today.
Their spirit and stamina were severely exhausted.
The next day, a cry of surprise sounded in Wang Menghan’s room.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at the data on her phone and her eyes widened.
She simply could not believe what she was seeing.
This!
“Is my phone broken?”
“Ahhh!
Menghan, get up quickly.
Hurry up!”
“Don’t sleep, get up!”
At this moment, Wang Menghan frowned and snorted on the bed.
“What are you doing, Xiao Zi?
Let me sleep for a while more.”
“You’re popular all over the Internet!
You’ve dominated all the major apps with the four songs!
You already have eight million fans on Weibo!
Look, the Huoyin app even specially made a MV for the four songs!”
Wang Menghan responded.
After a few seconds, her eyes suddenly opened and she sat up.
“Xiaozi!
What did you say?!”
She looked at Zhang Xiaozi’s phone and almost thought that she was still dreaming!
This was because it was too terrifying!
She couldn’t help but doubt the authenticity of it!
“I want to be alone.”
Wang Menghan jogged to the washroom and splashed cold water on her face.
When she returned, she looked at the data and saw that her songs were still rising terrifyingly!
The Huoyin short video platform even created fan-made music videos for her.
The four music videos were incomparably exquisite.
Below each video, there were also an explosive number of likes, comments, and shares!
She opened the comments section of “Remembrance”.
The top comment said, “If the person who came to watch this video is someone who has fallen out of love, please leave quickly.
Close the video and leave quickly.
Don’t look back!
Otherwise, you’ll cry in public like me!”
Furthermore, this comment had two million likes!
There were 100,000 replies to this comment!
With this comment, this video could instantly defeat 99% of the videos on the Huoyin short video platform.
She expanded the comments below.
“Damn it, why didn’t you remind me earlier!”
“I’ve already cried in my university class.
The teacher was frightened!
They just ran over to comfort me.”
“Our entire dormitory...”
“I saw this comment as soon as I came in.
I’ve stopped the video.
I’m a little afraid.
What should I do now?
I’m panicking!”

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Help Me Make Arrangements for Two People
paragraphs: Wang Menghan’s popularity naturally attracted the attention of more and more people.

In Shanghai, a few veteran singers were having a gathering. When they saw Wang Menghan’s data, they sneered. “Are singers nowadays so good at playing? They can just spend money to farm a place in the rankings.”
“Old Liu, this Wang Menghan is also a capable singer. I don’t think she’s farming a place on the rankings. Why don’t we evaluate her?”
“Alright, but let’s make a deal. If this is just a viral song, we have to voice it out. Otherwise, these young people will forget about us old people.”
“Okay.”
“Sure.”

Old Liu clicked on “My Carefree Heart”. Then, they listened to it with their eyes closed. The mocking smile on their faces gradually froze. Their closed eyes suddenly opened, and their eyes were filled with disbelief.
This tune! These lyrics! This voice!
This singing technique!
It was perfect and flawless!
Her voice-changing skills were also very profound!
This song!

At that moment, the few veteran singers present fell silent. Old Liu also silently stopped the song. “The new generation really surpasses the old. We’re already old, so we’re stuck in our ways. I didn’t expect such a powerful singer to appear among the younger generation. Moreover, she’s only 20 years old, so she has endless possibilities.”
“In the future, she can reach a terrifying height.”

With just a few words, the old singers looked helpless. They finally knew that Wang Menghan’s sudden rise was not because she spent money to get on the rankings, but because she relied on her own strength to reach the top.
These four songs!
They became the entertainment of the internet for the next few days!
They were very popular!
People were competing to spread the praise!
Amidst this revelry, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue had also finished their art exams and were preparing to rest at home.
“Brother, do you think we can get in?”
When Chen Yun heard Chen Mengmeng’s words, his face was filled with despair. “My dearest sister, you’ve been asking this all day for the past few days. Can you have confidence in yourself?”
“I think I performed well, but I wonder what the teachers think.” Chen Mengmeng slouched on the sofa with a melancholic expression.
Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng, who didn’t seem to have an appetite, and called Ma Ke.
He gave a few simple instructions.
A few minutes later, at the Acting Department of the Jiang City University of the Arts, the Dean’s phone rang.
At the same time, the door of his room was knocked on and the Deputy Dean opened the door. She looked at the visitor in front of her and his expression froze.
“Aiyo, isn’t this Dean Mao? Why do you have time to come to our place?”
The visitor was none other than the Dean of the Singing Department, Mao Yue.
“I’m here today to ask Dean Li for a small favor.” Mao Yue stood at the door and did not enter. He looked at the girl who was making a call not far away from the door.
The girl finished the call and walked over quickly with an apologetic smile on her face. “Dean, I had something to deal with just now. I hope that you don’t mind.”
“No, no.” Mao Yue laughed. “You’re now a popular person on the Internet. It’s only right that you have a lot of things to do.”
At this moment, the Deputy Dean looked at the girl and her eyes widened. She couldn’t believe what she was seeing!
The face she had seen the most in the past few days was the face of this girl!
Wang Menghan!
Her four songs became popular all over the country!
Furthermore, the four fan-made music videos had earned hundreds of millions of views!
They went viral on the entire Internet!
Everyone knew about her songs!
“Wang Menghan, you... this...”
For a moment, the Deputy Dean was so excited that it was as if she was not a woman in her forties, but a girl in her teens who was chasing after celebrities. Her eyes were filled with stars.
“Please come in, please come in.” The Deputy Dean quickly invited the two of them in.

The Dean looked at the visitors and nodded at Mao Yue. Then, he looked at Wang Menghan beside him and opened his mouth wide. After a while, he said into the phone, “CEO Ma, actually, you really don’t have to call me. Yes, yes, yes, I understand.”
After hanging up, the Dean heaved a long sigh of relief. Cold sweat broke out on his forehead.
Mao Yue looked at Dean Du Haochen and found it funny. “Old Du, what’s wrong with you? You’re so nervous just because of a phone call. What’s wrong? Which CEO asked you out for a meal?”
“What meal?” Du Haochen waved his hand and laughed bitterly in his heart. Mao Yue didn’t know who had called. If he knew, would he still make such a joke?
What a joke. Who was the caller?!
With his status as the Dean of the Jiang City University of the Arts, was he worthy of being treated to a meal?
Calling him already meant that CEO Ma thought highly of him!

Du Haochen looked at Wang Menghan in front of him and then looked at Mao Yue enviously. “Brother Mao, your academy is really lucky to have nurtured such a good seedling. She’s a popular singer on the Internet. With this, won’t your academy be able to exercise your powers in the entire school?”
As he spoke, he was also green with envy.

In the past, the Acting Department was the most well-funded and richest department in the entire school. They had a large number of donations from famous actors and alumni. Moreover, the principal also invested in resources. As for the Singing Department, the funds were only so-so.

However, things were different now. After all, they had nurtured Wang Menghan. She had become popular on the Internet in a few days and everyone knew the four songs. This way, the funding from the school would definitely lean towards them.
How long had it been?
The Modeling Department, which was originally at the bottom, rose up. The unknown Singing Department also rose up!
Meanwhile, the Acting Department did not make much noise!
It made Du Haochen feel very embarrassed.

Du Haochen looked at Mao Yue, who used to smile apologetically when he saw him. Now, Mao Yue was sitting there like an old man, but there was nothing he could do. After all, Mao Yue now had Wang Menghan in his hands and was very strong.
“Brother Mao, Menghan, what brings you here today?” Du Haochen asked.

“Menghan, go ahead. It’s not a big deal. Dean Du will definitely help.” Mao Yue looked at Wang Menghan and spoke with a smile. His eyes were filled with admiration. After all, Wang Menghan was now the signature student of the Acting Department!
Otherwise, if it were anyone else, he would not have come to Du Haochen even if they offered him money.

Wang Menghan looked at Du Haochen. “Dean Du, I’m here to ask you for a favor. I have two sisters. Although they’re not my biological sisters, we’re very close. One is called Chen Mengmeng, and the other is called Han Xue. They were interviewed by you a few days ago.”

“I don’t know how well they performed or if they were nervous, so I came to ask. If their performance was not satisfactory, I want you to help out. I can guarantee that these two girls are definitely good seedlings.”
“If you need my help in the future, I will definitely do my best.”
Who?!
Chen Mengmeng? Han Xue?
Who exactly were these two?!
Why was another one here to talk?!
His expression changed. Just as he was about to speak, there was another knock on the door.
Du Haochen opened the door and saw a middle-aged man and a girl standing outside.
“Old Du, you’re here. I’m here to ask you for a favor. I want you to help me admit two little girls into your Acting Department.”
“With our relationship, you have to help me!”

chapters.title: Chapter 98: A Major Figure!
paragraphs: A hearty voice sounded. Du Haochen looked at the people outside.
Damn it!
The two people he didn’t want to see the most today were here!
The other visitor was none other than the Dean of the Modeling Department!
Furthermore, from what he heard just now, was this person also here to plead for leniency?
Could these two little girls be...
“Right, right, what are the names of those two little girls? Xiao Xin?” The Dean turned his head and looked at the girl beside him. For a moment, everyone present suddenly stood up from their chairs.
Even Mao Yue gasped when he looked at the girl. How could he not know this little girl?
She was called the Internet God of Luck!
She was undoubtedly a pillar of the Tianyun Live-Stream!
She had tens of millions of fans on Weibo!
She was a figure who could exercise her influence on the Huoyin short video platform!
It was Liu Xin!
Wang Menghan also walked over quickly. “Xiao Xin!”

“Eh? Sister Menghan, it’s been a long time since we last met. I saw everything. Congratulations on your recent popularity!” Xiao Xin held Wang Menghan’s hand with both hands and sincerely congratulated her.

Wang Menghan smiled bitterly in her heart. She knew in her heart that all of this was brought to her by Chen Yun. If not for Chen Yun, she would still be unable to sleep the entire night and could not write a new song, let alone become popular all over the Internet.
“By the way, Xiao Xin, what are you doing here?”

Xiao Xin looked at Du Haochen. “Dean Du, I’m here for my two sisters. One is called Chen Mengmeng, and the other is called Han Xue. Please accept them into the Acting Department. They’re very hardworking.”
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were mentioned again?!
What kind of identities did these two have?!
Du Haochen looked at everyone and sighed. Then, he returned to his seat and slumped down.
Everyone looked at him and their hearts skipped a beat. Mao Yue rushed forward and said, “Old Du, you won’t disrespect us, right?”

“That’s right, Old Du. Why do you have such an expression? Isn’t this a small matter to you? Moreover, you only need to take in two more people. There’s no need to reduce the number of other students. Isn’t this a very simple matter?”
Du Haochen sighed and looked at the people in front of him!
“It was a very simple thing to begin with. You guys made it complicated.”

Everyone was stunned for a moment before laughing. That was right. The two most popular people on the Internet and two Deans of the Jiang City University of the Arts were here. In the end, it was all because of such a small matter.

“Isn’t it just a coincidence? However, I heard from Menghan that those two girls are indeed not bad. From the looks of it, they’re very popular. Otherwise, these two wouldn’t have come,” said Mao Yue after laughing.
Everyone nodded.
However, Du Haochen shook his head. “Brother Mao, do you know who called me just now? Which CEO is it?”
Hm?
“Who was it?”
“It was CEO Ma Ke of Sacred Heaven Entertainment! He also called to ask for a favor for the sake of these two girls!”
This sentence stunned the Deans of the other two departments. They stood rooted to the ground and could not regain their senses for a long time!
Who was Ma Ke?
He was the CEO of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, the head of the star-making factory!
Over the years, Ma Ke had created countless celebrities!
Every single one of them was still active in the entertainment industry!
If such a big shot was asking for a favor for these two little girls, then who were these two girls?!

“Actually, why did all of you come?” Du Haochen took out the results sheet and slammed it on the table. “Look, these are the results of the art examination. Chen Mengmeng scored 96 points and was ranked first!”
“Han Xue scored 94.6 points and was ranked second!”
“Tell me, why would I need you to plead for such good seedlings? Only a fool would not want such good seedlings!” Du Haochen spoke. He was even more certain of these two people in his heart.
After all, what was the background of these two people?
Ma Ke from Sacred Heaven Entertainment had deliberately instructed him!
The two most popular figure on the Internet were protecting them!
As the saying went, even pigs could fly in the eye of the storm, let alone these two people!
It was almost certain that they would become movie stars in the future!
Thinking of this, even Du Haochen was excited. A good thing had finally happened to the Acting Department!
Wang Menghan and Liu Xin went over to the results sheet and took two photos. They were satisfied.
Du Haochen took the opportunity to say, “Perfect timing. Shall we have lunch together?”
“Alright, then I won’t refuse.”
“We don’t have anything to do. Let’s go too.”
Meanwhile, in the villa, Chen Yun was calm while Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were listening to Wang Menghan’s song.
The next moment, Chen Mengmeng’s phone rang. “Sister Menghan, what’s wrong?”
“Huh? What did you say? Xiao Xue and I got first and second place in the art examination? Really?”
“That’s great!”
Chen Mengmeng jumped up, and Han Xue’s face immediately turned red.
“Okay, I’ll tell my brother.”
“Brother, Sister Menghan said that she’ll treat you to lunch. She said that Sister Xiao Xin and the Dean of the Acting Department are here too,” said Chen Mengmeng excitedly.
Chen Yun nodded. “Tell them to go straight to the First-Grade Restaurant. I’ll treat them to lunch. Tell Sister Menghan too.”
With a phone call, Chen Yun knew what was going on. It turned out that Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin had also gone to visit the Dean of the Acting Department.
However, the fact that Mengmeng and Xiao Xue scored first and second respectively should be correct.
They had been too worried.
“Let’s go. Dress appropriately.” Chen Yun stood up. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue immediately pounced on him, their faces filled with joy.
Chen Yun drove the two of them to the First-Grade Restaurant in the Maserati.
Xiao Xin and the others were already waiting at the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant.
Then, everyone saw a luxury car nearly six meters long drive over.
There was a Maserati Quattroporte!
It was a car worth more than three million!
They alighted from the car.
“Chen Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin greeted Chen Yun, and everyone greeted one another.
Chen Yun looked at Du Haochen. “Dean Du, I’ll have to trouble you with my two sisters in the future.”
“Of course, of course.”
Although Du Haochen did not know Chen Yun’s identity, just from his aura and this car, he was extremely extraordinary!
They walked in.
Many people immediately recognized Chen Yun.
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, which room are you in? I’ll toast you.”

Many people walked towards Chen Yun. All of them were dressed in suits and leather shoes, and they had outstanding auras. However, they smiled apologetically at Chen Yun and were as obedient as lambs.
Du Haochen moved closer to Wang Menghan. “Menghan, who is this person? Why are so many people calling him Director Chen?”
“He’s the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment and holds 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares. Ma Ke is his subordinate. Otherwise, CEO Ma wouldn’t have called you.”
What?
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment who held 80% of the shares!
In that case, wouldn’t his net worth be in the tens of billions?!
He was such a young billionaire!
For a moment, Du Haochen’s heart shook, and his legs began to tremble!

“Actually, why did all of you come?” Du Haochen took out the results sheet and slammed it on the table.
“Look, these are the results of the art examination.
Chen Mengmeng scored 96 points and was ranked first!”
“Han Xue scored 94.6 points and was ranked second!”
“Tell me, why would I need you to plead for such good seedlings?
Only a fool would not want such good seedlings!” Du Haochen spoke.
He was even more certain of these two people in his heart.
After all, what was the background of these two people?
Ma Ke from Sacred Heaven Entertainment had deliberately instructed him!
The two most popular figure on the Internet were protecting them!
As the saying went, even pigs could fly in the eye of the storm, let alone these two people!
It was almost certain that they would become movie stars in the future!
Thinking of this, even Du Haochen was excited.
A good thing had finally happened to the Acting Department!
Wang Menghan and Liu Xin went over to the results sheet and took two photos.
They were satisfied.
Du Haochen took the opportunity to say, “Perfect timing.
Shall we have lunch together?”
“Alright, then I won’t refuse.”
“We don’t have anything to do.
Let’s go too.”
Meanwhile, in the villa, Chen Yun was calm while Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were listening to Wang Menghan’s song.
The next moment, Chen Mengmeng’s phone rang.
“Sister Menghan, what’s wrong?”
“Huh?
What did you say?
Xiao Xue and I got first and second place in the art examination?
Really?”
“That’s great!”
Chen Mengmeng jumped up, and Han Xue’s face immediately turned red.
“Okay, I’ll tell my brother.”
“Brother, Sister Menghan said that she’ll treat you to lunch.
She said that Sister Xiao Xin and the Dean of the Acting Department are here too,” said Chen Mengmeng excitedly.
Chen Yun nodded.
“Tell them to go straight to the First-Grade Restaurant.
I’ll treat them to lunch.
Tell Sister Menghan too.”
With a phone call, Chen Yun knew what was going on.
It turned out that Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin had also gone to visit the Dean of the Acting Department.
However, the fact that Mengmeng and Xiao Xue scored first and second respectively should be correct.
They had been too worried.
“Let’s go.
Dress appropriately.” Chen Yun stood up.
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue immediately pounced on him, their faces filled with joy.
Chen Yun drove the two of them to the First-Grade Restaurant in the Maserati.
Xiao Xin and the others were already waiting at the entrance of the First-Grade Restaurant.
Then, everyone saw a luxury car nearly six meters long drive over.
There was a Maserati Quattroporte!
It was a car worth more than three million!
They alighted from the car.
“Chen Yun!”
“Brother Yun!”
Wang Menghan and Xiao Xin greeted Chen Yun, and everyone greeted one another.
Chen Yun looked at Du Haochen.
“Dean Du, I’ll have to trouble you with my two sisters in the future.”
“Of course, of course.”
Although Du Haochen did not know Chen Yun’s identity, just from his aura and this car, he was extremely extraordinary!
They walked in.
Many people immediately recognized Chen Yun.
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, which room are you in?
I’ll toast you.”
Many people walked towards Chen Yun.
All of them were dressed in suits and leather shoes, and they had outstanding auras.
However, they smiled apologetically at Chen Yun and were as obedient as lambs.
Du Haochen moved closer to Wang Menghan.
“Menghan, who is this person?
Why are so many people calling him Director Chen?”
“He’s the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment and holds 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares.
Ma Ke is his subordinate.
Otherwise, CEO Ma wouldn’t have called you.”
What?
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment who held 80% of the shares!
In that case, wouldn’t his net worth be in the tens of billions?!
He was such a young billionaire!
For a moment, Du Haochen’s heart shook, and his legs began to tremble!

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Acting Big
paragraphs: This!
This was a huge figure!
Du Haochen suddenly felt like he was overwhelmed by happiness.
At this moment, he finally understood why so many people were asking for a favor on behalf of these two little girls. It was because of their relationship with Chen Yun and Chen Yun’s identity!
He had a super terrifying identity!
At the next table, Du Haochen toasted Chen Yun a few glasses of wine. Chen Yun used tea as wine, but Du Haochen did not dare to say anything.
Du Haochen’s alcohol tolerance was indeed good. After drinking, the color of his face did not change.
In the afternoon, he even brought Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue to school, saying that he wanted to arrange for them to attend the upcoming department celebration.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun went straight to Sacred Heaven to inspect their work.
[Host, please check in.]
Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Charm Card.]
[The so-called Charm Card, as the name implies, will enhance the host’s aura and charm after using it.]
[It allows the host to become the brightest star in the crowd.]
[It’s being used.]
In the next moment, the way Chen Yun looked at the people beside him seemed to have changed, especially the girls. Their gazes were like those of hungry wolves that had not eaten for a few days.
What the f*ck!
He already had the looks of an immortal. Now that he had the Charm Card, who could stand him?!
In the Sacred Heavens, it was the same. Everyone’s gaze was focused on Chen Yun. Chen Yun was now simply countless times more beautiful than a popular male celebrity.

“Director Chen, I don’t know why, but I suddenly feel that you’re especially eye-catching. I can’t help but look at you.” Ma Ke smiled bitterly and looked at Chen Yun’s vigilant gaze. “No, no, no. Director Chen, that’s not what I meant. You’ve misunderstood.”
“I’m really not...”
Meanwhile, Du Haochen had already brought Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue back to the Jiang City University of the Arts.
“You two children have to study hard and hone your skills. You must not let down your resources.”
Hearing Du Haochen’s lecture, the two of them quickly nodded.
“I’ll arrange for you to attend the department celebration. You have to perform well. Of course, you don’t have to be nervous. Just treat this as an opportunity to train yourself.”
Du Haochen spoke casually, but he did not say that many people had to fight to get into the celebration organized by the Acting Department.
It was for no other reason but exposure!
Every year, big-name celebrities would come to the celebration by the Acting Department. They were either former students or invited guests. These people brought exposure!
At that time, there would be many reporters and scouts.
Furthermore, those who went on stage were usually the best second- and third-year students of the Acting Department.
Every time the academy held a celebration, many students would be selected by the talent scouts and debut directly.
This was a moment of glory!

“You guys can dance for Wang Yiting this time.” Du Haochen considered that it was their first time on stage, so he gave them a guest who was not very famous. It could be considered as reducing their pressure.
“Perform well. The future is yours.” Du Haochen patted their shoulders and asked the Deputy Dean to bring them over. Although his expression did not change during lunch, he was a little drunk now.
They arrived at the auditorium.
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue looked ahead and realized that many people were practicing hard.
Most of them looked like students. There were also older guests who were extremely serious.
Such a scene gave people a feeling of prosperity.
When it was their turn to practice, a student from the student union was instructed by the Deputy Dean. Then, she walked towards Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue.
“Hello, Senior.”
Their words immediately made the girl smile. After all, who didn’t like sweet-talkers?
“Juniors, this is the song and the movements for the backup dancers. You can start practicing first,” said the girl.
“Okay, Senior.” Chen Mengmeng took the information and looked at it. “By the way, Senior, where’s Wang Yiting? Aren’t we going to dance for her? Don’t we need to communicate with her?”
The girl smiled bitterly. “It’s like this. Ever since a few days ago, Wang Yiting hasn’t come to practice once. We don’t know what to do either. Just take care of yourselves.”
“Alright, Senior.”
They both nodded.
Not far from them, there were people discussing in private.

“Look, those two are going to be Wang Yiting’s dancers, right? Wang Yiting is too arrogant. It’s only been a few days, and the department celebration is about to start. However, she’s only appeared once.”
“Ha, did you guys just find out? When reciting her lines, she just needs to count to four and rely on post-production voice acting, let alone show up to rehearsals.”
“I really don’t know how such an actress could become a B-list actress.”
“Needless to say, it’s because of that.” A student sneered. “Haven’t you heard of these things?”
The students beside her also sneered and nodded, their faces filled with mockery.
Standing at the center of the storm, even a pig could fly!
For another two days, Wang Yiting did not appear.
Finally, on the third day, nearing the first official rehearsal at noon, Wang Yiting arrived late.
After one round, she went off-tune several times, and the effect was even worse. Many students frowned when they heard this.
Any student in the Acting Department could sing better than her. If one were to choose from the Singing Department, one could throw ten bricks and smash ten people who could sing better than her.
After the rehearsal, Chen Mengmeng walked to Wang Yiting’s side.

“Hello, Sister Yiting. Can we interact with each other? This is our first time on stage. I’m afraid that we won’t do some things well. Please give us some pointers.” Chen Mengmeng lowered her posture sufficiently.
Wang Yiting looked at her and Han Xue and sneered. As if she did not hear Chen Mengmeng, she walked past her.
“I say, haven’t you guys seen such strong sunlight? Don’t you know what to do?” Wang Yiting said impatiently to the assistants.
“Yes, Sister Wang.” One assistant quickly bent down and personally held an umbrella. The other assistant squatted in front of Wang Yiting and fanned her.
“Go ask the student union if they have air conditioning.” Wang Yiting leaned back in her chair with a displeased expression.
The assistant’s expression turned bitter. “Sister Wang, if we’re outdoors, air conditioning is...”
“Who said you can’t turn on the air conditioner outdoors?”
Wang Yiting’s words rendered the assistant speechless. She could only walk away silently.
Half an hour later, an air conditioner was brought over and started blowing at Wang Yiting outdoors. There were even two assistants holding umbrellas for her. Such a scene was shocking.
Even Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were stunned. From the looks of it, those who didn’t know better would think that the Best Actor or Best Actress had come!
“Why is this person like this?” Han Xue sighed and pouted, looking depressed.
She usually didn’t like to complain about others, but this time, she really couldn’t hold it in anymore.
“Alright, Xiao Xue, let’s practice. Don’t worry about her.” Chen Mengmeng was also furious with Wang Yiting, but she had no choice but to comfort Han Xue.
The two of them started practicing under the sunlight.
However, the condenser of the air conditioner was facing them. Waves of heat assaulted them, making them sweat profusely after dancing for a while.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Department Celebration
paragraphs: “Are the two over there in their second or third year?” Wang Yiting asked as she drank her iced fruit juice.
“They’re two freshmen.”
Freshman?
Wang Yiting pulled a long face. “I’m here to give the Acting Department some respect, but they actually found two freshmen to fool me.”

“Don’t, Sister Wang.” The assistant quickly said, “These two were personally allocated by the Dean of the Acting Department. Moreover, I think they’re dancing quite well. They shouldn’t be a burden to us.”
“Heh.”
Wang Yiting looked at Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue. Then, she sneered.
“Furthermore, we’re here for the appearance fee and exposure.”
As soon as she said this, Wang Yiting’s expression improved a little.
“Go and tell them to train hard. If anything happens during the celebration, they won’t be able to bear the responsibility.”
“Alright, Sister Wang. I understand.”
Wang Yiting’s behavior made many people unhappy.
Even the student union couldn’t stand it anymore.
However, there was nothing they could do. After all, she was a B-list celebrity. They could only endure it.
At night, when they returned home, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s expressions were still dark.
Chen Yun looked at their expressions. “How was your practice today? You’re tired, right?”
“Yes, yes. Brother, will you watch our performance?” Chen Mengmeng’s expression changed when she saw Chen Yun and she quickly asked.
[Check-in Mission]
[One day later at the Jiang City University of the Arts.]
[Additional Mission: 10,000 Admiration Points, 0/10,000]
Ten thousand admiration points?
What was that?
“Of course. How can I not watch my sister’s first performance on stage?” Chen Yun pinched her face.
“Really?” Then, Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun. “Brother, you seem different today. You look so eye-catching.”
[+1,000 admiration points from Chen Mengmeng.]
Chen Yun was speechless.
Was his sister so strong? Did she admire him this much?
Not bad.
After dinner, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue entered the training room without resting. After all, the department celebration was imminent.
After practicing for a while, Han Xue looked at her phone and her face instantly turned red.
“Who is it? Why is there such a boring selection?”
“What selection? Let me see.”
“It’s the department belle selection. Look, the two of us are on it too.” Han Xue handed her phone to Chen Mengmeng. “Take a look. The information here is the information we submitted for the exam.”
“I think it’s quite good. We’re quite photogenic and in good condition.”
Han Xue listened to Chen Mengmeng’s words. “Shouldn’t you be paying attention to why they put us in the lineup without asking for our permission? Furthermore, why is our information there?”

“It’s the selection for the department belle. It’s not a selection with ulterior motives. Alright, don’t be angry. Look, you’ve already surpassed me in the votes. You’re heading towards first place now.”
“I’m only in third place. In my opinion, Xiao Xue, you might become the department belle.”
Han Xue was speechless. She wanted to let Chen Mengmeng feel the pain of being pestered!
She would be in so much pain!

At this moment, many people in the Acting Department of the Jiang City University of the Arts had seen the selection. After all, there were all kinds of gimmicks in every selection, so it was impossible not to pay attention to it.
In the dormitory.
“Hey, did you guys see the selection for the department belle this year? Look at Han Xue. Her voice is so nice. I’ve decided to give my vote to her.”
“What? Look at Chen Mengmeng. Her dancing is so soft that it feels as if she’s boneless. She’s simply beautiful.”

“Alright, these two are our cute juniors. Furthermore, they’re freshmen. I heard that these two will be performing at the department celebration this time. They already have a fan club called ‘Meng Xue’. There should be more than a hundred people now.”
“I love it, I love it. I’ll definitely go to the department celebration!”
A day later, the celebration was held as scheduled.
The auditorium was packed with people!

After all, this was the department celebration. Not only could students from the Acting Department come, but students from other departments would also be present. In addition, there were celebrities from all walks of life and most of the people who had been selected as the department belle would perform, so it made people look forward to it.
It was not surprising that there was such a commotion.
Du Haochen had long been waiting outside with a group of Deans. When he saw Chen Yun, he quickly welcomed him.
“Director Chen, it’s our honor to have you here.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, your seat is here. Please follow us.”
Not only was Du Haochen like this, but even the leaders beside him had flattering smiles on their faces. They did not dare to be disrespectful. After all, they knew about Chen Yun’s status!
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
It had to be known that the Acting Department of the Jiang City University of the Arts was a star-making factory. Many of the students who went out were famous in the entertainment industry.
However, compared to Sacred Heaven, their Acting Department was nothing. Sacred Heaven was the real star-making factory. At most, they were just delivering raw materials to Sacred Heaven.
Therefore, how could they not be respectful to Chen Yun?
Hence, there was such a scene.
Chen Yun walked in front, and no one walked beside him. Even Du Haochen followed half a step behind Chen Yun.
Such a group of leaders entering naturally attracted the attention of the students.
They subconsciously looked at Chen Yun.
Chen Yun was dressed in a green and white suit. His domineering aura could be seen as he walked in front of everyone.
“Have you seen that brother?!”
“So handsome! I can’t take it anymore!”

“Does anyone know his information? I’ll pay 100, no, 200 yuan!” A girl couldn’t help but exclaim softly. She looked at Chen Yun with her beautiful eyes. “I suddenly feel like I’ve found my Prince Charming.”
“Don’t be unrestrained. That brother is mine. I’ll ask him for his WeChat.”
“Hey, don’t run!”
Chen Yun’s entrance caused all the girls to exclaim. Many girls left their seats and ran towards Chen Yun.
[+80 admiration points from Qu Yirun.]
[+67 admiration points from Zhang Huan.]
[+100 admiration points from Cong Qiannan.]
In just a few minutes, Chen Yun’s admiration points had already exceeded the 50,000 mark!
He had exceeded the quota for the reward!
Furthermore, it was still rising!
Seeing such a terrifying scene, even Du Haochen was shocked. He quickly waved his hand and chased these girls back. Then, he invited Chen Yun to sit in the middle of the first row.
“Director Chen, you’re also one of the judges today.” Du Haochen smiled at Chen Yun. Then, he handed Chen Yun a pen and score sheet.
Chen Yun nodded and sat there, looking at the stage in front of him.
Then, the phone rang.

“Hello? Mengmeng, I’m already here. I’m in the first row. Perform well. Best of luck.” Chen Yun looked at the boys and girls behind him who were holding up “Meng Xue” posters with Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s photos. “Can you see outside? You and Xiao Xue already have a fan club.”
“The name is not bad. It’s called ‘Meng Xue’.”
